Job Opening: Executive Administrator
Location: South Africa (Remote – US Hours)

Type: Full-Time, Work from Home

Hours: Monday to Friday: 9am- 5pm (US Hours)

Overview:
The Executive Administrator provides high-level administrative and operational support to senior leadership, ensuring seamless coordination, communication, and execution of executive priorities. This role requires exceptional organizational skills, discretion, and the ability to manage multiple tasks and stakeholders with professionalism and efficiency.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact and liaison between executives, internal teams, and external partners.
  • Manage complex calendars, coordinate meetings, and arrange domestic and international travel itineraries.
  • Prepare and review correspondence, reports, presentations, and other confidential documents.
  • Oversee administrative operations including expense tracking, procurement, and vendor management.
  • Maintain accurate and organized digital filing systems for contracts, communications, and key records.
  • Assist with special projects, board materials, and strategic initiatives as assigned.
  • Handle sensitive information with discretion and maintain strict confidentiality.
  • Anticipate executive needs and proactively address potential scheduling or operational conflicts.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, or related field (preferred).
  • 5+ years of experience in executive or senior administrative support roles.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and productivity tools (e.g., Google Workspace, project management platforms).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent time management, problem-solving, and multitasking abilities.
  • Professional demeanor, adaptability, and strong sense of ownership.

Job type: Part-Time (15-20hrs/week)

Think Academy US (), a 100% owned subsidiary of TAL Education Group(NYSE: TAL), is recently established education technology (Ed-Tech) company to provide K-12 extra-curricular learning services through science and technology. Pay starts from $20–25/hr, with opportunities for promotion and salary increases twice a year.

jobs.title: Superannuation Operations Specialist - Complaints
jobs.excerpt: About Future Group Future Group is not your traditional financial services company – we're a collective of super funds and services committed to changing our planet now for a better tomorrow.
jobs.description:
About Future Group
Future Group is not your traditional financial services company – we're a collective of super funds and services committed to changing our planet now for a better tomorrow. When you join us, you’ll become part of a team united by a clear and important mission: to lead the investment movement by advocating and campaigning for a future worth retiring into.
We are looking for someone to join our purpose-led high-growth scale-up as a Superannuation Operations Specialist – Complaints.

You’ll support the management of member complaints and help ensure fair, compliant and timely outcomes. You’ll work closely with senior Operations colleagues, administrators, insurers and internal stakeholders to review complaints, support responses, identify issues and contribute to improvements in member experience and complaints management.

You may already be working in a superannuation Trustee office, or you may be joining us from a superannuation administrator and looking to broaden your experience into governance, oversight and Trustee responsibilities. And the best bit, you’ll get to work with some fantastic work mates!
Future Group values diverse lived experience and identities, and we strongly encourage applications from people of Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander backgrounds, those with caring responsibilities, from culturally and racially marginalised groups, with disabilities, who experience ageism, LGBTQIA+ individuals, and those who face social exclusion due to their social class.

We recognise that the recruitment journey may present unique challenges for trans and gender diverse folk, and we are committed to ensuring an inclusive and accessible recruitment process for all. We will happily make any reasonable adjustments to accommodate diverse needs, so if there is anything we can do to support you at any stage of your application, please let us know. For more information about DEIB at Future Group, please contact us at

The Role As our Superannuation Operations Specialist – Complaints, you’ll be responsible for reviewing and supporting the management of complaints across internal dispute resolution and, where required, external dispute resolution processes.
You’ll help review complaint information, investigate member concerns, review and coordinate responses and ensure matters are accurately recorded and progressed within required timeframes. You’ll work with administrators, insurers and internal teams to gather information, clarify issues and support fair and well-reasoned outcomes for members.
You’ll also contribute to complaints reporting and insights by identifying recurring issues, process gaps and potential systemic concerns. Your work will help improve complaint handling, member communications, operational processes and outcomes.

You'll love this job if

  • You care about listening to members and helping resolve their concerns fairly.
  • You’re confident reviewing information, asking questions and identifying what needs to happen next.
  • You have strong written communication skills.
  • You have sound judgement and attention to detail.
  • You enjoy working with different stakeholders to resolve issues within clear timeframes.
  • You’re comfortable handling sensitive or difficult matters in a calm and professional way.
  • You’re interested in using complaints insights to improve processes and member experiences.

We're looking for someone who

  • Has 2+ years experience in superannuation administration, particularly complaints, or dispute resolution.
  • Has experience investigating member concerns, coordinating information from different teams and preparing or supporting complaint responses.
  • Has an understanding of internal dispute resolution and the importance of fair, accurate and timely outcomes.
  • Ideally has experience working in a superannuation Trustee office, or has worked closely with a Trustee, RSE licensee or service provider.
  • Can assess information, prepare clear written responses and maintain accurate complaint records.
  • Has strong organisational, stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Can manage multiple complaints and competing deadlines while maintaining quality.
  • Has RG146 or is willing to undertake the relevant training where required for the role.
  • Believes in Future Group’s mission and has a passion for moving Australia’s money out of fossil fuels and into renewable energy.
  • Believes in using the power of money to build a sustainable and equitable world.
Some nice-to-haves but are not essential are:
  • Experience handling complex or sensitive member complaints.
  • Experience supporting AFCA matters or systemic issue investigations.

Why would you enjoy working at Future Group?

  • A purpose-driven organisation - spend your days working on making this world a better place! The more we grow, the bigger the impact we are making on climate change and inequality
  • A B Corp organisation that cares about how it behaves inside and out
  • AFR's Best Place to Work 2026! Proud winners of TWO awards: Best Medium Organisation, and our industry category of Banking, Superannuation and Financial Services (an award we also won in 2022!)
  • Flexibility to fit work into your life (not your life around our work). School drop-offs/pick-ups and lunch-time gym sessions are a thing here
  • The choice to work from home, from one of our co-working spaces, from anywhere within Australia or even from overseas (for a short period of time)
  • The potential to own a piece of the Future Group pie with our unique Employee Share Ownership Program (with some fineprint)
  • Fun company-wide events
  • Progressive, people-focused policies and benefits including Menstrual and Menopausal Leave, Public holidays swaps, Cultural Leave, Self Care Leave and Gender Affirmation Guidelines and Leave
  • We offer employee network groups for people from diverse backgrounds: SuperGenders for cisgender women, trans men and women and non-binary folks; SuperGlobal for culturally diverse folks; and SuperPride for LGBTQIA+ folks. The groups are a safe, supportive space for people to share experiences and ideas
  • An inclusive parental leave package, with 20 weeks’ paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents of all genders
  • A laptop you can use to work remotely plus an allowance to make your working from home setup comfortable
  • Other perks such as access to our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), the ability to purchase leave, novated leasing arrangements for electric vehicles, and a few more to find out!

jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior Manager, Practice Operations
Location: remote (work from home eligible)
Travel: Ability to travel to client sites (domestic and(or) international) as required and defined per project requirements
Salary: $160,000-$180,000 DOE

Company Overview: Celerity is a consulting firm specializing in utilities and energy sectors. We empower organizations by converting complex data into actionable intelligence to mitigate risk, optimize assets, and maximize project outcomes. Our background and expertise enable us to drive and deliver transformation and operational excellence for our clients.
Practice Overview: The Business Integration Services (BIS) practice is a high-growth technology consulting practice delivering enterprise-scale integration, digital transformation, and solution design engagements for complex, multi-stakeholder clients. The practice is in its third year of a structured build and scale phase, expanding from a founding team to a full-capability organization spanning four pillars: Project Management (PMO), Business/Technical Analysis, Solution Architecture, and Engineering.
The practice operates at the intersection of business strategy and technology execution, working closely with technology partners and vendors to deliver outcomes that are both architecturally sound and commercially meaningful. It is entering a pivotal phase of maturity, transitioning from practice-leads delivery to a structured operating model with defined build paths, methodology standards, and delivery governance.
Position Overview: The Senior Manager role is newly created role designed to build and run the operational backbone of the BIS practice. This person is also a people manager while owning the internal operating infrastructure that allows the practice to scale without losing delivery quality or team cohesion. The Senior Manager is an experienced professional including consulting background with over 10 years of hands-on experience driving and building delivery excellence, can build and sustain a high-performing team culture, and has the operational discipline to manage experienced professionals through a period of rapid growth.
This role demands strong operational leadership, industry knowledge, and technical fluency to drive results in complex client environments.
Key Responsibilities:
Practice Operations & Delivery Coordination:

  • Own the weekly resource coordination sync and alignment across multiple projects — aligning deployment to project demand, managing capacity constraints, and ensuring no engagement is under-resourced
  • Maintain a real-time view of utilization across all active engagements; proactively identify over-allocation, burnout risk, or skill mismatches and resolve before they affect delivery.
  • Build and maintain the practice's operational cadences: team meetings, delivery check-ins, onboarding sequences, and inter-pillar coordination mechanisms.
  • Escalate delivery risks that require leadership action; translate ground-level team intelligence into clear, actionable executive signals without filtering out critical information
  • Ensure the project teams have the tools, templates, methodologies, and standards they need to deliver consistently across different engagement types and client environments
Capability Building:
  • Partner with the project teams to define and maintain the practice's methodology: discovery frameworks, requirements standards, stakeholder engagement approaches, and deliverable quality benchmarks
  • Build a learning and development calendar for the team that reflects real engagement needs — not generic training — including cross-pillar exposure across all pillars.
  • Create and maintain a competency framework that provides clear, credible criteria for performance evaluation and career progression, recognizing that most team members are already highly experienced
  • Drive/support the development of BIS delivery playbooks, templates, and standards for discovery, change management, testing, cutover, and post-implementation support.
  • Identify patterns across engagements where capability gaps surface and systematically address them through targeted development rather than reactive support
  • Use insights from the quarterly coach roundtable to shape new hire onboarding for incoming cohorts, ensuring lessons from active delivery are embedded into how new team members learn the practice
People Leadership & Team Development
  • Lead structured onboarding for incoming new hires, ensuring they integrate into the practice culture and reach delivery readiness within 60-90 days.
  • Serve as a direct people manager for the reporting team that includes senior business analysis professionals with process, data, business/technical requirements and systems/product implementation skillsets.
  • Hold a quarterly coaching roundtable with cross-pillar coaches to aggregate team development signals and translate them into management action
  • Retain and support a team of experienced senior practitioners— understanding the difference between craft recognition and career progression for high-expertise individual contributors
Practice Strategy & Governance
  • Contribute to capacity planning working with leadership to project capacity needs against pipeline and growth targets
  • Partner with leadership on the design of the coaching model, cross-pillar development programs, and any structural adjustments as the practice scales
  • Maintain the operating model documentation: org structure, role definitions, operating norms, and governance processes that align with the team structure on implementation projects.
Continuous Improvement & Quality Assurance
  • Promote continuous improvement through lessons learned, feedback loops, and project retrospectives.
  • Ensure project deliverables meet established quality standards, conduct quality audits and reviews, and implement quality improvement processes.
Educational Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Management, or a related field or equivalent experience.
  • Advanced degree (MBA or Master’s) is preferred.
Required Skills and Experience:
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in technology consulting, professional services, or a related discipline, with demonstrated experience leading or managing teams of senior practitioners.
  • Proven track record as a people manager — comfortable owning performance reviews, difficult conversations, retention risk, and career development for experienced individual contributors
  • Experience working with Agile and Waterfall methodologies in SaaS companies or with system integrators.
  • Strong working knowledge of the four pillars as a discipline: what excellent discovery looks like and how requirements mature through an engagement
  • Experience managing resource deployment and capacity planning in a project-based or consulting environment
  • Demonstrated ability to build trust with experienced peers and direct reports who have strong professional identities and do not require or respond well to directive management styles
  • Comfort operating in a high-growth, structurally evolving environment where processes are being built while delivery is ongoing
  • Strong understanding of utility operations, asset management, and regulatory compliance.
  • Demonstrated experience in team building and leadership, with the ability to inspire and develop talent.
  • Excellent project management skills, including proficiency in project planning, execution, and risk management.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage clients and stakeholders at all levels.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to engage with clients effectively, collaborate with internal teams, and interact with management.
  • Ability to travel domestically and(or) internationally if required.
Preferred Skills:
  • Prior experience in practice operations, delivery management, or capability development role within a consulting firm or technology services organization
  • Familiarity with the cross-functional dynamics between PMO, BA, solution architecture, and engineering in integrated delivery engagements
  • Experience with coaching models, structured mentoring programs, or formal learning and development initiatives in a consulting context
  • Exposure to Big 4 or top-tier consulting operating models — particularly how those firms separate craft leadership from people management at scale
  • Experience hiring and onboarding senior practitioners in a compressed timeline.
  • Certifications: PMP/PMI-ACP, Prosci/Change Management, ITIL, SAFe/Agile or relevant certifications.

The salary range for this position is provided in good faith and is subject to variation based on geographic location, candidate experience, and market conditions. Final compensation will be determined after a comprehensive evaluation of the candidate’s qualifications and alignment with the role.

In accordance with applicable pay transparency laws—including but not limited to those in California, Colorado, New York, Washington, and other jurisdictions—we disclose salary ranges to promote equity and transparency. jobs.excerpt: Employment Type:We welcome interest from both full-time employees and independent consultants for this role.
jobs.description:
Employment Type:

We welcome interest from both full-time employees and independent consultants for this role. Candidates may be considered for either a permanent position or a consulting engagement based on experience, availability, and project needs.

*Applications are accepted on a rolling basis and qualified candidates will be contacted when there are new openings*

This position is available for remote work in the following states: AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, KS, KY, MA, MD, MI, NC, NY, OH, OK, TN, TX, WA

Vanguard Clinical, Inc. is a Contract Research Organization (CRO) headquartered in San Diego, CA, USA. Our mission is to bring innovation to clinical trial execution through passion, transparency, co-active communication, and integrity, to facilitate the successful development of life-changing medicines and therapies.

We are experts in clinical trial operations with a focus on Clinical Trial Management, CRO/Vendor Oversight, Trial Master File Management, Clinical Monitoring, Quality Assurance, Data Management and Study Startup. As a small company, we are highly adaptable, flexible, and transparent. Our unwavering integrity forms the foundation for our strong relationships both internally and as a partner to our Sponsor clients. Beginning with study development, we bring a “white glove service” approach to clinical trials. Our flexible approach and ongoing process development ensure efficiency and adequate resourcing, allowing us to respond rapidly to our clients’ needs as they evolve.

Our talented team is driven by passion and purpose, which has afforded us the opportunity to successfully lead clinical programs for pharmaceutical, medical device and biotechnology companies of all sizes in a variety of therapeutic areas. Our mission is to conduct clinical trials with outstanding quality on behalf of our clients to bring new drugs to market with the utmost integrity and confidence in the results.

Position Overview:

Reporting to the Director, Clinical Monitoring, primarily responsible for the management of clinical sites and monitoring of clinical data at assigned sites. The Senior Clinical Research Associate (Sr. CRA) will independently execute monitoring responsibilities for clinical trials in Phases 1, 2, and 3, in accordance with ICH/GCP guidelines and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Prepares for and conducts site qualification, site initiation, interim, and closeout monitoring visits.
  • Main point of contact between assigned sites and Sponsor.
  • Conducts all monitoring with a strong focus on data integrity and patient safety, adhering to GCP protocol and sponsor requirements.
  • Delivers high quality and timely reports following each monitoring visit.

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Samsara Security is looking for a Senior Threat Detection Engineer. This is a hands-on engineering role: you will build and operate the signals, pipelines, and tooling that power how we discover threats against Samsara and our customers.

The Threat Detection team owns the detection platform end to end — the data pipelines that feed it, the detection content that runs on it, the CI/CD that ships it, and the AI-assisted tooling that scales what a small team can cover. You will write detections, and you will also build the machinery that makes the next detection faster to develop, safer to deploy, and measurable in production.

You will report to the Director of Threat Detection and Response and work closely with Security Operations, Application Security, and Enterprise Security, as well as engineering teams across the company.

We are looking for someone who takes projects from idea to proof-of-concept to production, who is comfortable being the first person to build something, and who is genuinely interested in what AI can and cannot do for detection engineering — including where it introduces risk rather than removing it.

This role is open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You're energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

  • Build, deploy, and continuously improve MITRE ATT&CK–aligned detections across cloud, endpoint, identity, email, and application telemetry, with clear false-positive thresholds.
  • Own the full detection lifecycle—from hypothesis, data validation, and baselining through deployment, tuning, validation, and retirement.
  • Advance our detection-as-code platform through version control, peer review, automated testing, CI/CD, and improved pipeline reliability and observability.
  • Identify emerging threat surfaces and build integrations that strengthen data ingestion, enrichment, and coverage across internal and third-party systems.
  • Evaluate AI-powered security capabilities, including secure MCP integrations, threat hunting, anomaly detection, and response automation.
  • Turn threat intelligence into actionable detection and retrospective scanning.
  • Partner closely with Security Operations during investigations, incidents, table top exercises, detection maintenance, and code pairing.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 6+ years in security engineering, detection engineering, or a related technology discipline.
  • Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience analyzing large datasets to build and validate detections.
  • Hands-on experience with detection-as-code, Git-based workflows, automated testing, and CI/CD deployment.
  • Deep experience with modern SIEM platforms, including data onboarding, advanced queries, dashboards, and threat intelligence enrichment.
  • Working knowledge of AWS, Linux, containers, and EDR.
  • Proven ability to build systems from scratch, lead projects independently, learn new technologies quickly, and communicate technical concepts clearly through documentation, RFCs, and presentations.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience with data orchestration platforms such as Airflow or Databricks.
  • Applied experience with LLMs, agentic frameworks, and MCP integrations, including their security risks and failure modes.
  • Experience with behavioral analytics, anomaly detection, feature engineering, and model evaluation.
  • Familiarity with risk-based alerting, ChatOps, distributed alerting, and attack simulation.
  • Additional experience with Go, Terraform, malware analysis, digital forensics, or FedRAMP environments.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$157,675—$238,500 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

jobs.title: Content LiveOps Manager
jobs.excerpt: We've set the standard in kids entertainment.  Come help us raise it.
jobs.description:
We've set the standard in kids entertainment.
Come help us raise it.

We're Lingokids, the #1 entertainment platform for young kids. Most kids content is designed to capture attention. We create experiences little ones genuinely love.

Everything we make is created in-house to be seriously fun, with the good stuff built in from the very beginning. We're KidSAFE certified, completely ad-free, and committed to giving families entertainment they can trust, with no compromise. Ever.

20 million kids come back to us every single month, and we’ve earned more than 50 awards along the way. Now we're going after something bigger: becoming the go-to entertainment destination for kids everywhere, and changing what content looks like for the generation growing up on it.

You in? Keep on reading.

What you’ll do

As a Content LiveOps Manager, you will build Content LiveOps from (almost) zero: there's limited live-ops cadence and an early playbook, so what you set up becomes the operating rhythm Lingokids ship from here on. There's a lot to unlock too. As we grow into the leading kids' entertainment platform for licensed IPs, every new IP adds another vein of live-ops potential (events, drops, tie-ins) nobody's tapped yet.

  • You’ll own and run a weekly content release cadence: new games, new IPs, new content going live on a predictable schedule.

  • Design, plan and run time-limited events as the program matures, eg: a themed weekend drop with its own promotional treatment, not just a content update.

  • Define what a release needs beyond the content itself: teaser moments, custom or animated icons, countdown treatments, in-app announcements, comms, and work with marketing, engineering and design to build what makes that possible.

  • Soft-launch new content and games, and own the process for how something moves from ready to live.

  • Partner with the Content Experimentation team to test the variables that matter (event length, timing, locking, positioning, packaging) and use the results to improve the next release.

  • Be accountable for whether releases actually land: on schedule, and with a measurable lift in engagement and retention.

What you’ll bring

  • Direct experience running a content release cadence, live-ops strategy, or live-events pipeline, done operationally.

  • Comfort with a weekly operating rhythm.

  • Strong cross-functional coordination skills: you'll be pulling in engineering, art, and design capacity shared across a broader team, not a dedicated build team of your own.

  • LiveOps and Performance Data literacy: you can look at a release's performance and know whether it worked, how to iterate, and why.

  • Background in games where "what's live changes constantly" is a normal part of the job.

Nice to have.

  • Experience specifically with time-limited or seasonal events (eg: a holiday tie-in, a licensed-IP drop, a themed weekend…)

  • Familiarity with subscription or content platforms for a young or family audience.

English is a must:We’re a multicultural team providing a service in English, so while certifications aren’t necessary, fluency is essential. As a fully remote company, clear and effective spoken and written communication—especially in asynchronous, long-form formats—is key to collaborating successfully.

Life at Lingokids

📚 Career Growth: Your growth drives our success! We invest in your development up to €2,000 per year for books and training; so you can keep learning and growing with us.

🏡 Remote in Spain & Relocation-Friendly Work from wherever you’re most productive, whether that’s your home anywhere in Spain or our vibrant hub in Madrid. Not currently in Spain? We’d love to have you here! We actively encourage relocation for those looking to make Spain their new home base.

📈 Stock Options: Your contribution matters! You'll receive stock options, giving you the opportunity to own part of the company and share in its success.

🖥 Home Office Setup: Create your ideal workspace with a €400 allowance for setup and €35/month for remote work expenses, because comfort fuels creativity!

🍲 Meal Allowances: Get €60/month on your Cobee card to enjoy meals at restaurants or food delivery, good food makes everything better!

💳 Flexible Compensation: Manage your meal, transport and childcare expenses easily with Cobee, integrating them directly into your payroll.

🩺 Health Insurance: Access private health coverage at exclusive rates through Adeslas, seamlessly deducted from your payroll, quality care made simple.

💬 Language Lessons: Learning never stops! Enjoy free language classes in Spanish and English, to sharpen your skills and stay connected in a global team.

🌍 Visa Sponsorship: If you need a visa to work in the EU, we’ll handle the process and cover the costs to make your transition seamless.

🎉 Company events: Yes! We’re a fully remote team spread across different countries, but we love getting together from time to time in different corners of Spain, for team gatherings and recharging at our amazing off-sites!

Passion matters more than perfection

Didn’t check every box for this role? No worries! We’re looking for passionate, driven individuals who believe in our mission. If that sounds like you, we’d still love to hear from you!

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

At Lingokids, diversity isn’t just a checkbox—it’s at the heart of everything we do. Just like we teach kids to embrace differences, we celebrate them in our team, knowing that the best ideas come from unique perspectives. We’re all about creating a space where everyone feels valued, heard, and empowered to be their authentic selves. No matter your background, identity, or story, if you’re passionate about making a difference in education, we want you here.

Senior Key Account Manager

Department:

Commercial Operations & Global Sales, Inventory and Operations Planning

Reports To:

Director, Commercial Operations & Global Sales, Inventory and Operations Planning

Location:

Remote option or onsite in either Marquette, MI or Bethlehem, PA (travel to sites and customers quarterly, approx. 20%)

FLSA Status:

Exempt

MAIN FUNCTION

The Senior Key Account Manager holds primary ownership of Exalta's most strategically significant original equipment manufacturer (OEM) accounts, serving as the senior customer-facing leader within the Commercial Operations team. This role requires substantial prior customer-facing experience within the OEM industry — medical device OEM experience strongly preferred — combined with demonstrated judgment managing complex, multi-site customer relationships at the executive level. The Senior Key Account Manager owns the customer Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) cadence for assigned strategic accounts, serves as the senior escalation point for customer-impacting issues, and partners directly with the Director of Commercial Operations and Global SIOP to translate customer demand into the SIOP process. The role also carries responsibility for mentoring and developing Key Account Managers, strengthening the team's account strategy and execution. This position is designed to build the next generation of commercial leadership within a vertically integrated medical device manufacturing environment.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES / RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic Account Leadership

  • Own the end-to-end commercial relationship for Exalta's most strategically significant OEM accounts, serving as the senior point of contact across multiple product lines, programs, and sites.
  • Lead the customer S&OP cadence for assigned strategic accounts, driving rollout, phased maturity, and ongoing governance in partnership with the Director of Commercial Operations and Global SIOP.
  • Develop account-level strategic plans that align customer growth expectations with Exalta's capacity and operational constraints.
  • Represent Commercial Operations in executive-level customer business reviews, contract discussions, and new program launch conversations.

SIOP Integration & Demand Ownership

  • Serve as the senior demand data owner for assigned strategic accounts within the SIOP process; validate and reconcile the highest-exposure forecast inputs ahead of the monthly demand review gate.
  • Own forecast accuracy performance for the largest accounts in the portfolio, identify variance drivers, and present trends into the SIOP executive alignment as needed.
  • Partner with the Director of Commercial Operations and Global SIOP to ensure customer demand inputs are reflected accurately in the SIOP demand plan, surfacing capacity risk early.
  • Support new product introduction onboarding for strategic account programs, coordinating across quality, planning, and operations at the program level.

Escalation & Customer Experience Ownership

  • Serve as the senior escalation point for customer-impacting issues across assigned strategic accounts, providing strategic direction rather than case-level handling.
  • Own root-cause resolution for significant service disruptions, partnering with planning, supply chain, and quality to protect delivery commitments.
  • Drive proactive, executive-level communication with customers on constraint impacts, delays, or substitutions.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Mentor and coach Key Account Managers on account strategy, escalation handling, and demand data ownership.
  • Provide the Director of Commercial Operations and Global SIOP with structured input on Key Account Manager performance, account coverage, and development needs.
  • Support onboarding and knowledge transfer for new Key Account Management team members.

Analytics, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Own KPI reporting for the Key Account Management team, consolidating on-time delivery, backorder, and fill rate performance across the portfolio.
  • Identify systemic trends across accounts and lead continuous improvement initiatives in customer operations, demand management, and order fulfillment workflows.
  • Contribute to ERP (Epicor) and Power BI reporting enhancements supporting Commercial Operations and SIOP objectives.
  • Ensure all customer-facing operations comply with FDA, ISO 13485, ISO 9001, and company quality standards.

KEY COMPETENCIES

  • Customer Focus — advanced ability to build and sustain executive-level relationships with OEM customers.
  • Leadership and Mentorship — proven ability to guide and develop Key Account Managers.
  • Business Acumen — strong understanding of OEM contract manufacturing economics, capacity constraints, and account profitability drivers.
  • Conflict Resolution and Negotiation — expertise managing complex, high-stakes customer issues to resolution.
  • Analytical and Critical Thinking — ability to translate order, forecast, and fulfillment data into account strategy.
  • Communication — executive-level written and verbal communication skills, able to represent Exalta credibly with customer Director- and Vice President-level stakeholders.

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

  • Demonstrated ability to manage a portfolio of large, complex OEM accounts simultaneously, balancing strategic priorities with day-to-day delivery commitments.
  • Executive-level written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to represent Exalta professionally in high-visibility customer settings.
  • Advanced analytical ability to translate order, forecast, and fulfillment data into account-level strategy and risk mitigation.
  • Proven skill mentoring and developing less experienced team members.
  • Collaborative working style with a demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional follow-through at senior levels.
  • Deep familiarity with demand planning, Sales and Operations Planning processes, and customer order management.
  • Proficiency in enterprise resource planning systems (Epicor preferred), Microsoft Excel (advanced), and Power BI or equivalent reporting tools.

REQUIRED / PREFERRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain, or a related field required; Master's degree a plus.
  • Minimum of five years of direct, customer-facing experience within the OEM industry required; medical device OEM or contract manufacturing experience strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience owning or supporting a formal Sales and Operations Planning or Sales, Inventory and Operations Planning cadence with strategic accounts.
  • Prior experience mentoring, coaching, or informally leading account management team members preferred.
  • Experience navigating FDA-regulated or ISO 13485 quality environments strongly preferred.
  • Epicor enterprise resource planning experience preferred; exposure to order management or demand planning modules is an advantage.

WORKING CONDITIONS

This position operates in a professional office environment with periodic interaction with manufacturing and warehouse functions. Travel to customer sites and offices may be required (approximately 20%, generally on a quarterly cadence). Must be able to maintain composure and professionalism in high-visibility, executive-level customer escalation scenarios.

Background

The African Climate Foundation (ACF) is the first and only African-led climate change re-granting organisation on the continent. Through a combination of grant making, fellowships, transformational research, technical assistance, coalition building and advocacy the ACF seeks to support interventions at the nexus of climate change, and development that have the greatest potential to deliver long-term socio-economic transformation and inclusive development. ACF also provides Fiscal Hosting (also called Fiscal Sponsorship) services to support emerging and mission aligned organisations and initiatives

All African countries should have the capacities, resources, and tools to shape their own energy transitions. African Energy Futures (AEF), housed within the African Climate Foundation, will fund African institutions to build energy systems knowledge and tools that meet African needs; train the rising generation of African energy system analysts; strengthen local energy policy and decision-making; and ensure Africa plays a greater role in shaping energy research, policy, and investment.

Purpose

The African Climate Foundation (ACF) and African Energy Futures (AEF) are establishing a shared Strategic Data & Intelligence Unit to improve how African energy and development data are gathered, governed, analysed, visualised and used.

The unit will build and maintain an online data visualisation platform, develop compelling evidence-based narratives that can shift public and policy understanding, and provide strategic analytical services to grant-making and regranting organisations. It will work closely with Ember during the platform’s initial development, while progressively building independent African capability in data infrastructure, analysis and storytelling.

The initial four-person team is intentionally multidisciplinary. It combines strategic intelligence and philanthropy engagement, applied artificial intelligence and platform development, rigorous data science and governance, and sustained hands-on data acquisition and cleaning.

Scope of the role

Reporting to the Project Director, the AI & Data Platforms Lead will design and deliver the digital and AI-enabled capabilities of the unit. The role combines product thinking, data engineering, applied AI and practical software development. You will work with Ember and other partners to develop the online data storage and visualisation platform, create efficient data workflows, and identify responsible AI applications that improve research, grant-making, communications and knowledge management across ACF and AEF. This is an applied role: the successful candidate must be able to move from experimentation to reliable tools that colleagues can use.

Responsibilities include but not limited to:

Platform and product development

  • Lead the technical design, development and iterative improvement of the online data platform and visualisation tools.
  • Translate user needs into a prioritised product roadmap, prototypes, specifications and tested releases.
  • Work with Ember to adapt or integrate relevant platform components while building a pathway to independent ACF-AEF capability.
  • Design for accessibility, low-bandwidth use, maintainability, multilingual expansion and responsible open access where appropriate.
  • Implement analytics, usage monitoring and user-feedback processes to improve product relevance.

Data engineering and architecture

  • Design scalable data ingestion, transformation, storage, metadata, versioning and publishing pipelines.
  • Integrate structured and unstructured data from public, partner and internal sources using APIs, automated workflows and documented manual processes.
  • Collaborate with the Junior Data Scientist to implement validation, provenance, reproducibility, access control and release standards.
  • Maintain technical documentation, source-code repositories, testing processes, backups and business-continuity arrangements.

Applied AI and automation

  • Identify, prototype and deploy useful AI applications for data discovery, extraction, classification, cleaning, summarisation, visualisation, research and internal knowledge management.
  • Develop retrieval, search and assisted-analysis tools that connect users to trusted ACF-AEF data and evidence.
  • Evaluate build-versus-buy choices and select appropriate open-source or commercial tools.
  • Create human-in-the-loop evaluation processes to manage hallucination, bias, confidentiality, intellectual-property and security risks.
  • Monitor relevant AI developments and provide practical briefings, demonstrations and guidance to ACF and AEF teams.
  • User enablement and collaboration
  • Work closely with analysts, programme teams, communications colleagues and external users to understand workflows and adoption barriers.
  • Provide training, templates and technical support that help colleagues use AI and data tools safely and effectively.
  • Manage technical vendors and contributors where necessary and conduct appropriate code and security reviews.

Requirements include but are not limited to:

  • Degree or equivalent practical experience in computer science, data engineering, information systems, software engineering, computational science or a related field.
  • At least 6 years of relevant experience in software, data-platform, data-engineering or applied-AI roles, including delivery of user-facing tools.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, experience with APIs and databases, and familiarity with modern web-based data visualisation approaches.
  • Practical experience with cloud infrastructure, deployment, version control, testing and secure data workflows.
  • Hands-on experience applying large language models or machine-learning tools to real organisational use cases.
  • Ability to explain technical choices, risks and trade-offs clearly to non-technical colleagues.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience with open-data platforms, geospatial data, energy data, development indicators or public-interest technology.
  • Knowledge of data protection, cybersecurity, AI governance and model evaluation in nonprofit or research environments.
  • Experience supporting organisations operating across multiple African countries and variable digital infrastructure.

Contract duration: 12 months (renewable based on mutual agreement and project success).

Business Development & Operations Lead

Remote | Full-time | 40-hours/week
Rate: $7 to $8/hour, with the final rate to be determined during the final interview.

About Pillar Health Solutions ()

Pillar Health Solutions is a growing healthcare company that partners with medical practices to provide insurance-supported dietary and exercise counseling programs for patients.

Our model connects physicians and their patients with dietitians, virtual trainers, and operational support designed to improve patient engagement and continuity of care.

We are entering an important growth stage and are looking for a Business Development & Operations Lead who can help expand our physician partnerships while strengthening the operational systems and client experience supporting that growth.

This is not a traditional back-office Operations Manager position.

We are looking for someone who can operate as a trusted extension of the leadership team: part business developer, part client success leader, part operator, and part strategic problem solver.

What You Will Own

Physician Acquisition & Business Growth

A major priority for this role is helping Pillar Health Solutions grow its network of physician and medical-practice partners.

You will:

  • Develop and execute practical strategies for attracting new physician and clinic partnerships

  • Identify opportunities to reach physicians, practice owners, office managers, and other healthcare decision-makers

  • Support organic marketing and local-market growth initiatives

  • Help develop physician-facing messaging, success stories, testimonials, and other materials that strengthen Pillar's value proposition

  • Research new channels, tools, partnerships, and approaches for increasing qualified opportunities

You do not need to be a career marketer, but you should understand how businesses grow and be able to contribute thoughtful, executable ideas.

Discovery Calls & Client Conversion

You will help convert interested medical practices into active Pillar partners.

Responsibilities will include:

  • Conducting or facilitating discovery calls with prospective physician partners

  • Explaining Pillar's services and patient-support model confidently

  • Communicating fees, billing structure, workflow, and partnership expectations clearly

  • Understanding the prospective practice's needs and identifying how Pillar can support them

  • Following up on opportunities and moving qualified prospects toward partnership

  • Continuously improving the discovery and conversion process based on feedback and results

Success in this position requires someone who is comfortable speaking directly with physicians, business owners, and senior decision-makers.

Physician, Patient & Program Operations

Once partnerships are established, you will help ensure that the experience remains strong for physicians and patients.

You will:

  • Serve as a key operational contact for physician partners

  • Monitor feedback from physicians and patients and take appropriate action

  • Coordinate with dietitians, virtual trainers, administrative staff, and virtual assistants

  • Support thoughtful matching between patients, dietitians, and virtual trainers when appropriate

  • Monitor patient engagement and identify concerns before they become escalations

  • Address service issues, complaints, and operational breakdowns

  • Help establish appropriate check-ins across the patient, dietitian, trainer, and physician relationship

Because patient experience can directly affect program continuation and business performance, this role requires someone who notices problems early and acts on them.

Founder Partnership & Executive Communication

You will work closely with Pillar Health Solutions leadership and should be comfortable communicating directly with a founder.

Initially, this may include a short daily business update meeting.

You will be expected to:

  • Prepare and drive the agenda rather than waiting for leadership to determine what should be discussed

  • Provide concise updates on projects, priorities, wins, risks, and unresolved issues

  • Explain not only what happened, but why it happened

  • Present recommended next steps and anticipated outcomes

  • Bring thoughtful options instead of open-ended problems

  • Negotiate priorities, expectations, and timelines when necessary

  • Provide respectful pushback when an idea may not be practical or when another priority should come first

  • Maintain transparency even when progress is slower than expected

We are looking for someone who can disagree professionally, communicate difficult information tactfully, and remain levelheaded under pressure.

AI & Technology Integration

Pillar wants AI to become a practical part of how the business operates.

You will:

  • Identify opportunities where AI can improve existing workflows

  • Research tools independently when a business problem arises

  • Use AI for research, analysis, documentation, communication, marketing support, and process improvement

We are looking for practical AI literacy, not simply someone who has used ChatGPT occasionally.

Operational Excellence

Although growth is an immediate priority, you will also help strengthen Pillar's operational foundation.

This may include:

What’s the position?

We’re looking for a Principal Backend Engineer to own technical direction for backend capabilities within the Promos domain, working within our shared service and cloud ecosystem. You will solve complex distributed systems problems, guide the evolution of APIs, events, data, and services, and raise the engineering bar across teams while remaining close to the code.

Working across Product, Mobile, Web, Data, QA, Platform, Security, Compliance, and Operations, you will turn ambiguous needs into durable strategies and guide critical initiatives from discovery through production. Principal level impact means creating clarity beyond one team, developing other engineers, and being accountable for organizational outcomes, not only implementation.

Your responsibilities will include:

Technical strategy and architecture

  • Own backend technical direction for the assigned product domain, such as Promos, while aligning with shared platform, cloud, data, and service standards.

Promotional and backend capabilities

  • Partner with Product, Mobile, Web, Back Office, Data, and Operations to define service boundaries, API and event contracts, experimentation, success measures, and operational controls.

Execution, quality, and operations

  • Remain hands on with the hardest problems, turning ambiguity into iterative delivery while delegating effectively and correcting work that is off course or not producing value.

  • Model and raise a high bar for code review, using reviews to improve correctness, maintainability, shared understanding, and engineer growth, and advance standards for testing, API design, security, observability, performance, CI/CD, controlled rollout, data migration, and production readiness.

  • Lead diagnosis across services, APIs, databases, caches, queues, and event streams using correlated logs, traces, and metrics, turning incidents into systemic improvements.

AI enabled engineering

  • Drive responsible adoption of AI assisted development across discovery, implementation, testing, documentation, debugging, and review, measuring improvements to quality, speed, learning, and developer experience.

  • Identify valuable product and operational uses for AI, assess feasibility and model risk, and establish guardrails for evaluation, confidential data, human accountability, and production safety.

Organizational impact and culture

  • Act proactively as a trusted technical advisor to Product and Engineering teams, identifying risks and opportunities early and using customer, operational, and market insight to make clear recommendations and drive decisions to closure.

  • Mentor Senior and Staff Engineers through architectural guidance, reviews, pairing, and reusable knowledge, and contribute technical perspective to senior hiring, capability planning, and career development.

  • Resolve systemic risks, ownership gaps, and missing capabilities by bringing the right people together, and lead change with calm ownership, constructive conflict, clear commitments, and learning without blame.

Requirements

What are we looking for?

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Experience designing microservice and service oriented architectures and operating containerized workloads with Docker and Kubernetes.

Preferred experience:

jobs.excerpt: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets.
jobs.description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

This is a technical management role to lead a team that develops Python and Golang micro-services that power our global software distribution engine. The world sees it as the Snap Store and marketplaces, behind the scenes it is a unified system that understands key concepts in software distribution - architectures, releases, betas, release candidates, stable releases, branches and more. We are on a journey to transform the experience that people all over the world have with their open source software by significantly expanding the range of software we can deliver through this system. If you have a passion for clean APIs, believe that great engineers ship software calmly and regularly against an agile plan, and know that tests are the key to higher velocity and reliability, you'll fit right in.

This is a great opportunity to take part in engineering a highly scalable SaaS product (think about the load on our systems when one of our largest Ubuntu Desktop snaps is updated by the publisher, for instance). In addition, you will have the opportunity to learn from Canonical's world-class security team as we work collectively to deliver this capability, safely, to our customers around the world.

As an Engineering Manager at Canonical, you must be technically strong, but your main responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You will develop and review code as a leader, but know that the best way to improve the product is to ensure that the whole team is focused, productive and unblocked. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do meaningful work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. You will also be expected to be a positive influence on culture, facilitate technical delivery, and regularly reflect with your team on strategy and execution. You will collaborate closely with other Engineering Managers, product managers, and architects, producing an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals.

We expect Engineering Managers to be fluent in the programming language, architecture, and components that their team uses. Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. The commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation is as important, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high-performing team.

This is a great opportunity to really learn how to do engineering of a highly-scalable SaaS product (think about the load on our systems when one of our largest Ubuntu Desktop snaps is updated by the publisher, for instance). In addition, you will have the opportunity to learn from Canonical's world-class security team as we work collectively to deliver this capability, safely, to our customers around the world.

Location: This role may be based remotely in the Americas, Europe, Middle East or Africa time zones.

What your day will look like

  • Lead a remote team of engineers in your time zone
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback, and hands-on career development
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, management, and external stakeholders
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • With your team, build clean web service APIs to support both CLI and web frontend clients, using Python (and optionally Golang).
  • Engage with many other teams at Canonical, as well as the open-source community and commercial partners

What we are looking for in you

  • Good experience in leading modern, agile software development practices
  • Experience in forming a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Demonstrative experience of being a role model for sound engineering principles and directly contributing toward your team's goals
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
  • You love to mentor, develop and grow people, and have a track record of doing it
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You are focused on success and the timely delivery of high-quality software
  • You value and nurture great team culture and spirit
  • You have experience and commitment to agile development methodologies
  • Software development experience in Python (experience in Golang in addition to that would be a big plus)
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Practical experience with Linux system administration

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.

  • Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Parental leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

ifeel | Internationaal platform voor mentale gezondheid

ifeel is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt. Wij beoordelen alle gekwalificeerde kandidaten ongeacht ras, huidskleur, religie, geslacht, seksuele geaardheid, genderidentiteit, nationaliteit, beperking of enige andere wettelijk beschermde eigenschap.

Alle informatie die je met ons deelt, wordt vertrouwelijk behandeld en uitsluitend gebruikt voor werving en selectie. Contract, per-project basis.

Compensation

Compensation is determined based on project scope and complexity.

Contractors are engaged based on the needs of specific projects and are not guaranteed ongoing or full-time work. Participation in meetings, workshops, or collaborative sessions may be requested depending on the project timeline.

Why Publish with The Daily Grace Co.?

With over a decade of publishing experience, The Daily Grace Co. creates Christ-centered resources marked by theological depth, biblical faithfulness, and practical encouragement. We value thoughtful, faithful writers and partner closely from concept development through launch. Our goal is not simply to publish books—but to serve readers with resources that meet real needs and help them treasure Christ.

Proposal Requirements


Important:Proposals that do not include all required components listed below cannot be reviewed.

AI Use:We strongly discourage the use of generative AI in book proposals, and we will not move forward with a book proposal if we detect that generative AI was used to generate or refine sample chapters.

Please submit all materials inasingle PDF(not a Word Doc or Google Doc) that includes:

1. Title and Subtitle

2. Controlling Idea (1–2 sentences)

3. One-Paragraph Summary

Provide a concise overview of the book’s purpose, scope, structure, and tone.

4. Target Audience Description (One of the Most Important Sections)Who this book is specifically for

  • Their stage or season of life
  • The particular struggles, questions, or longings they are experiencing
  • Why this book matters to them now
  • Tip: Specificity is essential. Broad descriptions such as “Christian women” or “believers” are not sufficient.

5. Comparable Titles (2–3 from the Past 5 Years)
Identify 2–3 comparable books published within the last five years and explain:

  • How your book overlaps with each one
  • How it is meaningfully distinct in approach, audience, tone, or theological emphasis

6. Author Bio

Explain what uniquely qualifies you to write this book, including:

  • Education
  • Ministry, counseling, academic, or professional experience
  • Subject-matter expertise
  • Lived experience relevant to the topic (if appropriate)
  • Previous publishing or writing experience

7. Detailed Chapter Outline

Provide a working table of contents that includes:

  • Chapter titles
  • The main idea of each chapter and how it supports the controlling idea of the book

8. Front and Back Matter (Optional)

Describe any supplemental materials (e.g., photography, illustrations, reflection questions, discussion guides, recommended resources, liturgies, appendices, etc.).

9. Timeline and Specifications

Include:

  • Current manuscript status (idea stage, in progress, complete, etc.)
  • Estimated total word count (typically 45,000–75,000 words)
  • Anticipated manuscript delivery date

10. Other Book Ideas (Optional)

If you have additional book concepts that may be a fit for The Daily Grace Co., please include a brief description of each idea (1–3 sentences per concept). While these ideas will not be considered part of the current proposal, they may be considered for future publishing opportunities.

11. Sample Material

  • The complete book introduction
  • Two fully written sample chapters representative of the final manuscript

About World Business Lenders

  • At World Business Lenders (WBL), we provide flexible, short-term commercial loans backed by real estate to help small and medium-sized businesses across the United States — particularly those facing difficulties with traditional financing. We're a fast-moving, results-driven organization that takes security seriously as we continue to grow.

Role Overview

  • Provide executive leadership and legal oversight for the Company’s Asset Resolution Department function, directing nationwide default litigation and other legal recovery strategies, overseeing Asset Resolution counsel, managing outside counsel relationships, and supporting portfolio performance and operational execution for non-performing commercial business loans secured by real estate.

Key Responsibilities & Achievements

  • Lead comprehensive legal recovery strategies across foreclosure (judicial and non-judicial), bankruptcy, lawsuits involving breach of note and guaranty, title claims, receivership, loan workouts, deed-in-lieu transactions, judgment enforcement, and collateral liquidation.
  • Provide executive oversight and direction to the Asset Resolution legal team, currently consisting of 10 Asset Resolution counsel and 6 support staff, while maintaining accountability for legal strategy, workload distribution, performance, and consistency of execution.
  • Oversee the legal management of an active portfolio of approximately 342 Asset Resolution cases, with each Asset Resolution counsel managing an average of approximately 35 active matters.
  • Oversee nationwide outside counsel by setting litigation strategy, managing legal spending, monitoring performance, reviewing legal invoices, coordinating payment of law firm invoices, and ensuring alignment with Company objectives and applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
  • Manage relationships with existing outside law firms and identify, evaluate, retain, and oversee new law firms to represent WBL in foreclosure, bankruptcy, litigation, title, and other Asset Resolution matters.
  • Partner with Executive Leadership, Credit, Servicing, Finance, Compliance, and Operations to assess portfolio risk, prioritize recovery strategies, and maximize returns on distressed assets.
  • Provide legal oversight of preservation, insurance compliance, lien protection, title matters, and disposition strategies for commercial real estate securing business loans.
  • Oversee complex enforcement matters involving deficiency judgments, guarantor collections, fraudulent transfers, bankruptcy proceedings, and contested foreclosure actions without directly managing individual cases.
  • Negotiate and oversee settlements, restructurings, loan modifications, discounted payoffs, and other resolution strategies that balance recovery objectives, litigation risk, and cost discipline.
  • Support submissions to the Asset Resolution Committee and Executive Leadership, including settlement proposals and bidding instructions associated with foreclosure sales, in coordination with designated Asset Resolution Committee representatives.
  • Develop executive reporting and portfolio analytics that deliver actionable insight into recovery performance, legal expenditures, asset aging, recoveries, charge-offs, litigation trends, and portfolio performance.
  • Establish policies, procedures, performance metrics, and accountability standards that strengthen operational consistency, reporting accuracy, portfolio visibility, legal risk management, and outside counsel performance.
  • Advance workflow automation, reporting enhancements, and operational standardization to improve efficiency, strengthen legal oversight, and support continued portfolio growth.

Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of 10 Asset Resolution counsels and 6 support staff responsible for the nationwide management and legal resolution of approximately 342 active distressed commercial loan matters.
  • Provide strategic direction and oversight rather than direct case management, ensuring Asset Resolution counsel has clear legal strategy, appropriate resources, consistent standards, and effective external legal support.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, strategic problem-solving, and client-focused decision-making while maintaining strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external legal partners.

Requirements

Legal Qualifications

Education:

  • Candidates must hold a Juris Doctor (J.D.) from an accredited U.S. law school and maintain an active license to practice law in at least one U.S. jurisdiction in good standing.

Professional Experience

  • Demonstrated experience managing or overseeing a high-volume litigation portfolio, including the ability to establish priorities, allocate resources, identify risk, monitor deadlines, and maintain consistent quality across hundreds of active matters.
  • 10 + years of substantive legal experience with proven experience overseeing multi-state foreclosure and default litigation, with a strong understanding of varying state foreclosure procedures, court requirements, timelines, lien priority, title issues, and applicable creditor/debtor laws.
  • Substantial experience with bankruptcy proceedings, breach of note and guaranty claims, title disputes, deficiency claims, receiverships, judgment enforcement, contested litigation, and other creditor recovery matters.
  • Experience managing, supervising, and developing attorneys and legal support personnel, including establishing performance expectations, reviewing work, allocating caseloads, and providing strategic legal direction.
  • Demonstrated experience selecting, retaining, managing, and evaluating outside counsel, including monitoring litigation strategy and performance, reviewing legal budgets and invoices, and managing legal spend.
  • Experience developing and implementing litigation, settlement, and recovery strategies consistent with business objectives, risk tolerance, and portfolio economics.
  • Demonstrated ability to review and analyze settlement proposals, foreclosure sale strategies, and bidding instructions and communicate recommendations to executive leadership and/or the Asset Resolution Committee.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze large volumes of case and portfolio data and use legal case-management systems, litigation tracking platforms, Microsoft Office/Excel, reporting tools, and legal research platforms.
  • Experience developing legal department metrics, dashboards, reporting, KPIs, budgets, and portfolio analytics is strongly preferred.
  • Strong judgment and demonstrated ability to identify litigation risk, evaluate recovery alternatives, make commercially sound recommendations, and balance legal risk against recovery objectives and cost.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a high-volume, deadline-driven environment while maintaining accuracy, responsiveness, confidentiality, and professional judgment.
  • Experience working directly with C-suite executives, senior business leaders, committees, and cross-functional stakeholders.
