We are seeking an experienced Senior Foundry Integration Engineer to lead the development and maturation of our silicon photonic fabrication processes through close partnership with external commercial foundries. In this highly cross‑functional role, you will own integration strategy, accelerate learning through structured experimentation, and help drive our technologies from development into stable, ramped production.

In this role, you will work at the intersection of device physics, materials, and manufacturing—coordinating across internal design, modeling, and systems teams while serving as a key technical interface to our external foundry partners.
As a Senior Foundry Integration Engineer at Photonic you'll directly shape how quickly and reliably we learn, scale, and deliver. You will help establish development priorities, improve reproducibility, and enable scaling of Photonic’s quantum compute systems.
Please include a cover letter with your resume (in one file) describing how you would be a great fit at Photonic and what attributes you could bring to our growing team.

WHAT WE NEED YOU TO DO

  • Own and execute process integration plans across external commercial foundries to mature and stabilize fabrication flows.
  • Define, organize, and drive experiments to accelerate learning and drive product performance.
  • Design experiments, analyze fabrication and measurement results, and synthesize data into clear technical conclusions.
  • Define next step process improvements and development priorities based on experimental outcomes.
  • Lead technical engagement with foundries, including aligning on integration intent, process assumptions, and learning objectives.
  • Translate system level and device level requirements into actionable fabrication strategies.
  • Collaborate closely with internal teams across nanofabrication, design, modeling, yield, and systems to produce chips supporting our core technology.
  • Ultimately drive successful production ramp of chips through improved yield, reproducibility, and process robustness.

WHAT YOU BRING TO OUR TEAM

  • Master’s or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, or a closely related field.
  • 3+ years of industry experience in process integration, semiconductor fabrication, or related roles.
  • Hands‑on experience working in or with a commercial semiconductor foundry.
  • Strong understanding of semiconductor process integration, unit processes, and cross‑module interactions in both foundry and university cleanrooms.
  • Experience and intuition in silicon photonics fabrication and design.
  • Demonstrated ability to design experiments, analyze data, and drive data‑informed technical decisions.
  • Excellent communication skills and comfort working across organizational and company boundaries.
An exceptional candidate will bring:

jobs.excerpt: As Director of Product, your mission is to build the premier product organization in supply chain: disciplined about what you build, iterative in how you build it, obsessed with the customer, and driven by data at every decision.
jobs.description:
As Director of Product, your mission is to build the premier product organization in supply chain: disciplined about what you build, iterative in how you build it, obsessed with the customer, and driven by data at every decision.

About Bobtail

Bobtail is dedicated to increasing happiness by eliminating inefficiencies in the supply chain. We envision a supply chain without friction, fraud, waste, and abuse where companies succeed based on the value they create.

We work in a unique way at Bobtail, where we value teams over individuals and encourage experimentation and iteration to constantly improve. Teams are given flexibility in working towards a shared purpose and given the freedom to decide how they will accomplish their goals.

If you are an out of the box thinker that takes a proactive approach in collaborating with others to solve problems and achieve your goals - we would love to talk to you.

The things we value:

  1. Mission
  2. Teams over individuals
  3. Collaboration
  4. Communication
  5. Iteration
  6. Experimentation and failing fast
  7. Initiative and solutions oriented approach
  8. Documentation
  9. Data
  10. Mental health and work life balance
  11. Diversity
  12. Transparency

We're hiring a Director of Product to lead product strategy, development, and innovation at Bobtail. This is a first-of-its-kind seat built around three priorities: deciding what Bobtail builds, deciding what it deliberately does not build, and executing at a high level in lockstep with engineering and the rest of the senior management team to ship it. You'll work directly with the CEO to turn a wide set of strategic options, into a sequenced, evidence-backed roadmap.

The ideal candidate has led product at a company of comparable size and complexity, with a track record of setting strategy from ambiguity rather than just running an existing roadmap, and the discipline to say no as often as yes. This individual will be highly data-driven and analytical, with the judgment to move on conviction when the data is inherently thin. We are looking for a strong product leader who can build the product management function at Bobtail from the ground up, hire and develop a team, and partner closely with engineering, design, and go-to-market leadership to turn decisions into shipped product. This includes identifying new products, services, platform capabilities, and revenue opportunities that solve meaningful problems for our customers and strengthen our competitive position. The right person will not wait for someone to hand them a list of features to build. They will spend time understanding how our customers operate, where they struggle, what they currently pay others to do, and what problems remain unsolved.

You should apply if you have:

  • 8+ years of experience in product management and strategy, including experience leading product at a company of comparable size and complexity.
  • A track record of setting product strategy from ambiguity and defending sequencing decisions with both data and judgment.
  • Experience in fintech, financial services, payments, lending, factoring, transportation technology, or another transaction-heavy financial environment strongly preferred.
  • Experience conducting product discovery, customer research, and market analysis. Strong commercial instincts and the ability to evaluate product opportunities based on customer value and business economics.
  • Comfort with compliance and risk constraints (KYC/KYB, lending, payments) is a plus.
  • Experience building and leading a product team, including hiring the first few members of a function.
  • Strong technical fluency - you don't need to write code, but you should be able to work closely with engineering on architecture trade-offs and technical feasibility.
  • Highly analytical and data-driven, with strong pattern-recognition and problem-solving skills.
  • A bias toward shipping and iterating over long planning cycles.
  • Comfort operating at a founder-led, profitable company rather than a venture-subsidized one.
  • Strong communication and cross-functional leadership skills, including the ability to clearly communicate product strategy and trade-offs to senior leadership. The discipline to say no - comfortable deferring or killing ideas that don't earn their place on the roadmap, even when they're compelling in isolation or popular internally. Demonstrated ability to influence across functions and challenge senior stakeholders constructively.
  • Financial fluency - comfortable modeling and defending the revenue potential, development cost, and opportunity cost of a roadmap bet directly to the CFO and other finance stakeholders. A track record of measuring product success based on customer and business outcomes.
  • An obsession with the customer and the product - you can't walk past something broken without wanting to fix it, and you know the product as well as the people using it, not just the roadmap slide.

You will be responsible for:

  • Decide What to Build: Develop and maintain a product strategy that clearly connects product investment to the company's broader strategic and financial objectives. Look beyond incremental feature improvements to identify opportunities for meaningful product innovation.
  • Process around decision making: Create a disciplined process for gathering and evaluating ideas without allowing the product roadmap to become a collection of stakeholder requests. Ensure completed functionality solves the underlying customer or business problem rather than simply meeting documented requirements.
  • Decide What Not to Build: Exercise real judgment about scope. Establish clear criteria for when to build, continue investing in a new product, change direction, or discontinue an initiative.
  • Execute at a High Level: Partner closely with engineering - and with design, go-to-market, and senior leadership - to turn the roadmap into shipped product on a predictable cadence, not just a plan.
  • Defend the Business Case: Build and defend the revenue potential, development cost, and opportunity cost of each major roadmap bet to the CFO, so product decisions hold up under financial scrutiny, not just strategic conviction.
  • Own the outcome: Ensure new products have clearly understood operational, financial, regulatory, and risk requirements before launch. Measure product success based on business outcomes - not simply whether features were delivered.
  • Own the Product: Take full, unbounded ownership of Bobtail's product. There are no lanes here; if it touches the customer or the platform, it's yours to shape.
  • Obsess Over the Customer and the Product: Establish a disciplined process for identifying and evaluating new product opportunities. Spend meaningful time talking directly with customers rather than relying exclusively on feedback filtered through Sales or Operations. Develop a strong understanding of competitors and adjacent providers within transportation finance and fintech. Live inside the carrier's day-to-day and inside the product itself. We want someone who can't walk past something broken without wanting to fix it, and who knows the product as well as the people using it.
  • Evidence-Driven Decision Making: Build the muscle - data, customer research, experimentation - to validate bets before committing engineering resources, while being willing to move on conviction when the data is inherently thin.
  • Team Building: Hire and develop the product management function at Bobtail, defining process and hiring bar as the first dedicated product leader.
  • Market & Competitive Judgment: Track how freight-tech and fintech infrastructure are evolving, including AI-driven disruption and industry consolidation, and stress-test Bobtail's roadmap against it.

Benefits

  • Generous PTO
  • Monthly Mental Break Day
  • Parental leave
  • Comprehensive healthcare coverage
  • Life insurance
  • 401k with company match
  • Work from home (or wherever)

Creating a diverse and inclusive workplace is Bobtail’s nucleus. We are an equal opportunity employer and embrace people of different backgrounds, cultures, religions, national origins, races, colors, genders, gender expressions, sexual orientations, ages, marital status, veteran status, experiences, abilities and perspectives.

jobs.description:
Customer Success Manager DACH (m/w/d) – Teilzeit / Contractor

Wir suchen eine strukturierte und serviceorientierte Persönlichkeit, die unsere Kunden in der DACH-Region unterstützt und ihnen hilft, das volle Potenzial von Abler zu nutzen.

Die Rolle startet in Teilzeit (ca. 10–20 Stunden pro Woche) und bietet die Möglichkeit, mit unserem Wachstum in der Region weiter zu wachsen.

Abler wird bereits von Organisationen im Umfeld von Clubs wie Chelsea F.C., Newcastle United oder Barcelona genutzt. In England arbeiten wir mit rund 40% der Clubs aus den Top 4 Ligen zusammen. Auch in Deutschland haben wir bereits erste Kunden und bauen unsere Präsenz weiter aus.

Wir sind überzeugt, dass wir eine sehr starke Value Proposition haben und echten Mehrwert für Sportorganisationen schaffen. Unser Ziel ist es, diese Qualität und Struktur auch im Breitensport verfügbar zu machen.

Wenn du die richtige Einstellung und Motivation mitbringst, unterstützen wir dich mit allem, was du brauchst, um in der Rolle erfolgreich zu sein.

Die Rolle

  • Du arbeitest eng mit neuen und bestehenden Kunden zusammen und stellst sicher, dass sie Abler erfolgreich einsetzen.
  • Dazu gehören das Onboarding neuer Vereine, die Unterstützung im täglichen Umgang mit der Plattform sowie die Beantwortung von Fragen.
  • Du bist Teil unseres Customer Success und Support Teams und arbeitest mit klaren Prozessen. Gleichzeitig hilfst du aktiv dabei, unseren Ansatz für Kundenbetreuung und Implementierung im DACH-Markt weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Du sammelst Feedback aus dem Markt und bringst es in unser Produktteam ein, um sowohl das Produkt als auch unsere Arbeitsweise kontinuierlich zu verbessern.
  • Je nach Interesse kann die Rolle auch Aufgaben im Bereich Go-to-Market und Marktentwicklung umfassen, z. B. bei der Identifikation potenzieller Kunden oder erster Business-Development-Aktivitäten.
  • Gelegentlich können auch persönliche Besuche bei Kunden Teil der Rolle sein.

Arbeitsweise

  • Remote-first Rolle (Arbeiten von zu Hause)
  • Flexible Zeiteinteilung im Rahmen der Teilzeit
  • Möglichkeit zur Unterstützung von Co-Working-Spaces je nach Bedarf
  • Gelegentliche Vor-Ort-Termine bei Kunden

Deine Aufgaben

  • Onboarding neuer Vereine und Begleitung beim Setup
  • Unterstützung von Kunden im täglichen Einsatz von Abler
  • Beantwortung von Fragen und Sicherstellung einer positiven Nutzungserfahrung
  • Sammeln und Weitergeben von Kundenfeedback an das Produktteam
  • Mitgestaltung unserer Prozesse für Customer Success und Implementierung in DACH
  • Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von Hilfsmaterialien und Guides
  • Unterstützung bei Go-to-Market und Marktentwicklung bei Bedarf

Das bringst du mit

  • Freude daran, Menschen zu helfen und Probleme zu lösen
  • Bezug zum Sport (z. B. als Spieler, Trainer oder im Verein)
  • Sicher im Umgang mit gängigen digitalen Tools (Du musst nicht hoch technisch sein, solltest aber offen sein, neue Systeme zu lernen (wir schulen dich auf Abler)
  • Strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse
  • Wohnsitz in der DACH-Region
  • Erfahrung mit Abler ist ein Plus
  • Spanischkenntnisse sind ein großes Plus (Unterstützung in anderen Märkten möglich)

Das erwartet dich

  • Flexible Teilzeitrolle mit Entwicklungsperspektive
  • Remote-Arbeitsumfeld mit hoher Eigenverantwortung
  • Unterstützung bei Co-Working-Space möglich
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit einem erfahrenen Team
  • Klare Prozesse, Einarbeitung und Unterstützung
  • Möglichkeit, aktiv Einfluss auf Produkt und Arbeitsweise zu nehmen

Über Abler

Abler entwickelt das Betriebssystem für Sportorganisationen.

Unsere Plattform wurde in Island entwickelt, einem Land mit einem der stärksten organisierten Sportsysteme weltweit. Island gilt international als Vorzeigemodell für erfolgreiche Sportentwicklung. Heute nutzen rund 75 % der gesamten Isländishen Bevölkerung Abler im Kontext von Sport - alles vom Breitensport bis hin zu professionellen Strukturen.

Unser Ziel ist es, Sportorganisationen besser zu machen und dadurch die Entwicklung von Menschen und Gemeinschaften durch Sport zu fördern.

Sport matters.

Bewerbung

Wenn dich die Rolle anspricht, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Bei Fragen kannst du dich direkt an den Hiring Manager wenden:
. Alle Bewerbungen werden vertraulich behandelt.

Part-Time Customer Success & Implementation Manager (DACH)

This is a part-time contractor role (around 10-20 hours per week to start), with the opportunity to grow over time as we expand in the region.

The Role

You will work closely with new and existing customers, helping them get set up and making sure they are successful using Abler.

This includes onboarding new clubs, answering questions, supporting them in their day-to-day use, and making sure they feel confident using the platform.

You will be part of our wider Customer Success and Support team, so you will not be alone. We will train you and support you closely, and you will have clear processes to follow. In addition, depending on your interest and capacity, the role can expand into supporting our go-to-market efforts in the DACH region. This may include helping identify potential customers, mapping the market, or supporting early business development activities.

From time to time, the role may also include visiting customers in person.

What You'll Do

  • Help onboard new clubs and guide them through setup

  • Experience with Abler is definitely a plus

What We Value

We look for people who have the Winner Mindset, Passion and Ownership.
Read here about our DNA

About Abler

Abler is building the operating system for sports organisations.

We help clubs run their programmes, manage their members, and communicate better, all in one place. Our goal is simple: help sport organisations run better and reach more people.

We are already used at scale in our home market and are growing internationally. We work with leading organisations connected to clubs like Chelsea, Newcastle, and Barcelona, and bring those same tools and standards to grassroots sport.

How to apply

If you are excited about the opportunity, join our talented team and make a significant impact on the future of our next generation through sport. We look forward to hearing from you soon!

Lieu : Montréal – télétravail possible depuis le Québec ou l’Ontario
Durée : Jusqu’au 31 janvier 2027, renouvelable

À propos du poste

Nous recherchons un Chef de projet SAP S/4HANA senior pour piloter un projet de mise à niveau de la plateforme SAP S/4HANA vers une version plus récente. La personne sera responsable de la planification, de la coordination et de l’exécution complète de l’upgrade, de la préparation initiale jusqu’à la mise en production et à la stabilisation post-déploiement.

Le mandat évolue dans une grande organisation de plus de 10 000 employés, au sein d’un environnement complexe et fortement réglementé. Le Chef de projet travaillera avec plusieurs équipes internes et externes, notamment SAP, BASIS, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, équipes d’affaires, partenaires et fournisseurs.

Exigences principales

  • 10+ années d’expérience en gestion de projets SAP.
  • Expérience concrète dans la gestion de mises à niveau SAP S/4HANA, idéalement d’une version 2020/2021 vers 2023 ou plus récente.
  • Excellente maîtrise de la méthodologie SAP Activate.
  • Expérience importante dans les domaines Supply Chain et Manufacturing.
  • Expérience dans une organisation de plus de 10 000 employés.
  • Expérience de projets SAP globaux impliquant plusieurs équipes, fournisseurs et parties prenantes.
  • Expérience en environnement hautement réglementé.
  • Capacité à coordonner plusieurs fournisseurs et partenaires simultanément.
  • Expérience importante dans la planification et le pilotage des tests, cutover et mises en production.
  • Excellente maîtrise de la gouvernance de projet, notamment échéanciers, budgets, jalons, dépendances et registres RAID.
  • Capacité à communiquer efficacement avec les équipes techniques, les responsables d’affaires et la haute direction.

Atouts

Une expérience en custom code remediation lors d’un upgrade S/4HANA est particulièrement pertinente. Une bonne compréhension de SAP BASIS et de l’architecture SAP, ainsi qu’une expérience de tests à grande échelle et de périodes d’hypercare/stabilisation post-go-live, constituent également des atouts.

Les certifications PMP, PRINCE2 ou SAP sont appréciées.

Responsabilités principales

Le Chef de projet prendra en charge le plan détaillé de la mise à niveau SAP, incluant les échéanciers, ressources, jalons, risques, enjeux et dépendances. Il pilotera les différentes phases du projet selon SAP Activate, notamment la préparation, le Sandbox, le développement, l’assurance qualité, les tests et la mise en production.

Il coordonnera les campagnes de tests intégrés, de régression et de performance, ainsi que la stratégie et l’exécution du cutover. Il sera également responsable de la coordination entre les équipes SAP/BASIS, les responsables des processus d’affaires, les équipes Supply Chain et Manufacturing ainsi que les différents fournisseurs.

La personne assurera la gouvernance du projet, le contrôle des changements, le suivi des risques et la production des rapports destinés à la haute direction. Elle contribuera également à la gestion du changement, à la formation, à la documentation et à la période de stabilisation suivant la mise en production.

jobs.title: Senior Database Administrator
jobs.excerpt: What are we building? Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world.
jobs.description:
What are we building?

Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. We're building a team that resonates with passion for learning, operating, and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We care about each customer's interactions, experiences, behavior, and insights, and we strive to ensure we always act authentically.

Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, the new Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We're taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space. Ready to join us?

What's the position?

Every bet and payout at Hard Rock Digital is a database transaction that has to be fast and accurate. A casino game resolves in milliseconds; settling a big sporting event moves millions of balances at once, and none can be wrong.

We're hiring a Senior Database Administrator to own production reliability for our CockroachDB and PostgreSQL fleet. You'll diagnose contention, range hotspots, retry storms, plan regressions, and cross-region latency in systems that move money at scale. You'll read execution plans and reason about the optimizer that produced them, inspect database internals when behavior doesn't match the docs, write Go and Python tooling that makes the next incident faster to solve, and set standards that application engineers rely on under pressure.

Claude Code, Codex, and similar AI harnesses are part of how this team works. You'll use them to investigate incidents, generate probes, summarize evidence, and turn one-off debugging into durable tooling. The goal is to spend less time on toil and more on the work that compounds: better defaults, safer migrations, and tooling that makes the next incident shorter than the last.

What You'll Do

Reliability & Performance

  • Operate and evolve multi-region CockroachDB clusters and PostgreSQL instances across production, staging, and development.

  • Investigate contention, serialization retries (SQLSTATE 40001), and range hotspots in the transaction paths behind bets, wagers, settlements, and payouts.

  • Diagnose leaseholder placement, monotonic-key write pressure, and cross-region latency that turn one query into several network round trips.

  • Trace a slow query to its execution plan, the plan to optimizer behavior, and the behavior to the schema or application call path that caused it.

  • Catch plan regressions after statistics changes, schema changes, data growth, or releases, then turn the fix into a safer rollout pattern.

  • Assess schema-change and backfill risk before it reaches large tables: lock behavior, retry pressure, capacity impact, and rollback path.

  • Plan capacity, scaling events, and version upgrades that customers don't feel.

Observability & Incident Response

  • Build database observability with Prometheus, Grafana, Mimir, Loki, and Snowflake: dashboards backed by real queries, alerting on leading indicators, and SLO tracking.

  • Connect database symptoms to application behavior and business events so alerts point at causes.

  • Join the on-call rota for the data layer, lead incident analysis when the database is part of the failure, and drive blameless postmortems toward durable fixes.

  • Instrument the system to surface degradation before it becomes an incident.

Automation & Tooling

  • Build Go and Python tools that make incidents easier to understand: log collectors, explain-plan analyzers, migration checks, capacity models, and runbook generators.

  • Automate provisioning, configuration, backup, and recovery with Terraform and other infrastructure-as-code tools.

  • Work with platform engineering on CI/CD, deployment safety, and change management for database-touching services.

AI-Augmented Engineering

  • Use Claude Code, Codex, and similar harnesses in daily work to investigate incidents, generate probes, draft runbooks, and write tooling.

  • Keep the harness grounded in logs, traces, metrics, and source code, and verify its output against production facts before you ship it.

  • Evaluate AI-assisted observability and anomaly detection, and share what works with the team.

Security & Compliance

  • Implement and audit access controls, authentication, authorization, and encryption in transit and at rest.

  • Support data-protection, audit-logging, and retention requirements for a regulated gaming platform.

Standards & Mentorship

  • Build a database center of excellence: documentation, standards, and reusable patterns that other teams build against.

  • Mentor engineers on database fundamentals, distributed-systems behavior, and operational discipline.

  • Read CockroachDB and PostgreSQL internals when a problem needs a code-level answer, and bring what you learn back to the team.

Requirements

What are we looking for?

  • 5+ years operating production relational databases as a DBA, Database Reliability Engineer, or Data Platform Engineer.

  • Deep production experience with PostgreSQL, CockroachDB, or another relational database management system, with fluency in the tradeoffs behind isolation, consensus, locality, and query planning.

  • You understand how a SQL engine works under the hood: MVCC, the Volcano iterator execution model, and cost-based optimizer frameworks such as Cascades. You apply that knowledge to indexing strategy and to execution plan analysis.

  • Working knowledge of distributed-systems fundamentals: consensus (Raft and Paxos), distributed transactions, consistency models, and failure modes.

  • You write tools and automation in Python or Go, and you can debug and suggest fixes to line-of-business code in Java or a similar language.

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code and a monitoring and observability stack such as Grafana or Datadog.

  • UNIX/Linux administration with shell scripting, comfort on a cloud platform (AWS preferred, Azure, or GCP welcome), and willingness to join an on-call rota.

  • Clear technical writing and speech. You'll work across teams.

What You've Done

The strongest candidates show evidence here, not a checklist.

  • Shipped Go or Python tooling for database operations, performance analysis, migration safety, or incident response that other engineers then used.

  • Investigated production incidents end-to-end using metrics, logs, query fingerprints, execution plans, and source-level reasoning.

  • Owned a database platform through on-call, post-incident repair, standards, and cross-team adoption.

  • Used AI coding agents in real engineering work, with review habits that keep generated output tied to evidence.

  • Run CockroachDB in production.

  • Contributed to an open-source database such as PostgreSQL.

  • Worked with streaming infrastructure such as Kafka and Materialize.

  • Worked with a modern data warehouse or analytics platform such as ClickHouse Cloud or Snowflake.

  • Practiced SRE along the lines of the Google SRE books.

What’s in it for you?

We offer our employees more than just competitive compensation. Our team benefits include:

  • Competitive pay and benefits

  • Flexible vacation allowance

  • A hybrid / remote working environment

  • Startup culture backed by a secure, global brand

  • Opportunity to build products enjoyed by millions as part of a passionate team

  • Team gatherings around the US and Europe

  • Employer-sponsored training and conference attendance

  • Opportunity to work in an AI-first environment with access to the tools you need to excel at your job

Roster of Uniques

We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us, and trust and empower our staff to own and drive their experience. Our vision for our business and customers is built on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where regardless of background or beliefs you feel able to be authentic and bring all your talent into play. We want to celebrate you being you (we are an equal opportunity employer).

jobs.title: Scholarship Program
jobs.excerpt: The Court Reporting Academy (“TCRA”) in partnership with court reporting industry partners has established a scholarship and professional career development program for qualified individuals who wish to become professional digital court reporters.
jobs.description:
The Court Reporting Academy (“TCRA”) in partnership with court reporting industry partners has established a scholarship and professional career development program for qualified individuals who wish to become professional digital court reporters. One of the major objectives for the program is to ensure that scholarship recipients are prepared to successfully pass the AAERT CER (Certified Electronic Reporter) certification exam.

The TCRA Scholarship Program also includes career placement services for individuals who have successfully completed the digital court reporting courses. Career placement is not guaranteed by TCRA; however, the court reporting industry has a growing need for qualified court reporters. Successful and motivated TCRA graduates will find there are significant opportunities for both full and part-time employment positions as well as independent contractor career opportunities.

The Digital Court Reporter (DCR) Scholarship Program Includes:

  • DCR 101 & DCR 102 courses
  • Practical and hands-on professional development and career guidance
  • No cost court reporter software during the course
  • Job placement services (for full-time and independent contractor opportunities)

Description of the Digital Court Reporting Courses:

Digital Court Reporter (DCR-101): A 4-to-6-week self-paced online course with extensive live coaching and instructor interaction. The course is designed to prepare You to be a professional digital court reporter and to successfully pass the AAERT certification exam. Several live course review and annotation sessions are held each week and scholarship students must attend at least one session per week. Successful completion of the DCR-101 course will provide You with the required knowledge of the legal system, terminology, recording equipment, reporter software and annotations, etiquette, ethics, digital court reporter best practices and other critical knowledge required to become a successful digital court reporter.

Digital Reporter Mentorship (DCR-102): An intense 3-to-4-week program that matches You up with experienced court reporters and court reporting agency sponsors as part of our unique mentoring program. The program includes shadowing experienced working court reporters in live proceedings, while also practicing Your skills in mock and actual recorded proceedings. You will receive direct feedback and coaching from TCRA mentors and instructors. To complete this course, You will need to successfully lead and complete a live mock deposition conducted with instructors and mentors.

Scholarship Selection Criteria:

Space is limited, and only qualified and motivated individuals will be considered. Individuals desiring both full and part-time employment opportunities may apply for available scholarships. Scholarship availability is based on the current market demand for court reporters and decision criteria may include a student’s state or regional location and employment objectives (i.e., full vs. part-time). TCRA in its sole determination may select a candidate for scholarship which we feel will be most successful in the DCR professional development program and best matches the reporter staffing requirements and reporter demand of our court reporting agency sponsors and clients.

Scholarship Candidate Qualifications and Requirements Include:

  • Skills: 40 to 60 WPM typing, excellent English grammar & punctuation proficiency, experience/proficiency with Window-based computers and Outlook applications. Candidates will be asked to take a skills entrance exam.
  • Successfully interview with TCRA instructors and TCRA Placement Services team.
  • Time commitment/availability: Candidates must be able to devote a minimum of 15 to 20 hours per week in order to successfully meet the DCR 101 &102 study and practice requirements.
  • Equipment: Students must have access to a PC (Windows 10 or greater) and (approved USB microphone, USB speaker and headphones or earbuds)
  • Career employment objectives: Candidates must be planning to seek full-time employment opportunities as a court reporter or a minimum of 20 working hours per week if part-time or as an independent contractor).
  • Notary – Candidates must be able to apply and qualify for a notary license in their state of domicile and have no criminal record or convictions.
  • Candidates must be US citizens or a green card holder and have a high school diploma or GED to qualify for a scholarship.
  • Candidates must agree to limited background checks, similar to those conducted by potential employers.

If you're interested, please Apply ASAP - we're eager to hear from you!

jobs.description:
Graphite Financial is a growing boutique finance, accounting, tax, and strategy firm (www.graphitefinancial.com) built to help startup and high-growth companies scale efficiently and sustainably. Graphite Financial is redefining the “finance department” for early-stage companies and VC-backed startups. We deliver high-caliber accounting and finance leadership and support to entrepreneurs and management teams building scalable, high-growth companies. Our clients are actively managing cash burn, measuring performance, reporting to investors, making capital allocation decisions, and preparing for fundraising. All of that takes expertise and time that founders don’t have and can’t afford to hire for. Graphite bridges the gap with flexible, fixed-fee support packages that provide fractional leadership and operational support from CFOs, Controllers, FP&A Managers, and Tax leaders.

ROLE PURPOSE

Ensure high-quality, consistent client delivery across an assigned team of CPG-focused Client Leads and staff by enabling, coaching, and coordinating their work. The Accounting Senior Manager — CPG Team Lead is accountable for team effectiveness across a portfolio of consumer packaged goods clients — not just individual client outcomes. This role requires both delivery leadership and people leadership, and carries formal responsibilities for performance reviews, career coaching, and development planning.

CPG is a demanding vertical. Clients in this space deal with trade promotion complexity, multi-channel revenue structures, inventory and landed cost challenges, and margin pressure that requires precision at every level. The Team Lead must be fluent enough in CPG accounting to coach Client Leads through these challenges credibly — and to recognize quality work product when they review it.

WHAT IT TAKES TO SUCCEED HERE

This is a fully remote leadership role within a client-facing professional services firm. You lead a team of Accounting Managers (Client Leads), Senior Associates, and Associates serving CPG clients who expect Graphite-quality accounting every month. The following qualities define what high performance looks like at this level.

•CPG Accounting Fluency: You understand CPG accounting at a practitioner level — trade spend, deductions, landed cost, inventory reconciliation, gross-to-net revenue across channels. You do not need to prepare every reconciliation yourself, but you need to review one and know immediately whether it is right.

•Leadership Without Proximity: You set clear expectations, provide consistent coaching, and hold your team accountable — entirely through remote communication and structured operating rhythms. Your presence is felt through the quality of what your team produces.

•Client Credibility: You maintain the technical depth and professional presence to engage senior CPG client contacts directly when needed. Your team’s standards reflect yours — invest in both.

•Coaching Over Fixing: Your job is to make Client Leads better — not to do their work for them. When something goes wrong on a CPG engagement, your first instinct is to coach, not to take over.

•Responsiveness at Scale: You model the responsiveness you expect from your team. Delayed decisions and slow escalations create client risk in a fast-moving industry. Move fast, communicate clearly, and resolve things.

•Accountability for Team Outcomes: You own what your team delivers across the CPG portfolio. You do not deflect to process or capacity. You identify problems early and solve them.

•Professional Standards Enforcement: You hold Client Leads and Associates to a high bar for written communication, client interaction, and deliverable quality. This is not optional in a remote, client-facing environment.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Team Enablement & Oversight

•Coach Client Leads on solution design, client management, delivery approach, and professional judgment across CPG engagements

•Review CPG client engagement approaches for technical risk, complexity — particularly around trade promotion accounting, inventory, and multi-channel revenue — or inconsistency with firm standards

•Serve as the first escalation point for delivery challenges, CPG-specific technical questions, and team capacity problems

•Ensure all work produced by the team meets Graphite’s quality standards before it reaches clients

People Leadership

•Conduct formal performance reviews and ongoing career development conversations with direct reports

•Identify CPG accounting capability gaps within the team and address them through coaching, targeted training, or resourcing decisions

•Build a team environment where Client Leads operate with confidence and accountability, not dependency

Capacity & Quality Management

•Balance workload across Client Leads and adjust resourcing to manage close peaks, seasonal CPG demand cycles, and coverage risks

•Drive execution consistency across the CPG client portfolio without creating bureaucratic overhead

•Ensure no CPG client engagement is a single point of failure — cross-training and documentation are standing expectations

Client Execution (Selective)

•Maintain a purposefully limited personal CPG - focused client book

•Use direct client execution to stay current on CPG accounting complexity, model the standards you set for your team, and remain credible as a coach and escalation resource

Cross-Team Coordination

•Partner with Standards and Technology teams to translate firm-wide standards into practical, CPG-ready execution within your team

•Surface recurring CPG delivery issues, client patterns, and improvement opportunities to the Director proactively

CLIENT INTERACTION

•Not a primary client contact in the standard operating model

•Engages directly with CPG clients during escalations, complex onboarding, or when providing real-time coaching to Client Leads on high-stakes situations

•Maintains the professional presence, CPG industry fluency, and technical credibility to represent Graphite confidently in any senior client conversation

QUALIFICATIONS

•Bachelor’s degree in Accounting required; CPA required

•7–10 years of accounting experience including at least 2 years in a client lead, manager, or team leadership role; public accounting (Manager level) or outsourced accounting leadership experience strongly preferred

•Demonstrated CPG accounting experience — this is a firm requirement. Candidates must be able to speak specifically to trade promotion accounting, inventory reconciliation, landed cost, and multi-channel COGS in a CPG context

•Familiarity with CPG-specific platforms and operational systems including QuickBooks Online, NetSuite, Cin7, Shopify, and 3PL management systems preferred

•Deep working knowledge of GAAP with direct experience navigating startup-specific accounting complexity: SAFEs, convertible instruments, ASC 606, equity compensation, and more

•Demonstrated ability to manage a team and a client portfolio simultaneously without sacrificing quality on either

•Strong coaching and feedback skills — you have developed junior accounting professionals before and take that responsibility seriously

•Excellent written and verbal communication skills; executive presence in client-facing situations

•Experience working in a remote professional services environment is strongly preferred

Comprehensive Benefits & Perks:

  • Health & Wellness: Competitive Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage. 100% of the employee's health insurance premium is covered by the company.
  • Financial Security: Company-paid Short-Term and Long-Term Disability insurance.
  • Work/Life Balance To Include: Generous Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO), 11 Paid Company Holidays, and comprehensive Paid Parental Leave.
  • Remote Work Setup: Fully remote position with company-provided technology equipment and a $250 technology stipend to support your ideal home office setup.
  • 401k: With a company match

jobs.title: Principal Identity Engineer
jobs.excerpt: What are we building? Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world.
jobs.description:
What are we building?

Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. We’re building a team that resonates passion for learning, operating, and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We care about each customer interaction, experience, behavior, and insight and strive to ensure we’re always acting authentically.

Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We’re taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space - ready to join us?

What's the Position?

Identity is the control plane of modern security. In a Zero Trust world, every access decision — for every employee, every administrator, and every machine — flows through the identity systems you will own. We're looking for a Principal Identity Engineer to be the technical authority on how Hard Rock Digital decides who (and what) can access which systems, when, and under what conditions.

This is a deliberately senior, high-trust role — one of three Principal openings reporting directly to our VP Security / CISO — because identity is not a slice of our security program; it is the backbone the rest of it is built on.

You'll be our first dedicated identity hire, inside a 16-person security organization spanning Security Operations, Risk Management, and Architecture & Engineering. Day-to-day provisioning and helpdesk sit with our IT team; your job is architecture, automation, and governance that make access safe.

If you think in terms of blast radius, least privilege, and phishing-resistant authentication — and you like owning a domain end to end rather than a corner of it — you'll feel at home here.

What You'll Do

Identity & Access Architecture

  • Own the security architecture, standards, authentication methods, and roadmap for Microsoft Entra ID, our primary identity provider — partnering with IT on tenant operations

  • Design and continuously refine Conditional Access policies that balance strong protection with a smooth experience for a globally distributed workforce

  • Advance our rollout of phishing-resistant, passwordless authentication (passkeys, certificate-based, FIDO2)

  • Own federation and single sign-on across our SaaS estate (SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM provisioning)

Privileged & Just-in-Time Access

  • Own our privileged access model using Microsoft Entra PIM — separate admin identities, just-in-time elevation, and approval workflows

  • Design and maintain break-glass procedures and safeguards for our most sensitive administrative paths

  • Reduce standing privilege across the environment and make "least privilege, just in time" the default

Identity Lifecycle & Access Governance

  • Automate the joiner-mover-leaver lifecycle so access is granted, changed, and revoked accurately and promptly

  • Build and run access reviews and entitlement governance, partnering with our GRC team on audit evidence (ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, GLI-19/GLI-33)

  • Make access decisions auditable, explainable, and continuously right sized

Non-Human & Workload Identity

  • Govern service principles, managed identities, and workload/federated credentials across AWS, Azure, and GCP

  • Partner on secrets governance across our secrets management platforms to shrink the number of long-lived, standing secrets

  • Partner with our Principal Cloud & Network Security Engineer, who owns service-to-service authentication (mTLS, service mesh)

Zero Trust Strategy

  • Serve as the identity authority for our Zero Trust program, aligned to NIST SP 800-207 and the CISA Zero Trust Maturity Model (Identity pillar)

  • Partner with our cloud and network security function on identity-aware access through Cloudflare Access

  • Partner with Security Operations to make identity signals (risky sign-ins, privileged elevation, MFA anomalies) first-class inputs to detection and response

  • Advise on customer identity (CIAM) and account-security architecture — partnering with our Principal Product Security Engineer, who owns the application security of player-facing account flows, and with product engineering

  • This is a big charter by design — year one is about sequencing. You'll set the identity roadmap with the CISO, with leadership backing to execute against it. Our 24/7 Security Operations team owns monitoring; you'll be the escalation point for identity-related incidents.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years in identity and access management, security engineering, or a closely related field — or equivalent practical experience

  • Deep, hands-on expertise with a modern enterprise identity platform — Conditional Access, PIM/PAM, authentication methods, and identity governance (we run Microsoft Entra ID)

  • Strong command of identity protocols and patterns: SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM, and modern MFA

  • Experience automating the identity lifecycle and integrating identity across a large SaaS and multi-cloud estate

  • Scripting and automation skills (PowerShell, Microsoft Graph API, Python) and comfort with Infrastructure as Code

  • A track record of designing least privilege, just-in-time access in a real production environment

  • Excellent written and verbal communication — you can explain an access decision to an engineer and a risk to an executive

  • Fluency with AI — you lead with it, reaching for AI tools daily to work faster and sharper; hands-on experience applying AI to security or engineering work is a must.

  • You don't need to tick every box. If you're deep in workforce identity but still growing into workload identity — or the reverse — we want to hear from you.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in a regulated industry (gaming, financial services, healthcare)

  • Exposure to customer/player identity (CIAM) and KYC providers

  • Passwordless or phishing-resistant MFA rollouts at scale

  • Familiarity with Identity Threat Detection & Response (ITDR)

  • Relevant certifications (e.g., Microsoft Identity & Access Administrator, CISSP)

Who You Are

  • Strategic and hands-on — you set direction and you build the thing

  • Fiercely focused - zero in on the control that matters most and finishes strong

  • Deeply curious — you test assumptions and keep learning as the identity landscape shifts

  • Customer obsessed about access — you treat login friction as a security outcome and design controls people don't have to fight

  • A clear communicator who builds trust across security, IT, engineering, and leadership

Why This Role Is Different

At most companies, identity is a queue of tickets buried inside an infrastructure team. Here it’s the backbone of our Zero Trust program: you set the strategy, you build the controls, and you answer directly to the CISO. If you've been waiting for identity to be treated as the strategic function it deserves to be, this is that role.

This is one of three Principal openings reporting to our VP Security / CISO: Identity (who and what gets access), Cloud & Network Security (where workloads run and how traffic moves), and Product Security (the code and its vulnerabilities). Apply to the one that sounds like your Tuesday.

What’s in it for you?

We offer our employees more than just competitive compensation. Our team benefits include:

  • Competitive pay and benefits

  • Flexible vacation allowance

  • A hybrid / remote working environment

  • Startup culture backed by a secure, global brand

Roster of Uniques

We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us, and trust and empower our staff to own and drive their experience. Our vision for our business and customers is built on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where regardless of background or beliefs you feel able to be authentic and bring all your talent into play. We want to celebrate you being you (we are an equal opportunity employer).

jobs.title: Technical Operations Engineer (Voice & Integrations)
jobs.excerpt: Vozy es el sistema para resoluciones de cliente — la plataforma donde los agentes de IA y los equipos humanos comparten memoria, gobernanza y resuelven como uno.
jobs.description:
Vozy es el sistema para resoluciones de cliente — la plataforma donde los agentes de IA y los equipos humanos comparten memoria, gobernanza y resuelven como uno. Diseñado para transformar la experiencia al cliente con agentes de IA.

Somos un equipo diverso y talentoso distribuido en varios países, y estamos buscando un Technical Operations Engineerpara sumarse al area Customer & Product Success (CPS), el dominio donde la tecnología se encuentra con el cliente y donde Lili y el equipo humano resuelven como uno.

Misión del Rol

Garantizar que la infraestructura técnica del lado del cliente funcione (telefonía, conectividad, integraciones, activaciones) y ser el puente de resolución técnica entre CPS y Platform.
Este rol resuelve los problemas que no son del agente conversacional ni de la plataforma core, sino de la capa intermedia que conecta a Vozy con el cliente. Sin este trabajo, los agentes que despliegan los FDEs simplemente no llegan al usuario final.

Lo que harás en:

1. Telefonía y conectividad

  • Configurar, migrar y sostener troncales SIP de clientes y de Vozy: esquemas de carrier global, carrier por cuenta, troncales por Internet y por VPN.
  • Diagnosticar fallas de marcación y de audio con trazas SIP y capturas de paquetes: rechazos por código 480, congestión de circuito, timeouts de timbrado, transferencias sin respuesta, invites duplicados sobre una misma llamada, audio que llega degradado desde el carrier.
  • Gestionar DIDs, prefijos, enmascaramiento y matrices de enrutamiento por país, y validar por qué ruta entra el tráfico antes de configurar.
  • Interlocutor directamente con carriers y con los equipos de telefonía de los clientes hasta el cierre del caso, con evidencia técnica en la mano.
  • Sostener pruebas de telefonía en ventanas acordadas con cliente, incluyendo pruebas por país, numeración local y reversión de troncal al terminar.

2. Activaciones e integraciones

  • Ejecutar la activación técnica de clientes nuevos: troncal SIP, conectividad, VPN, listas de IP, webhooks, SFTP y buckets de almacenamiento.
  • Provisionar y migrar canales de mensajería: creación de cuenta con el proveedor de WhatsApp Business API, conexión con el Business Manager del cliente, onboarding de números y validación de saldo y estado de cuenta.
  • Validar integraciones con las centrales telefónicas y contact centers del cliente, y armar la lista de chequeo de requisitos técnicos antes de cada integración.

3. Soporte y escalamiento

  • Ser el primer punto de escalación técnica para FDEs y clientes en temas de telefonía e integraciones.
  • Triage de tickets: exigir la información mínima (identificador de sesión, cuenta, agente, campaña, fecha y hora, evidencia) antes de investigar, y devolver lo que llegue incompleto.
  • Escalar a Platform e infraestructura con contexto y propuesta, nunca con un "algo no funciona": qué falla, en qué cuenta, qué se descartó y cuál es la hipótesis.
  • Sostener la operación durante incidentes que afectan a varias cuentas a la vez, coordinando comunicación con FDEs y liderazgo.

4. Monitoreo y prevención

  • Construir y operar monitoreo proactivo de la capa técnica: tableros de llamadas rechazadas por cuenta, estado de troncales, saldo de canales, salud de los flujos.
  • Anticipar problemas recurrentes y proponer solución preventiva. Hoy varios incidentes se detectan porque el cliente los reporta, no por alerta propia. Cerrar esa brecha es parte del rol.
  • Automatizar detección y respuesta a degradación, no solo alertar.

5. Documentación y formación

  • Mantener runbooks de soporte técnico y activaciones para los escenarios más comunes.
  • Entrenar a FDEs en troubleshooting básico de telefonía e integraciones, con sesiones prácticas sobre casos reales.
  • Documentar patrones de problema y solución reutilizables, incluyendo el inventario de carriers y rutas como fuente única.

Qué se espera en los primeros meses

  • 30 días. Accesos completos y autonomía en diagnóstico de primer nivel: leer una traza SIP, identificar en qué tramo se rompe la llamada y decir si es de Vozy, del carrier o del cliente. Conocer el mapa de escalamiento y los canales internos.
  • 60 días. Atender tickets de telefonía e integraciones de punta a punta sin acompañamiento, ejecutar activaciones de clientes nuevos y sostener turnos de cobertura alternos.
  • 90 días. Tomar propiedad de al menos un frente completo (por ejemplo monitoreo proactivo o metodología de activaciones), con runbook publicado y adoptado por los FDEs.

Perfil requerido:

1. Obligatorio

  • Dos a cuatro años en operación de voz sobre IP, telecomunicaciones o soporte técnico de plataformas de comunicaciones.
  • SIP a nivel de protocolo: códigos de respuesta, negociación de medios, RTP, y lectura de trazas y capturas de paquetes.
  • Experiencia operando softswitches o plataformas de conmutación de voz en producción.
  • Conectividad y redes: VPN sitio a sitio, listas de IP, firewalls, NAT, DNS.
  • Integraciones de aplicación: APIs REST, webhooks, SFTP, clientes de prueba de API, lectura de logs.
  • Manejo de herramienta de tickets y disciplina de documentación.
  • Español nativo e inglés de lectura técnica.
  • Relación directa con clientes corporativos y con proveedores de telefonía: capacidad de sostener una conversación técnica firme y amable, sin culpar al cliente y sin aceptar diagnósticos sin evidencia.

2. Deseable

  • Experiencia en contact center, CPaaS, CCaaS o proveedores de telefonía en LATAM.
  • Canales de mensajería: WhatsApp Business API y administración de Business Manager.
  • Observabilidad: tableros de métricas y consultas sobre logs.
  • Scripting en Python o Bash para automatizar validaciones y capturas.
  • Exposición a agentes conversacionales o IA de voz: entender latencia, transcripción, detección de buzón y calidad de audio como variables del negocio, no como caja negra.

3. Madurez en IA (requisito bloqueante)

Nivel esperado: AI Integrated. La persona debe entender la capa de IA lo suficiente para diagnosticar en producción, distinguir un problema de infraestructura de uno del modelo o del diseño del agente, y usar IA para construir y automatizar parte de su propia carga de trabajo.

Competencias que definen el buen desempeño

  • Diagnóstico con evidencia. Nada se afirma sin traza, captura o tablero que lo sostenga. En los casos más ruidosos el valor está en demostrar con datos cuándo el corte viene de la infraestructura del propio cliente.
  • Proactividad sobre reactividad. Revisar todos los escenarios posibles y descartar causas antes de escalar.
  • No asumir lo que el cliente quiere. Aterrizar el requerimiento real antes de ejecutar.
  • Servicio al equipo de al lado. El FDE que atiende la cuenta debe quedar con contexto suficiente para hablar con su cliente.
  • Operación en paralelo. Sostener varias activaciones e incidentes simultáneos sin degradar tiempos de respuesta.
  • Criterio de escalamiento. Saber cuándo el caso ya no avanza y hay que subirlo, con el contexto completo.

Indicadores del rol

  • Tiempo de resolución de tickets técnicos de telefonía e integraciones.
  • Porcentaje de casos resueltos sin escalar a Platform.
  • Tiempo de activación técnica de un cliente nuevo, desde el acuerdo hasta la primera llamada en producción.
  • Porcentaje de incidentes detectados por monitoreo propio antes del reporte del cliente.
  • Disponibilidad efectiva de troncales e integraciones de las cuentas activas.
  • Cobertura: días al mes en que la operación técnica puede sostenerse sin la persona titular del frente.

Contexto de la operación

  • CPS opera con modelo de Forward Deployed Engineers, con tres FDE Leaders y cerca de 55 a 60 cuentas enterprise activas en LATAM.
  • El frente técnico atiende cuentas de banca, seguros, telecomunicaciones, retail, utilities y cooperativas de crédito en México, Centroamérica, Colombia, Perú y Bolivia.
  • Interlocutores internos frecuentes: Platform e infraestructura, FDE Leaders y el equipo de soporte.
  • Rituales donde participa el rol: Planning semanal de CPS, All Hands CPS, Daily CPS, war rooms de salud de cuentas y sesiones técnicas con clientes.

Cultura Vozy

En Vozy, la transparencia no es solo una palabra de moda — es nuestra forma de hacer las cosas. Mantenemos la información fluyendo de manera abierta y honesta, para que todos estemos en la misma página. Somos un equipo 100% remoto; nuestras herramientas async te permiten gestionar tu tiempo de la mejor manera para ti, mientras que nuestras reuniones en vivo son para conectar, decidir y avanzar juntos. Nos movemos con nuestros valores: Compromiso , Compasión , Innovación y Amor .

Lo que ofrecemos

  • Trabajo 100% remoto.
  • Día libre de cumpleaños.
  • Vacaciones Ilimitadas
  • La oportunidad de tener impacto real en clientes desde el primer día, en un entorno técnico y colaborativo, con una ruta de crecimiento clara hacia la banda Driver.

¿Crees que no cumples con todos los requisitos? En Vozy valoramos el potencial tanto como la experiencia. Si te apasiona lo que haces y tienes ganas de crecer, postúlate de todos modos — ¡podrías ser justo lo que buscamos!

Title/Role: Software Developer
Division: Technology Operations
Location: Remote, reporting to New York City
Reporting to: Vice President

Position Summary
We’re looking for a Ruby on Rails Developer to help improve an early-stage Business Process Management (BPM) product. The ideal candidate is a dedicated Ruby developer with strong design skills who enjoys working in an early-stage product environment and understands what that entails. At times, they will be given a fully developed design specification; at other times, they will need to communicate with non-technical users, identify product requirements, and create the design specification themselves. This role requires comfort implementing modern UI/UX experiences using full-stack Rails, including a Rails backend and Stimulus/Turbo front end.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop the future of BPM software in a tight knit team that has been developing for 2+ years, has acquired 100~ daily active users, and aims to expand our userbase exponentially.
  • Implement new features end-to-end in Rails / Stimulus / Turbo.
  • Communicate with non-technical users to surface product requirements and then create a feature spec.
  • Iterate on existing features until the product feels both elegant and easy to use.
  • Implement and support SSO, Active Directory, SAML, OAuth, and dynamic user provisioning.
  • Develop document-centric features, including PDF generation, editing, and workflow integration.
  • Integrate AI capabilities into customer-facing products and internal development processes.

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years of Full Stack software development experience.
  • 2+ years or more of Ruby on Rails experience.
  • Mid-level (or greater) design proficiency.
  • Someone comfortable working in an early-stage environment with frequently changing product requirements.
  • Experience building enterprise-scale applications and workflow-driven systems.
  • Hands-on experience with Active Directory, SSO, identity management, and enterprise security models.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar.
  • Has worked within a structured Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) Policy.

Nice to Have

  • Early-stage startup experience
  • Experience with SaaS products that had a large amount of daily active users
  • Experience building with Stimulus / Turbo
  • Cyber Security Certifications

Advantages of Working at E-J

  • Leading Electrical Contracting Organization Nationwide
  • Oldest Family-Owned and Operated Electric Contractor since 1899
  • Job training and mentorship
  • Competitive compensation packages
  • Comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, and 401K plan
  • Paid holidays and vacation
  • Merit-Based Bonus
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program 

Salary Range: $110,000 – $140,000/year, based on experience

jobs.excerpt: The Manager, Development leads the strategic direction and operational execution of multiple software development teams, typically managing a one-to-three-year roadmap horizon.
jobs.description:
The Manager, Development leads the strategic direction and operational execution of multiple software development teams, typically managing a one-to-three-year roadmap horizon. In this role, you collaborate closely with cross-functional partners to deliver critical software initiatives, ensuring continuous alignment with organizational objectives. You actively foster team development, optimize productivity, and promote an agile, collaborative environment. Through strategic leadership and effective communication, you drive technical excellence, innovation, and a culture of continuous improvement. You lead AI-First teams, where AI agents are the default way work is planned, built, tested, and reviewed, and you are accountable for doing so with the verification, governance, and measurement discipline our regulated environment requires.

Job Responsibilities

  • Team Leadership & Management: Attracts, hires, coaches, and retains high-performing software development engineers, actively developing personalized career plans that include AI fluency progression, and promptly addressing performance issues.
  • Accountable Delivery: Effectively plans, manages, and leads the delivery of roadmap items, including product and modernization initiatives, leveraging AI-driven workflows to compress cycle time while holding quality and reliability constant.
  • Organizational Alignment: Maintains a 360-degree alignment between product roadmap, architectural strategy, and software development processes to ensure the delivery of value-generating software solutions.
  • Collaboration: Works proactively with cross-functional partners (product management, architecture, QA, operations) to clearly define strategic goals and maintain transparency in planning, execution, and delivery.
  • Architecture & Technology Strategy: Actively contributes to shaping and evolving the architectural and development strategies, aligning closely with product roadmaps, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and quality.
  • Quality and Continuous Improvement: Promotes a culture of quality and continuous improvement by implementing Agile and Lean Development methodologies in collaboration with cross-functional partners, fostering a shift-left mindset, holding AI-generated code to the same test coverage, review, and security standards as human-authored code, and ensuring consistent developer engagement and productivity improvements.
  • Customer Experience: Delivers excellent customer experiences by ensuring high-quality, reliable software products.
  • Scalability: Participates in defining architectural direction and development strategies to ensure scalable and maintainable software solutions.
  • Security: Provides leadership in application security remediation activities and mentors on implementing security remediation and secure programming practices; ensures secure use of AI tooling, including approved tools only, least-privilege agent permissions, no sensitive or customer data in unapproved systems, and a full audit trail for agent-made changes.
  • Technical Contribution: Contributes technically when needed, including directing and reviewing agentic work, and maintains strong hands-on engagement with the team’s AI toolchain to support the team and organizational outcomes.
  • Technology Innovation: Actively contributes to evolving the organization's core technology stack through innovative adoption and enhancement of cloud, web, mobile, microservices, big data, and API-enabled platforms.
  • AI-First Delivery: Establishes AI-assisted development as the team’s default operating model, with spec-driven intent, agent-executed implementation, and human-verified outcomes, and measurably raises the team’s AI maturity each quarter by tracking utilization, cycle-time impact, and cost per delivered outcome.
  • AI-Enabled Product Delivery: Partners with Product and Architecture to identify, scope, and ship AI-powered capabilities in our products, applying guardrails for accuracy, explainability, data privacy, and model risk.
  • Responsible AI & Governance: Ensures team adherence to the organization’s AI stance and enterprise risk expectations, including approved tools, permission tiers, human-in-the-loop gates, and provenance for agent-involved changes, and holds engineers accountable for reviewing every AI-generated change for intent, risk, and correctness.
  • AI Capability Building: Coaches engineers from AI-assisted coding toward directing agents, developing skills in decomposition, specification, context engineering, and verification; owns the team’s version-controlled AI context assets (agent instructions, skills, prompts, and configurations); and develops champions to accelerate peer adoption.
  • Talent Pipeline: Actively invests in co-op programs and consistently identifies, cultivates, and converts suitable candidates into full-time software engineers.

Requirements

  • B.S. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 5+ years of software development experience, demonstrating strong proficiency in software engineering.
  • Proven track record in technical leadership roles, with 1+ years managing and leading engineering teams.
  • Extensive hands-on experience in software engineering practices and successfully leading engineering teams to deliver impactful outcomes.
  • Strong expertise working within Agile/Lean environments, including practical experience with common Agile/Lean frameworks (e.g., Scrum, Kanban).
  • Demonstrated ability to attract, hire, develop, and retain high-quality technical talent, including experience managing globally distributed or remote engineering teams.
  • Exceptional communication skills, capable of clearly conveying technical information and strategies to diverse stakeholders.
  • Hands-on experience using AI coding agents in production software delivery, including spec-driven delegation and review of agent-generated changes.
  • Demonstrated experience leading a team through AI tooling adoption, including changes to workflow, review practices, and definition of done.
  • Working understanding of AI risk in regulated environments, including data handling, model limitations, auditability, and human oversight requirements.

Skills

  • Stay Current: Continuously monitors and adopts emerging software development trends, technologies, and best practices to maintain competitive advantage, with particular attention to AI development tooling and agentic workflows.
  • Value-Oriented: Ensures all development initiatives clearly deliver measurable value to the organization and align with strategic objectives, including quantifying the return on AI investment in the team’s delivery.
  • Team Organization: Skilled in organizational design, effectively structuring teams for optimal performance, execution of priorities, and balanced decision-making that benefits the entire organization.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Proven ability to coordinate and align engineering, product management, and architecture efforts to ensure cohesive and strategic outcomes.
  • Team Motivation & Clarity: Leads engaging and productive team meetings, consistently providing clarity, context, and motivation to drive high performance and morale.
  • Proactive Initiative: Demonstrates initiative by proactively identifying and addressing additional responsibilities that positively impact both engineering outcomes and overall business success.
  • Effective Communication: Clearly articulates technical strategies, project statuses, and updates across diverse settings, including Agile ceremonies, ensuring messages resonate with varied audiences.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Actively shares relevant information with stakeholders, ensuring transparency, informed alignment, and collaborative decision-making.
  • Decision-Making Acumen: Balances detailed insights with a strategic viewpoint, consulting appropriate stakeholders to make informed decisions that reflect organizational priorities.
  • Sustainable Growth Mindset: Fosters an environment where results are achieved without compromising long-term growth, employee retention, or psychological safety.
  • Change Management: Serves as a stabilizing and calming presence, effectively guiding teams through periods of change and uncertainty, including the shift from authoring code to directing agents.
  • AI Judgment: Knows when AI accelerates work and when it introduces unacceptable risk; sets clear team norms for where agent autonomy ends and human decision begins.
  • Context Engineering: Understands how to give AI systems the right internal context, including codebase, documentation, and standards, to produce reliable output, and drives the team to build and maintain those assets.
  • Experimentation Discipline: Runs structured pilots of new AI capabilities with defined hypotheses, success measures, and rollback paths rather than ad hoc tool adoption.
  • Positive Culture Champion: Actively promotes and cultivates a positive, inclusive, and collaborative work environment.

The salary range for this position is $151,00 - $194,000; commensurate salary to be determined based on skills, professional background and expertise. This position is also eligible, pursuant to applicable eMoney policies, for the annual bonus program, retirement contributions, health insurance, sick leave, parental leave and paid time off

At eMoney, we’re powering what’s possible in financial planning. Our mission is to help people talk about money and make more informed financial decisions. Through our comprehensive financial planning solutions, we help advisors bring clarity to complex decisions and deliver more personalized guidance.

Today, eMoney supports more than 138,000 financial professionals who guide the financial lives of over 7 million end clients. That reach gives every member of our team the opportunity to contribute to work that makes a meaningful, lasting impact.

We’re equally committed to powering what’s possible for our people. We foster an inclusive, people-first culture where diverse perspectives are valued, innovation is encouraged, and employees are supported in doing their best work.

eMoney is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

Our customers have invested heavily in platforms like Snowflake. They understand what they need to build, but face complex challenges in data discovery, data governance, and data access. Drive New Business: Identify, qualify, and pursue new sales opportunities within target accounts. You will own the entire sales cycle, from initial engagement and needs analysis to solution presentations and contract negotiations.

Become a Trusted Advisor: Cultivate lasting relationships with key decision-makers. You will develop a deep understanding of client needs and position Revelate's Data Monetization solutions as the definitive key to achieving their business objectives.
