We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

Hybrid in Berlin or London

We’re looking for a Growth Product Manager

Own the systems that decide which German businesses iwoca reaches, and the journey they take from first click to submitted loan application. You’ll join a team that is still being built, with a data scientist in place and engineers being hired in parallel. A good fit if you like working from first principles, and would rather run an experiment than win an argument.

The team

The DE Acquisition Tech team builds the systems behind how German businesses discover iwoca and apply for funding: the models that decide which businesses to approach, the eligibility checks that tell a business early whether iwoca can help, and the signup flow itself. Product, analytics, data science and engineering sit in the same squad by design, so the team can go from hypothesis to shipped change without waiting on anyone else. The German marketing and sales teams depend on this work: the team’s models decide who they contact, and its journeys decide how many of those businesses convert.

The team is being built right now. It currently includes a data scientist, and we’re hiring engineers in parallel – so you would join early enough to shape how the team operates.

The role

This role sits between iwoca’s German commercial teams – marketing, sales and commercial strategy – and the technical squad that builds for them. Reporting into the Head of Direct Acquisition, you will own acquisition and activation outcomes for the German market: finding the opportunities, defining the hypotheses, and working with engineering, data, marketing and sales to build, test and iterate.

The scope is broad. We’re not looking for someone with deep expertise in every domain the team covers – spanning product development, analytics, UX and data science – but rather someone intellectually curious, and skilled at asking the right questions.

Own the funnel from first visit to application

  • Own every step of that journey, including the signup flow itself and the eligibility checks inside it.

  • Set the roadmap for acquisition and the signup journey, and decide what the squad builds next.

  • Own the scoring and segmentation that decides where marketing spends and who sales calls first.

Build with your technical squad

  • Ship lead scoring systems, eligibility checkers and signup flows with the team’s data scientist and the engineers we’re hiring.

  • Rework website content, signup flows and decisioning logic with marketing and sales, to convert more of the businesses that already reach iwoca.

  • Strip friction out of the signup journey, so that applying for funding takes minutes rather than an afternoon.

Be the first call when the numbers look wrong

  • Act as the technical partner for German marketing, sales and channel management on attribution, tracking and data pipeline problems.

  • Investigate and resolve data quality issues – broken dashboards, misattributed traffic, unexplained volume changes – often at short notice.

  • Give channel managers access to, and guidance on, the attribution logic behind their numbers.

  • Keep the tracking and attribution systems trustworthy, so every decision downstream rests on numbers the team believes.

Run the experiments that decide what ships

  • Design, run and interpret A/B tests across messaging, targeting, eligibility checks and signup flows.

  • Find opportunities from first principles, backed by data, customer research and funnel analysis.

Shape how a new team works

  • Direct the squad’s work day to day: brief the data scientist and engineers, set priorities, and turn their models into shipped products.

  • Define the priorities, roles and rituals of a team that is still being built.

  • Lead cross-functional initiatives with marketing and sales, aligning them with engineering and data on shared goals, hypotheses and success metrics.

  • Turn the commercial strategy team’s goals into testable hypotheses and briefs the squad can act on.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Experience as a product manager, growth product manager, or in a role with clear ownership of product-led growth outcomes.

  • Strong analytical capability and experience with experimentation frameworks and A/B testing tools.

  • Hands-on experience with tracking and attribution setups, such as Amplitude, GA4, GTM, server-side tagging or conversion feedback into ad platforms.

Bonus:

  • Knowledge of the German SME ecosystem or B2B financial products.

The salary

We expect to pay from £60,000 - £80,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

Job Summary

The role is responsible for analyzing customer and telecommunications data—including revenue, provisioning, ordering, billing, and contract information—to identify billing discrepancies and opportunities where the client may be under-billing its customers. The position requires a strong understanding of telecommunications products, services, ordering and provisioning processes, and billing practices, combined with strong analytical and technical skills. Identified under-billing opportunities must be analyzed, validated, and quantified, and then corrected in collaboration with the client.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform Revenue Assurance audits for assigned telecommunications clients to identify billing inaccuracies, revenue leakage, and under-billing opportunities.

  • Analyze and reconcile multiple data sources, including customer revenue, billing, provisioning, ordering, invoice, and contract data.

  • Apply analytical techniques, including anomaly detection, trend analysis, contract analysis, order-to-bill analysis, and invoice validation, to identify potential billing discrepancies.

  • Use knowledge of telecommunications products, services, network services, ordering processes, provisioning, and billing to determine whether identified discrepancies represent actual revenue leakage or under-billing.

  • Validate identified billing issues by researching customer contracts, orders, provisioning records, invoices, and applicable billing rules.

  • Work collaboratively with client teams to correct inaccurate billing through the client's ordering and billing processes.

  • Track identified opportunities, corrections, and financial results through client portals and internal tracking dashboards.

  • Monitor the status of identified revenue assurance opportunities and follow through to ensure corrections are implemented and reflected in billing.

  • Prepare and provide analytical reports, findings, and supporting information in response to internal and client requests.

  • Meet established internal and client performance, productivity, and revenue recovery targets, and report progress against those targets.

  • Communicate findings clearly to both technical and business stakeholders, including the ability to explain the financial impact and root cause of billing discrepancies.

Required Skills & Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify patterns, investigate anomalies, and determine root causes.

  • Ability to work with and analyze large and complex datasets from multiple sources.

  • Strong telecommunications industry knowledge, particularly in customer ordering, provisioning, billing, contracts, and revenue processes.

  • Ability to interpret telecommunications contracts, service orders, invoices, and billing records.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify discrepancies across multiple systems and data sources.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including data analysis, reconciliation, filtering, formulas, and reporting.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word and Microsoft Outlook.

Cardinal Education is a premier educational consulting firm based in the San Francisco Bay Area that provides world-class academic coaching, test preparation, and admissions advising. Role Overview

We are seeking an Associate Account Manager to own and manage ongoing relationships with families receiving our educational services. You will serve as the operational and relational hub for each client account, from onboarding through ongoing support, ensuring each family’s experience is seamless, responsive, and high-value.

You’ll work closely with academic coaches, consultants, billing teams, and cross-functional leaders to deliver timely service, address concerns, and retain long-term clients.

jobs.excerpt: Werk volledig remote, ook vanuit het buitenlandBen jij een ervaren Verpleegkundig Specialist GGZ die graag zelfstandig werkt, verantwoordelijkheid neemt en energie krijgt van specialistische GGZ?
jobs.description:
Werk volledig remote, ook vanuit het buitenland

Ben jij een ervaren Verpleegkundig Specialist GGZ die graag zelfstandig werkt, verantwoordelijkheid neemt en energie krijgt van specialistische GGZ? Wil je jouw medische en verpleegkundige expertise inzetten binnen een innovatieve, volledig digitale behandelomgeving, waar kwaliteit, autonomie en samenwerking centraal staan?

Dan is Beterggz mogelijk een mooie volgende stap voor jou.

Wij zoeken een proactieve Verpleegkundig Specialist GGZ voor een nieuwe rol binnen onze organisatie. Een professional die online behandelen serieus neemt, stevig in zijn of haar schoenen staat en ook op afstand hoogwaardige specialistische zorg weet te leveren.

Over Beterggz

Beterggz is een online aanbieder van specialistische GGZ. Wij bieden landelijk poliklinische behandelingen aan cliënten met uiteenlopende en complexe zorgvragen.

Ons team bestaat uit psychologen, artsen, psychiaters, verpleegkundig specialisten en andere betrokken professionals. We werken volledig digitaal, multidisciplinair en met korte lijnen. Onze missie is helder: kwalitatief hoogwaardige GGZ toegankelijker maken, wachtlijsten verkorten en zorg slimmer organiseren.

Omdat wij volledig online werken, maakt het minder uit waar je werkt. Of je nu vanuit Nederland of vanuit het buitenland werkzaam bent, zolang de kwaliteit, continuïteit en professionaliteit gewaarborgd zijn.

Wat ga je doen?

Als online Verpleegkundig Specialist GGZ ben je zelfstandig behandelaar en lever je specialistische zorg aan cliënten binnen de SGGZ. Je voert diagnostiek uit, stelt behandelplannen op, behandelt cliënten en bewaakt de voortgang van het behandelproces.

Je bent regiebehandelaar en werkt nauw samen met psychiaters, psychologen, SPV'ers en andere behandelaren binnen het multidisciplinaire team. Vanuit jouw verpleegkundige én medische expertise lever je een belangrijke bijdrage aan kwalitatief hoogwaardige en veilige zorg.

Daarnaast kun je worden ingezet voor overbruggingszorg, complexe triage en consultatie. Je signaleert risico's, beoordeelt crisissituaties, schrijft waar nodig medicatie voor binnen jouw bevoegdheden en draagt actief bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze digitale zorgverlening.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Zelfstandig behandelen van cliënten binnen de specialistische GGZ.

  • Fungeren als regiebehandelaar.

  • Uitvoeren van diagnostiek en indicatiestelling.

  • Opstellen, uitvoeren en evalueren van behandelplannen.

  • Medicatiebeleid en farmacotherapeutische begeleiding binnen het eigen deskundigheidsgebied.

  • Risicotaxaties, crisisbeoordelingen en crisisinterventies.

  • Complexe triage en consultatie.

  • Overbruggingszorg en wachttijdbegeleiding.

  • Multidisciplinair overleg en afstemming met collega's.

  • Zorgvuldige dossiervoering en rapportage.

  • Coaching en inhoudelijke ondersteuning van collega's waar passend.

  • Actief bijdragen aan kwaliteitsverbetering, innovatie en de verdere ontwikkeling van digitale behandelprocessen.

Omdat dit een nieuwe functie binnen Beterggz is, krijg je bovendien de mogelijkheid om mee te bouwen aan de verdere inrichting en ontwikkeling van deze rol.

Requirements

Wie zoeken wij?

Wij zoeken een zelfstandige en ervaren Verpleegkundig Specialist GGZ met ruime ervaring binnen de specialistische GGZ.

Om deze functie te kunnen vervullen beschik je over:

  • Een afgeronde opleiding HBO-Verpleegkunde.

  • Een afgeronde Master Advanced Nursing Practice (MANP) met uitstroomprofiel GGZ.

  • Een geldige BIG-registratie als Verpleegkundig Specialist.

  • Ervaring als Verpleegkundig Specialist binnen de specialistische GGZ.

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met diagnostiek, behandeling en regiebehandelaarschap.

  • Kennis van psychiatrische ziektebeelden, farmacotherapie, risicotaxatie en crisisinterventie.

Je bent gewend om zelfstandig beslissingen te nemen, werkt zorgvuldig en gestructureerd en voelt je verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit van de zorg die je levert.

Omdat je volledig online werkt, beschik je over eigen apparatuur en een rustige, veilige en professionele thuiswerkplek.

Ervaring met persoonlijkheidsproblematiek, trauma, stemmingsstoornissen, angststoornissen, ADHD en autismespectrumstoornissen binnen de SGGZ is een pre.

Verder:

  • beheers je de Nederlandse taal uitstekend, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk;

  • is beheersing van de Engelse taal een pre;

  • ben je ingeschreven als ZZP'er bij de Kamer van Koophandel;

  • beschik je over een geldige beroeps- en bedrijfsaansprakelijkheidsverzekering;

  • ben je bereid een geldige Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) aan te leveren.

Waarom Beterggz?

Bij Beterggz werk je volledig remote, met veel flexibiliteit in waar en wanneer je werkt. Je kunt dus ook vanuit het buitenland werken, zolang je professioneel bereikbaar bent en kwalitatief hoogwaardige online zorg levert.

Wij werken op basis van een ZZP-overeenkomst met een uurtarief van €110 per uur. Het aantal uren stemmen we in overleg af en starten kan op korte termijn.

Je komt terecht in een snelgroeiende, digitale GGZ-organisatie met korte lijnen, veel vertrouwen en ruimte voor eigen verantwoordelijkheid. Omdat dit een nieuwe functie binnen Beterggz is, krijg je bovendien de kans om actief mee te bouwen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze online zorgverlening en de inrichting van deze rol.

Interesse?

Lijkt het je interessant om als online Verpleegkundig Specialist GGZ bij Beterggz aan de slag te gaan?

Stuur dan je motivatie en CV naar:

Bij voldoende geschikte kandidaten sluiten wij de vacature.

We're looking for a seasoned healthcare collector with the experience and judgment to effectively manage complex, aged, and high-dollar insurance receivables. The ideal candidate can independently manage a high-volume portfolio, identify the root cause of non-payment, determine the appropriate recovery pathway, and escalate accounts appropriately using established payer and industry-standard processes. We're looking for someone who takes end-to-end ownership of assigned revenue, understands how to navigate payer barriers, and consistently moves accounts toward payment or final resolution.

  • Prioritize inventory based on financial exposure, aging, timely filing risk, and recovery opportunity

  • Maintain ownership of assigned inventory through payment or final disposition

What Success Looks Like

The successful collector demonstrates consistent ownership of assigned accounts and applies sound judgment to move claims toward timely resolution. This includes:

  • Conducting thorough claim research to identify the root cause of non-payment or underpayment

  • Selecting the appropriate resolution pathway based on payer requirements, claim status, and established escalation protocols

  • Maintaining complete, concise, and actionable documentation of findings, actions taken, payer responses, and next steps

  • Establishing appropriate follow-up timelines and maintaining consistent ownership through payment or final disposition

  • Balancing productivity, quality, and financial impact while meeting established performance expectations

  • Demonstrating measurable contribution to aged AR reduction, cash recovery, and inventory resolution

What You Bring

How We Measure Success

Success in this role is measured by both productivity and outcomes. Key performance indicators include meaningful claim activity, documentation quality, adherence to follow-up expectations, aged AR reduction, cash recovery, and inventory resolution. Collectors are expected to maintain ownership of assigned accounts from initial assignment through payment or final disposition, while consistently meeting established productivity and quality expectations.

jobs.description:
About the Role

This role owns the full design-make-test-model loop at an early-stage AI-driven protein and peptide engineering company: you will run and improve pocket-conditioned discrete diffusion models for sequence design and personally execute the binding kinetics that close the loop. You will sit on a lean core team reporting directly to the CEO, making this one of the highest-leverage scientific roles at the company.

What You'll Do

  • Improve and extend proprietary diffusion and companion folding models with architectural refinements, new attention heads, and hierarchical reasoning.

  • Operate an ML inference platform at scale and diagnose usage patterns across signups, churn, and customer segments.

  • Own fluid-handling robotics and plate automation (Hamilton, Tecan, Opentrons, or equivalent) and ship reliable, production-ready protocols.

  • Own BLI and SPR end-to-end: assay design, immobilization, regeneration, referencing, dilution series, kinetic fitting, QC, and failure-mode diagnosis.

  • Write detailed cloud-lab protocols and manage internal screening instrumentation.

  • Work the full stack from receptor biology and protein structure through scoring functions to platform outputs that scientists will actually use.

  • Close design loops: take sequences from the platform, run kinetics, update the model, and ship improved sequences.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years building or operating discrete diffusion models, protein language models (such as ESM or ProtT5), or structure prediction systems in a real make-test-model cycle, not academic papers or public fine-tunes.

  • Personally written and debugged liquid-handler protocols on robotic platforms and shipped them to production, not supervised a core facility.

  • Personally fitted BLI or SPR kinetic curves end-to-end and diagnosed failure modes: mass transport, tip avidity, nonspecific binding, aggregation, hook effect, bad referencing.

  • Proficiency coding robot methods and analyzing kinetic data in Python or equivalent scripting.

  • Demonstrated ability to close a full loop: design sequences, synthesize or express, measure kinetics, update the model, iterate.

  • Comfortable treating protein language models and sequence design tools (such as RFdiffusion or BindCraft equivalents) as inputs and outputs, not black boxes.

  • Strong background in biology, biochemistry, or a closely related life-sciences field.

  • Operator mentality: resourceful, action-oriented, comfortable executing at odd hours to have data ready the next day.

  • Background in gene editing, gene therapy, or receptor trafficking is a plus.

  • Prior experience at biotech accelerators or early-stage biotech startups is a plus.

Compensation and Benefits

Initial consulting engagement: $3,000 to $5,000 per month. Full-time conversion: base salary $80,000 to $200,000 depending on profile, with meaningful equity and deal-contingent upside. No visa sponsorship available.

Location

Hybrid in New York, NY. On-site presence will increase once internal screening instrumentation is operational (expected within 3 to 6 months).

jobs.excerpt: Maximus is looking for a Head of Growth & Marketing (VP).
jobs.description:
Maximus is looking for a Head of Growth & Marketing (VP).

Company: Maximus | Location: Remote (US) | Reports to: CEO | Type: Full-time, Executive


About Maximus

Maximus () is a mission-driven consumer performance medicine telehealth company that provides men and women with content, community, and clinical support to optimize their health, wellness, and hormones. Maximus has achieved profitability, 8-figure ARR, and is doubling year over year — with a strong cash position. We have raised $15M from top Silicon Valley VCs such as Founders Fund and 8VC as well as leading angel investors and operators from companies like Bulletproof, Tinder, Coinbase, Daily Stoic, and Shopify.

The Role

We’re hiring a VP of Growth to run the growth engine. The core of the job is high-velocity, highly analytical experiment design: finding new levers that work, across advertising, creative, pricing, and the digital product, and finding them faster than the current ones fatigue. You set the testing agenda and hold the bar on what counts as a good experiment.

The defining requirement is the ability to think in connected customer journeys, not siloed channels: how a persona is defined, how creative and messaging speak to that persona, how that creative shows up differently on Meta versus paid search versus influencers versus affiliates, what landing experience each arrival deserves, and how we ultimately convert and retain that customer. Channel, creative, and site experience are one system — and you own the system.

Two things come with this role that growth leaders almost never get to own. First, the conversion flow: not just the landing page — the entire quiz flow, every step from first click through credit-card entry. Second, pricing: price points, offers, discounts, and plan structure across the portfolio, where there’s enormous leverage waiting for someone with the analytical chops to find it. If you’ve spent your career optimizing ads against a funnel somebody else controlled, this is the opposite of that job.

This is a hands-on job. You’ll inherit a team and an agency roster and reshape both as the strategy requires — hiring where there are gaps, holding the agencies to outcomes. You’ll also spend lots of time in spreadsheets and Ads Manager, and lately in Claude, looking at the nitty-gritty yourself. You’ll report directly to the CEO and hold the senior-most marketing seat in the company. The role is revenue-accountable: you take the company’s revenue target and build the strategy across the product portfolio (Testosterone, Weight Loss, Growth Hormone, and future verticals) to hit it.

What You’ll Own

The experimentation engine: the core of the job. Design and run a high-velocity testing program across advertising, creative, pricing, and the digital product: hypothesis quality, test design, statistical rigor, and the speed from insight to rollout. Build the team’s operating rhythm (planning, budgeting, creative reviews, reporting) around that cadence.

Money allocation, decided by incrementality and LTV. Own where the money goes, and back every allocation with data: incrementality and lifetime value, not last-click ROAS. That means knowing how to measure mid-funnel and upper-funnel activity, how to evaluate discounts analytically, and how LTV differs by product and channel in a business where the LTV math gets complicated. FP&A owns the forecast model; you own the levers inside it — spend, CAC, conversion, LTV by product line — and the results against it.

The conversion flow, end to end. The entire quiz flow through credit-card entry, not just the landing pages in front of it: messaging continuity from ad through intake to purchase, experimentation inside the flow itself in partnership with product and engineering, and the test discipline that keeps the wins real.

Pricing. Price points, coupons, offers, discount architecture, and plan structure across the portfolio, including long-term commitments — and the margin-versus-CAC tradeoff every one of these decisions moves. Discounting here is an analytical problem.

Lifecycle and CRM. Email and SMS as a real growth channel: cart-abandonment recovery, nurture for hesitant buyers, cross-sell across the portfolio, revival of lapsed customers. Run it with the same rigor as paid — experiments, holdouts, measured LTV impact. The customer should never feel a handoff, from ad to quiz or from checkout to inbox.

Persona-driven acquisition, creative, and the channel portfolio. The channel is a persona signal: the research-heavy buyer coming from branded search isn’t the validation-seeker coming from cold social. Define the persona for each channel and let it drive everything downstream. Own paid media, influencers, and affiliates, with enough diversification that no one platform dominates; own creative built for each persona, native to each channel, and judged on funnel outcomes. This is creative as a growth lever, not a brand job.

What You’ll Need

The bar, in one question. Be ready, at any point, to say where the next incremental dollar should go — more Meta spend, a deeper discount, a new quiz branch, an untested channel — and why. “I think it’ll lift the funnel” isn’t an answer; we want the test you’d run, the LTV math behind it, and what you’d cut to fund it.

  • Command of incrementality and LTV: this is what we’re hiring for. You can design the incrementality test and defend the math; you can explain how you’d measure mid-funnel and upper-funnel activity, and how you’d evaluate a discount analytically; and you’ve dealt with a complex-LTV business firsthand — subscription, multi-product, or both.

  • Still hands-on. You get into the weeds yourself (the ad account, the funnel data, the models) and did so this quarter, not three jobs ago.

  • Connected-journey thinking. You can walk a funnel you owned end to end — persona, channel, creative, landing experience, conversion — and explain how each step informed the next.

  • Direct ownership of post-click conversion: landing experiences, quiz- or intake-style funnels, checkout, lifecycle (email and SMS) — with structured experimentation and results to show for it.

  • Pricing and offer experience: you’ve designed pricing, discount, or plan-structure tests and owned the revenue outcome.

  • 10+ years in growth or performance marketing, including 5+ years leading teams, with a track record scaling a DTC subscription business built on a high-consideration product — a premium-priced purchase people research before buying.

  • Ownership of a revenue number, not just a media budget — you built the plan tying spend to revenue and defended it to a CEO or a board.

  • A builder profile: you’ve restructured or built a marketing org, hired senior channel leads, and managed agencies to outcomes.

  • Nice to have: telehealth, regulated health, or wellness experience (health-claim ad policies, compliance-constrained creative), and experience marketing a multi-product portfolio with a distinct buyer per product.


What Success Looks Like

This role moves fast; we expect the engine to be running within the first quarter. Specific targets get set together in your first 30 days.

By month 3: there’s a real testing cadence live across ads, creative, pricing, and the quiz flow; CAC, conversion, and LTV are instrumented by product so we trust the numbers; and you’ve made the first budget reallocations based on measured incrementality.

By month 6: conversion through the full quiz-to-credit-card flow is up; persona-matched journeys are shipping (right creative, right landing experience, right quiz flow for each buyer type); the first pricing wins are banked; and at least one channel beyond Meta has scaled past the test phase.

By month 12 and beyond: you’ve delivered the revenue target, CAC and LTV have both moved the right way, the team and agency roster fit the strategy, and the CEO and board trust your numbers because they hold.

Maximus Offers World-Class Benefits:

  • At-cost employee access (50% off discount) to all Maximus protocols

  • Full Suite Insurance: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance
    Premium Blue Shield Platinum PPO & HMO Health Plans (up to 80% coverage)

  • Best-in-class 401K options

  • Fully remote work. Flexible vacation/time-off policies

  • Extended options exercise window for loyal employees (3 months for every year of service; e.g. 1 year for 4+ year employees)

Data, AI, automation, and marketing technology will support faster research, more relevant personalization, scalable execution, and continuous campaign optimization. Strong human judgment remains essential for translating insights into strategy, evaluating performance, prioritizing opportunities, and determining where investment will have the greatest pipeline impact.

Our client builds the data layer that AI agents run on. One API call turns any URL into clean, structured, LLM-ready data. It's already the default way a huge number of developers pull web data into their AI systems, with over 1.5 million users building on the platform.

The numbers back it up: 8 figures in ARR in year one, more than doubled that in year two, and 180,000+ GitHub stars, putting them in the top 50 repositories of all time. They just closed a $75M Series B to build out a new knowledge library product for AI agents. The company is small, moving fast, and hiring people who want to build the next chapter with them.

The Mission

They believe developers and AI agents shouldn't have to fight the web to get data out of it. Every hour spent maintaining a scraper or babysitting a parser is an hour taken away from the actual product. Their job is to make that problem disappear.

The Opportunity

As a Sales Engineer, you'll own the technical side of every serious deal: discovery, architecture, demo, POC, start to finish. You'll sit close to the VPs and the founders, so the feedback loop between "customer needs this" and "we're building it" is short. The split runs roughly half pre-sales, half implementation. You see a deal through from the first call to production.

What You'll Do

  • Run the full technical sales cycle: discovery, solution architecture, live demos, POCs

  • Get in front of customers and show them, hands-on, how the product solves their problem

  • Build POCs and technical proposals strong enough to turn "interesting" into "signed"

  • Answer the hard technical questions that decide deals, and know when to pull in engineering

  • Take what you hear from prospects straight back to product and engineering

  • Split your time close to 50/50 between pre-sales and implementation

  • Report to the VP of Revenue and Success, with real access to the founders

What You Bring

  • 3-7 years in pre-sales engineering or solutions engineering at a dev tools, API, or data infra company, as an individual contributor

  • Built and delivered POCs for enterprise prospects on your own

  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs, RAG, agents, or AI data pipelines. You can read code, write, and use an API without help

  • Can talk to an engineer about architecture and to a VP about ROI in the same afternoon

  • Genuine energy for customer conversations, with real ownership over deal outcomes

  • Authorized to work in the US already (no visa sponsorship on this one, so US citizens or Green Card holders)

Key Success Drivers

The people who do well here build things themselves. They get more energy from a good customer conversation than from a status meeting, and they're comfortable owning an outcome without a playbook to follow.

Why Join?

  • Compensation & Equity: Base $143K–$199K, OTE $190K–$265K, 75/25 split. Meaningful equity in a fast-growing, well-funded startup.

  • Traction: 8 figures in ARR in year one, more than doubled in year two. 180,000+ GitHub stars, putting them in the top 50 repositories of all time. A developer base of over 1.5 million users showing up before you even start selling to them.

  • Funding: Just closed a $75M Series B. The new capital is funding a major new knowledge library product for AI agents.

  • Team: ~40 people total, real visibility with the founders and leadership. No layers, no committees, fast decisions, short feedback loops.

  • Benefits: 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision (50% for spouse and kids); employer-paid life, short-term, and long-term disability insurance; 401(k), pre-tax FSA, and commuter benefits; pet insurance; 15+ days PTO; 12 weeks fully paid parental leave for moms and dads; $100/month wellness stipend; $1,000/year learning and development budget; 3-month paid sabbatical after 4 years; team offsites twice a year; SF HQ perks and a loaner e-bike for commuting.

  • Visa: not open to visa sponsorship on this one (US citizens and Green Card holders only).

Interviewing Process

  • Recruiter Screen: confirm a shipped AI-native project (public repo preferred) and a closed deal you can size, with your role in it

  • Intro Chat (25 min): what you've been working on, why this caught your interest, what you want next

  • Technical Chat (60 min): a real scenario from the business, discovery, demo, or scoping a POC for a hard prospect problem

  • Paid Work Trial (1–2 weeks): remote-friendly, working an actual technical deal scenario with the team

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.excerpt: Who we areSamsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara’s Customer Success team is on the front lines of business value delivery by helping customers adopt our platform, realize measurable business value, and renew and expand with confidence. Our Mid-Market Customer Success Managers pick up where our Implementation team leaves off, working closely with our customers to understand their fleet and unique challenges, advising on how to customize Samsara for their needs, and becoming their long-term partner.

You’ll manage a portfolio of 100-200 named accounts, using AI tooling to Mid-Market your reach and prioritize where you spend your time. You won’t shy away from rolling up your sleeves on integrations and the more technical aspects of the Samsara platform — you’ll learn, understand, and convey the value of our most complex products and features.

Your role will be cross-functional, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering, and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper-growth company from within. The Mid-Market CS team is still being built, and you’ll help write its next chapter — shaping the playbooks, workflows, and AI-powered motions that define how we Mid-Market.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except Alaska, Austin Metro, Boulder Metro, California, Chicago Metro, Connecticut, Dallas Metro, Denver Metro, Houston Metro, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Rhode Island, Seattle Metro, and Washington, D.C.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Be on the front lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform.
  • Manage a portfolio of ~100-200 named accounts, using AI tooling to Mid-Market your engagement, prioritize proactively, and drive efficiency and outcomes across your book of business.
  • Demonstrate a willingness to understand and explain technical issues to a non-technical audience and to engage the right cross-functional partners to drive resolution.
  • Compose joint success plans with customers, outlining their objectives, metrics, and timelines, and effectively removing any barriers to achieving business value.
  • Conduct workshops with customers to understand their current operations and recommend workflow changes to maximize the value of their Samsara products.
  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities — including its more technical and integration-related features — and explain them to businesses of all types: field services, utilities, long-haul transportation, school buses, and many more.
  • Help build the next chapter of Mid-Market CS at Samsara by contributing to the playbooks, workflows, and AI-powered motions that define how the team Mid-Markets.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 2 - 4+ years of experience in a customer success, account management, sales, or strategic consulting role. Enterprise SaaS experience preferred.
  • This is a demanding position with high internal visibility that requires strong priority management and high emotional intelligence.
  • Experience supporting or working with technical products.
  • Solutions-oriented with strong problem-solving skills.
  • Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety of internal and external stakeholders: executives, Sales, Product, Support, and Engineering leadership, and day-to-day users of our software.
  • Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment.
  • Diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues.
  • Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience working on a Renewal + Growth Quota
  • Has a strong bias for action, the ability to think big, and insistence on high standards.
  • Has experience serving and supporting large-Mid-Market business solutions at Fortune 500 companies.
  • Thrives in an unstructured, fast-paced, and change-heavy environment.
  • AI First: Experience using AI tooling to drive efficiency and outcomes.
  • Technical Proficiency: Comfort with APIs and integrations.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$65,598.75—$88,200 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Location: Fully Remote, United States

Position Type: Full-Time

Clearance: U.S. citizenship is required. The candidate must be eligible to obtain and maintain federal suitability, a government-issued PIV credential, and required system access.

The Opportunity

TeamWorx Security is seeking a Senior Data Scientist to develop analytical and AI-enabled capabilities on a federal enterprise data modernization effort. The Senior Data Scientist will work with business teams, technical staff, and government stakeholders to turn mission questions into analytical approaches, build and validate models on governed enterprise data, and deliver results decision-makers can act on and defend.

The work spans multiple business lines, so priorities shift as different teams need help. This role rewards someone who can move between problem domains, learn a new business area quickly, and apply the method that best fits the stakeholder's or end-user's question.

Success in this role requires initiative, ownership, and clear communication. You will work through ambiguity, identify needs or risks before they become problems, and move work forward without waiting for detailed direction.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Translate mission and business questions into analytical approaches, working directly with government stakeholders and subject matter experts to define the problem before modeling it.
  • Perform exploratory and statistical analysis, predictive modeling, forecasting, scenario analysis, and feature engineering using governed enterprise data.
  • Develop, validate, and maintain models and AI-enabled analytical capabilities, including documented assumptions, definitions, and data lineage, and establish whether the outputs are accurate, explainable, and fit for the decision being supported.
  • Build the analytical datasets your work depends on using Databricks, BigQuery, Python, and SQL, working with the data engineering team where production pipelines are required.

This role is a dual-focus technical leadership position within our Engineering organization: leading company-wide AI productivity initiatives and contributing as a senior software engineer to our core product. You will design, build, and maintain AI-powered workflows and tools that accelerate delivery and raise quality across engineering and other departments. You will develop and execute training strategies that bring all employees along in adopting AI effectively and securely. This role contributes to a globally distributed SaaS platform used around the world to effortlessly and securely connect guests and residents (and all their devices) to the internet with an at-home Wi-Fi experience. Our platform serves a variety of markets. From hotels and multi-family residences to campgrounds and college campuses, every day, tens of millions of people benefit from the services we provide.

Reporting Relationships:

This role reports to a Senior Engineering Manager and has no direct reports. Provides AI and technical leadership across all engineering teams and partners with other departments on AI adoption initiatives.

Essential Job Functions & Core Responsibilities:

AI Leadership & Productivity

  • Design, build, and maintain AI-powered workflows, tools, and automation that improve productivity, code quality, and operational efficiency across engineering and other departments
  • Evaluate, prototype, and introduce cutting-edge AI technologies, frameworks, and patterns (including agentic AI, LLM orchestration, and multi-step reasoning) into company workflows
  • Develop and execute AI training strategies and enablement programs for employees across the organization, ensuring teams can effectively and responsibly adopt AI tools

  • Manage AI-related vendor and tech partner relationships, evaluating tools and platforms for fit, security, and cost-effectiveness

Core Product Engineering

  • Architect, design, and implement scalable, secure cloud-native solutions on AWS that handle high transaction volumes across multi-tenant environments

  • Champion security-first development practices, ensuring sensitive data handling meets compliance and industry standards across all services

  • Mentor and develop engineers at all levels, fostering a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, and innovation

  • Other duties as assigned

Working Conditions:

This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, and printers. This job operates remotely, in a home office environment, with occasional travel for team meetings or company offsites.

Physical Demands:

Remains in a stationary position for extended periods of time. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, cell phones, computer mouse and computer monitor. For remote office setup; places, moves, installs, replaces and hooks up technology equipment that may weigh up to 20 pounds. Communicates complex information effectively to clients and co-workers via telephone, video, or email.

Candidate Requirements

Must Have:

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • 3+ with demonstrated leadership in AI adoption and tooling
  • Proven hands-on experience building AI-powered workflows, developer tools, or automation systems that delivered measurable productivity gains across teams or organizations
  • Deep understanding of the current AI/ML landscape—foundation models, agentic AI patterns, LLM orchestration, tool use, and multi-step reasoning—with the ability to translate rapidly evolving capabilities into practical, secure solutions
  • Experience developing and delivering AI/technical training programs, workshops, or enablement initiatives for technical and non-technical audiences
  • Strong security awareness in the context of AI—understanding risks around data leakage, prompt injection, model misuse, and compliance implications of AI tool adoption
  • Deep expertise in AWS cloud services with hands-on experience designing and operating complex serverless and event-driven architectures
  • Strong proficiency in two or more object-oriented programming languages
  • Experience with both relational and NoSQL databases, such as MS SQL Server, DynamoDB, and OpenSearch
  • Proven experience building and operating high-transaction, low-latency backend systems at scale
  • Demonstrated experience handling sensitive data in multi-tenant SaaS environments with a security-first mindset (encryption, access control, data isolation, compliance)
  • Track record of end-to-end ownership of large-scale solutions—not just contributing to a piece, but driving the full architecture from design through production
  • Experience with RESTful API design and event-driven integration patterns
  • Proven experience shipping product as part of an Agile team
  • Strong desire to help a successful company scale existing cloud-based services while also being a significant contributor to the development of new products
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for diverse audiences
  • A collaborative, energetic team player with a genuine willingness to help others, a proactive attitude, and a natural curiosity for learning and adopting new technologies

Strongly Preferred:

  • Experience with data lake architectures and BI tooling (e.g., AWS Athena, QuickSight, Redshift, Glue)

  • Hands-on experience implementing CI/CD pipelines—not just using them, but designing and building deployment infrastructure using tools such as Kraken, CloudFormation, CDK, or similar IaC frameworks
  • Database administration experience or backup DBA capacity across various database engines (relational, NoSQL, in-memory)
  • AWS certification(s) (Solutions Architect, Developer, Security Specialty, or Machine Learning Specialty preferred)
  • Bachelor's degree in related field

Candidates for this role, must be based in the United States and legally eligible to work for any US employer. Eleven is not able to sponsor candidates at this time.

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with occasional visits to customers across the DACH region.

As team collaboration is of great importance to us, we highly encourage team members to join us in Zurich at least once a month. These visits are financially supported by BLP.

About the role

For a process to run autonomously, four things have to line up: the technology, the process itself, the data behind it, and the people who work with it. That alignment does not happen at go-live. It happens in the months after, and that is where this role sits.

Our customers go live with a working solution. What they do not have on day one is an organisation that operates in an AI-native way. Processes were designed around people checking things. Data was maintained well enough for humans to interpret. Teams know the old workarounds better than the new system. Your job is to lead that transition, from a process that is automated in parts to a process that genuinely runs on its own.

That means working across every level of the customer's organisation. With operational teams you build understanding and find where automation is actually blocked. With department leads you challenge the process rules that make full automation impossible, and drive the decisions that change them. And you use the right lever for each blocker, because they are all different: some are a data clean-up you coordinate with the customer, some are a training and adoption gap, some need a custom agent, and some are structural and belong with our engineering teams.

You do not do this alone. You enable the customer's core team to solve their own issues, you work with our Customer Success Engineers on the technical side, and you use the Customer Success Manager to get decisions made where you need commercial weight. For our smaller customers, where there is no Customer Success Manager, you are the escalation point yourself.

You own customer health. Your sharpest measure of it is the automation rate.

What you'll do

  • Lead the transition to AI-native ways of working: identify what blocks automation, and pick the right way to solve each blocker.

  • Work with operational teams on enablement and adoption, so people work efficiently with blp rather than around it.

  • Challenge process rules that prevent automation, and drive improvements with the department leads who can decide.

  • Coordinate data clean-up with the customer where master data quality is capping what automation can reach.

  • Enable the customer's core team to resolve issues themselves, and reduce what has to come to us at all.

  • Identify where a custom agent solves the problem, and where the issue is structural and belongs with our engineering teams.

What we're really looking for

  • Client Hands – You bring customers with you. You are strict on the things that matter and flexible on the things that do not, you understand the context people are working in, and you have more than one way of convincing them.

  • Ownership & Autonomy – You take a customer from live to high automation without being told the steps.

  • Comfort in the Data – You go into the numbers yourself to find where automation is leaking.

  • Problem Solving & Critical Thinking – You separate a configuration symptom from a process cause, and pick the right lever for each.

What you'll get

About the role

We are looking for a sharp, fast, brand-obsessed Retention Specialist to own the voice of a high-growth consumer technology client. You will write the email and SMS copy that carries the program, direct the creative that goes with it, and keep the marketing calendar moving as output scales.

You are writing a program into existence rather than maintaining one. The list starts near 20,000 and grows fast behind a significant acquisition investment, volume ramps to 40–60 emails a month, and deepening segmentation multiplies the number of versions behind every send. Most of what you write is automated — lead capture, welcome series, first-conversion and activation sequences — and then loyalty and repeat purchase programming on top of it. The program runs on enterprise tooling such as Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, or .

This is a copy-led role. You will write more than you manage, and the quality of your writing is the primary thing we are hiring for. The ability to hold a consistent voice across a lot of output is essential.

You should apply if this sounds like you

You are a copywriter who happens to work in lifecycle marketing. You can explain a technical product simply, write a subject line that earns the open, and make a subscription upgrade feel like a good idea rather than a sales pitch.

  • 3–5+ years of experience writing marketing copy, with meaningful time in email, SMS, or lifecycle marketing. A strong portfolio matters as much as the years.

  • You write excellent short-form copy — subject lines, preheaders, body, CTAs, SMS — and you can show work where your copy moved a number.

  • You can make consumer technology, software, or a digital subscription feel clear and desirable without jargon. Experience writing for a SaaS, app, or connected-device brand is a strong plus.

  • You have written the funnel: lead capture and opt-in copy, welcome series, first-conversion and onboarding sequences, and subscription activation messaging.

  • You have written loyalty, rewards, and win-back programming, and you understand that driving repeat purchase and long-term value is a core outcome of this role.

  • You are comfortable working from a segmentation strategy, writing distinct copy for distinct audiences rather than one message for everyone.

  • You can direct design. You write clear creative briefs, give specific and useful feedback on layout, hierarchy, and imagery, and you know when a design is not serving the copy.

  • You are fluent in Figma — you review and approve designs there, leave actionable comments, and keep versions straight.

  • You own a marketing calendar with confidence: you can hold a high-volume calendar, flag conflicts early, and keep a lot of moving pieces on schedule.

  • You are detail-obsessed about proofing, links, personalization tokens, and brand consistency. Typos in a send genuinely bother you.

  • You take feedback well and iterate quickly, and you are comfortable presenting and defending your creative choices to a client.

  • Working knowledge of an enterprise ESP (Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, , or comparable) is a plus; you do not need to be the one building, but you should understand what is possible.

A day in the life

  • Write the email and SMS copy for campaigns, flows, and automations across your client's program, from lead capture through activation, loyalty, and repeat purchase.

  • Develop and maintain the client's marketing calendar, sequencing campaigns against the strategy your Associate Director sets and flagging capacity risks before they become problems.

  • Write creative briefs for the design team and give clear, specific direction on what each asset needs to do.

  • Review and approve designs in Figma, leaving actionable feedback and shepherding assets to final.

  • Own the brand voice and the copy guidelines for your client, keeping tone consistent as output scales and segmentation multiplies the number of versions.

  • Partner with the CRM Specialist to make sure copy, segmentation logic, and dynamic content line up in the build.

  • Proof every send before it goes out — copy, links, personalization, rendering.

  • Review performance with your Associate Director and translate what you learn into your next round of copy tests.

What It's Like to Work at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

  • Unlimited PTO + Local holidays (Relevant to your hub): Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.

  • Remote-First Culture: Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include Brazil and Spain.

  • Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.

  • Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

About the Role

This role sits at the intersection of applied data science and AI product quality for a small, fast-moving AI productivity startup building autonomous agents that handle email, calendar, browser, and business software tasks.   • Define and track metrics such as task success, tool-selection accuracy, instruction adherence, factual consistency, latency, cost, and reliability.

  • Design deterministic and model-based graders, calibrate LLM-as-a-judge systems, and measure grader agreement, false positives, and false negatives.

jobs.description:
About Sidekick

At Sidekick, we help people recover faster from injuries. Trusted by Olympic champions and everyday athletes, our products have been featured in Men's Health and Running Magazine. With 94% of users finding relief, we aim to be the go-to injury relief brand.

The role

A lot of performance creative work goes into creating demand that wasn't there. That's not the problem here. Our customer already wants what we sell. Their heel hurts every morning when they get out of bed, or their ankle rolls on uneven ground and they've stopped trusting it.

What they don't believe is that this is the thing that finally works. They've already bought the insoles, done the stretches, and gone to physio twice. So you have to teach before you can sell, and you have to earn trust from someone who has been let down already. It's a harder brief than most, and a more interesting one.

You'll write our paid social advertising and own angle development and testing, reporting to our Creative Director. Expect to ship around 15 briefs a week, a mix of net-new concepts and iterations on ads that are already working. Your week is writing, research, and feedback to editors.

You don't need a physiotherapy background, but you do need to pick up a clinical concept quickly enough to explain it clearly and honestly in fifteen seconds of camera time.

What you'll do

  • Find new winning angles. Better creative is what lets us spend more, so we need a steady supply of ads that keep working as budgets grow.
  • Open new audiences. Runners, older adults worried about falling, people on their feet all day. Each group buys for a different reason, and every one we crack opens up new demand.
  • Get more life out of winners. Read the data weekly, iterate what's working, retire what's finished.
  • Write the scripts. Short and long-form video, hooks that stop the scroll, dialogue that sounds like a real person. This is most of your week.
  • Direct the edit. Brief and manage editors and creators so the idea survives production.
  • Extend what wins. Take proven angles into landing pages and email.

Requirements

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years writing paid social ads that were judged on sales (not brand awareness, engagement etc.)
  • Your ads have been responsible for over $100K+/month in ad spend (across all your ads, for a single brand). We'll ask you to walk us through it.
  • Proof you can iterate on a winner. Plenty of people can write one good ad; we want someone who gets eight more out of it.
  • You've opened a new audience before, and you can name the angle that got you in
  • Excellent writing for spoken word, which is a different skill from writing for the page
  • Strong direct response fundamentals: offer, mechanism, objection handling, proof
  • Experience briefing editors or creators
  • Health, fitness or medical device categories are a plus

What we care about

We want people who are ambitious and hold themselves to a high standard. They don't need to be managed closely, and want to be the best at their craft. The volume is real and the feedback is direct. In exchange you'll see more results in a year than most people see in three. If you're looking for something comfortable, this won't be the right fit for you.

Benefits

  • Compensation: Top of the market for this role. We’ll share compensation details on the first call.
  • Fast-growing company whose mission is to solve chronic pain and injuries
  • You’ll see the direct impact of your work on business results
  • You’ll be held to a high bar, which means you’ll get better fast
  • Fun, approachable yet ambitious colleagues
  • Comprehensive health benefits
  • Work from home

jobs.excerpt: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!
jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a six-month internship based at our HQ in central Zurich or in Munich. This is an in-person role. You learn this job by sitting next to people who already do it, and that does not work remotely.

About the role

Think of this role as the modern Sherlock Holmes — new puzzles to solve and new people to work with, every single day.
This role sits exactly at the intersection of technology and business, and that is not a figure of speech. On one side you are in the system, in the data, working out what actually happened. On the other you are on a call with a finance team explaining it and agreeing what to do. You need both, every day.

Our customers run their finance and supply chain processes on blp. When something does not behave the way they expected, a document that did not post, an exception that should have resolved itself, a number in a dashboard that looks wrong, they write to us. That is where your work starts, and it is also where you become the face of blp for that customer. What reaches them is you: your answer, your explanation, your judgement about what to do next.

You will not be reading from a script and escalating. You investigate what the system did, what the data says and what the customer's process actually requires. You have the access and the authority to change configuration when that is the answer. And when it is not, you know who to bring in and what to give them.

The role grows with you. You start on cases where the pattern is known and someone is close by. As your expertise builds you take the harder ones, and your exposure to customers grows with it: from written answers, to calls, to being in the room when a customer wants their most pressing problem solved now.

This goes well beyond tickets. We are a fast-moving organisation and a lot of what needs to exist does not exist yet. You will take on and drive initiatives that make the whole operation scale: a recurring problem that should be solved once rather than fifty times, a piece of tooling that does not exist, a way of working that has outgrown itself. Interns here have shipped things that the team still uses.

How we think about ownership
You will be given real work with real consequences, early, because that is the only way anyone learns this job properly. The other half of that is judgement: explore and decide for yourself where you can, and pull someone in when something critical is on the line. Knowing which situation you are in is part of the skill, and nobody will hold it against you for asking. What matters is that you are the face of blp to that customer, and that you take that seriously.

Most of our customers work in German and you will be in front of them from early on. That is uncomfortable for about three weeks and then it is the best part of the job.

This is a real internship, not an observation post. You will be trusted with live customers quickly, with people close by while you learn.

What you'll do

  • Answer incoming customer requests through our support channel, and be the person they hear back from.

  • Own incidents end to end: investigate, resolve, and confirm with the customer that it is actually fixed.

  • Work out why a workflow, document or posting did not behave as expected.

  • Adjust configuration where that is the right fix.

  • Recognise when a problem is bigger than one case, and hand it on with proper evidence.

  • Join customer calls to work through urgent issues directly, as your experience grows.

  • Take on initiatives beyond the queue: things that should be fixed once rather than answered repeatedly.

  • Document what you learn so the next person does not have to learn it twice.

What we're really looking for

We do not expect you to know ERP systems. We expect you to be the kind of person who gets to the bottom of things.

  • Curiosity – You want to know why something works, not just that it does.

  • Clear Logic – You take a messy situation apart, find the actual cause, and explain it simply.

  • Customer Nerve – You stay calm and credible with a frustrated controller on the phone, and you can say "I do not know yet, here is how I will find out."

  • Self-Driven – You close your own knowledge gaps without being told to.

  • Ownership – You see things through without someone checking, and you know when to pull someone in.

What you'll bring

  • Enrolled in or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's in business, economics, information systems, engineering, computer science, or something adjacent. Strong candidates from other backgrounds are welcome to make their case.

  • German and English, both fluent. This is a hard requirement. Our customers work in German every day and our internal work runs in English.

  • Strong analytical thinking and comfort working with data.

  • Genuine interest in enterprise software, AI, and how large organisations actually run.

  • Nice to have, not required: first exposure to ERP systems, SQL, APIs, or process modelling.

Where it leads

Our internship is the main entry point into the delivery organisation. Interns who do well are offered a permanent role, most often as a Customer Success Engineer or as an AI Automation Specialist, and from there the paths into Consulting and into project management are well travelled. We tell you early and honestly whether that conversation is coming.

What you'll get

  • Real responsibility from week three, not shadowing.

  • A steep learning curve on live enterprise systems.

  • Direct access to engineers, product managers, and the people running our customers' finance operations.

  • Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option programme.

  • Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

  • Visits & offsites – including collaborative team offsites.

Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact.

Learn more about blp and our values at .

jobs.description:
Lavendo partners with startups and high‑growth companies to help them hire top‑tier sales, GTM, and technical talent. This role is with one of our clients; we’ll share full details about the company and interview process as we get to know you and confirm mutual fit.

About the Company

Our client builds the data layer that AI agents run on. One API call turns any URL into clean, structured, LLM-ready data. It is already the default way a huge number of developers pull web data into their AI systems.

The numbers back it up: 8 figures in ARR in year one, more than doubled that in year two, and 125,000+ GitHub stars. They just closed a $75M Series B. The company is small, moving fast, and hiring people who want to build the next chapter with them.

The Mission

They believe developers and AI agents should not have to fight the web to get useful data out of it. Every hour spent maintaining a scraper, dealing with stale pages, or working around brittle retrieval systems is an hour taken away from the actual product.

Their job is to make that problem disappear: give AI systems reliable access to the live web, then make the results clean, current, structured, and useful enough to power real products.

The Opportunity

As a Search Engineer, you will own the systems that turn the open web into a high-quality search index.

You will work directly with the Head of Search and a small team to build and improve the crawling, indexing, retrieval, ranking, and serving infrastructure behind a fast-growing search product. This is an end-to-end role: you will improve relevance while solving the real constraints of search at scale - freshness, deduplication, latency, reliability, and cost per query.

The key requirement is direct production ownership of ranking and relevance. You should be able to point to a search-quality change you personally shipped and the metric it improved.

What You’ll Do

  • Own ranking quality and relevance for LLM-driven search and retrieval

  • Build and operate the crawling, indexing, retrieval, and search-serving systems behind the product.

  • Improve search quality using lexical, semantic, hybrid, and reranking approaches

  • Reduce latency and cost per query as query volume and corpus size grow, without compromising relevance, correctness, or reliability

  • Own systems end to end: design, build, deploy, monitor, troubleshoot, measure, and iterate in production

  • Solve for freshness, incremental indexing, deduplication, crawl scheduling, and large-scale corpus management

  • Work directly with the Head of Search and the team to shape the roadmap and ship customer-facing improvements quickly

What You Bring

  • 3+ years building and operating production search or retrieval systems, with direct ownership of ranking and relevance

  • A specific example of a ranking or reranking change you owned and the measurable impact it had on relevance, recall, conversion, CTR, NDCG, MRR, or a similar metric

  • Hands-on information-retrieval depth across BM25/lexical, semantic/vector, hybrid retrieval, reranking, and retrieval or RAG evaluation

  • Strong backend and distributed-systems skills in Go, Rust, Python, or a comparable language, with end-to-end production ownership

  • Experience improving latency and cost at meaningful query volume while maintaining quality and reliability

  • Familiarity with search and infrastructure tooling such as Lucene, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Redis, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, Docker, AWS/GCP, gRPC, or Protobuf

Key Success Drivers

The people who do well here have personally owned search quality in production, think end-to-end about relevance, crawling, indexing, serving, latency, and cost, and thrive in ambiguity by shipping, measuring, and iterating quickly without needing a fully defined playbook.

Why Join?

  • Compensation & Equity: Base salary of $235K-$260K+. Meaningful equity in a fast-growing, well-funded startup

  • Traction: 8 figures in ARR in year one, more than doubled in year two. 125,000+ GitHub stars and a developer base showing up before you even start selling to them. $75M Series B closed in 2026, backed by top-tier investors

  • Team: ~40 people total, real visibility with the founders and leadership. No layers, no committees, fast decisions, short feedback loops

  • Benefits: 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision (50% for spouse and kids); employer-paid life, short-term, and long-term disability insurance; 401(k), pre-tax FSA, and commuter benefits; pet insurance; 15+ days PTO; 12 weeks fully paid parental leave for moms and dads; $100/month wellness stipend; $1,000/year learning and development budget; 3-month paid sabbatical after 4 years; team offsites twice a year; SF HQ perks and a loaner e-bike for commuting

  • Visa: not open to visa sponsorship on this one (US citizens and Green Card holders only).

Interviewing Process

  1. Intro Chat

  2. Technical Chat

  3. Founders Chat

  4. Paid Work Trial
