A Teyánál hiszünk abban, hogy a kisebb, helyi vállalkozások a közösségünk alapjai.
Azért vagyunk itt, mert úgy látjuk, a jelenlegi játéktér nem ad valódi esélyt a kisebb szereplőknek a nagyvállalatokkal szemben.
Azért dolgozunk, mert azt tapasztaljuk, hogy a bankok és a hagyományos szolgáltatók gyakran megnehezítik a helyi vállalkozások hatékony működését. Nem hisszük, hogy a legjobb technológia vagy szolgáltatás csak a legnagyobb cégeket illetné meg.
Egy olyan jövőért dolgozunk, ahol a kisebb vállalkozások is sikeresen működhetnek és ugyanolyan elkötelezettséggel támogatjuk őket, amilyennel ők nap mint nap építik a közösségünket.

Küldetésünk

Csatlakozz lendületes és sokszínű Értékesítési csapatunkhoz, ahol minden nap azon dolgozunk, hogy ügyfeleink a lehető legjobb szolgáltatásban részesüljenek. Ez a pozíció kifejezetten a magyarországi független értékesítők és üzleti partnereik támogatására fókuszál. Többféle kommunikációs csatornán keresztül segítjük őket abban, hogy jobban megismerjék termékeinket, és minél hamarabb megoldást találjanak a felmerülő kérdéseikre. Mindig meghallgatjuk javaslataikat, és figyelembe vesszük, hogyan fejlődhetünk cégként – legyen szó folyamataink újragondolásáról vagy belső rendszereink fejlesztéséről.

  • Első szintű ügyféltámogatás nyújtása, a független értékesítők kérdéseinek megválaszolása és problémáik megoldásának elősegítése

  • Szoros együttműködés a KYC csapattal annak érdekében, hogy a kereskedők jogi és megfelelőségi folyamatai gördülékenyen működjenek

  • Pontos és naprakész nyilvántartás vezetése, frissítések rögzítése az adatbázisban

  • Az értékesítési folyamat nyomon követése, időben történő emlékeztetők és utánkövetések küldése az értékesítési csapatnak

  • A dokumentáció precíz, határidőre történő vezetése, a belső szabályzatok és iparági sztenderdek szerint

  • Panaszok kezelése, szükség esetén továbbítása a felsővezetés felé

A Te történeted

Szívesen tanulsz és fejlődsz velünk, miközben a saját szakértelmeddel is hozzájárulsz ahhoz, hogy ügyfeleink igényeit a lehető legjobban kielégítsük. Szeretsz másoknak támogatást nyújtani, és kész vagy mindig egy lépéssel többet tenni az ügyfelekért. Kiemelkedő kommunikációs készségeid vannak, és folyékonyan beszélsz magyarul és angolul.

  • Központban az ügyfél: mindent megteszel annak érdekében, hogy a lehető legjobb szolgáltatást nyújtsuk.

  • Lelkesedéssel és energiával dolgozol, nyitott vagy az új lehetőségekre és a folyamatos fejlődésre.

  • Magabiztosan kezeled a felmerülő akadályokat.

  • Erősséged, hogy gyorsan megtalálod a közös hangot bárkivel, és könnyen építesz kapcsolatokat.

About Chainlink
Chainlink is the industry-standard oracle platform bringing the capital markets onchain and powering the majority of decentralized finance (DeFi). The Chainlink stack provides the essential data, interoperability, compliance, and privacy standards needed to power advanced blockchain use cases for institutional tokenized assets, lending, payments, stablecoins, and more. Many of the world’s largest financial services institutions have also adopted Chainlink’s standards and infrastructure, including Swift, Euroclear, Mastercard, Fidelity International, UBS, S&P Dow Jones Indices, FTSE Russell, WisdomTree, ANZ, and top protocols such as Aave, Lido, GMX and many others. Chainlink leverages a novel fee model where offchain and onchain revenue from enterprise adoption is converted to LINK tokens and stored in a strategic Chainlink Reserve. Learn more at .

About The Role

Chainlink Labs is hiring an Institutional Relations Lead to build and run a disciplined institutional relations function for the Chainlink ecosystem. This is a newly created, senior individual contributor role with a clear and commercially critical mandate: Build and own Chainlink's relationships with sell-side research analysts, create institutional-grade content that drives informed coverage of Chainlink, and support broader marketing efforts to the institutional community.

This is a "build" role, not maintenance; you will own the narrative that institutions and capital-markets counterparties hear about Chainlink, constructing the strategy, materials, and relationships from scratch.

The successful candidate must navigate the distinctions among Chainlink Labs, the decentralised Chainlink Network, communicating these nuances to a sophisticated audience spanning traditional asset managers, crypto-native funds, and sovereign institutions.

Your Impact

Analyst Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain a structured coverage program for sell-side research analysts at firms covering crypto, fintech, and digital assets.

  • Serve as a primary point of contact between Chainlink Labs and the sell-side analyst community

  • Proactively brief analysts regarding major announcements, protocol upgrades, and partnership milestones.

  • Facilitate access to Chainlink Labs' executive team and technical leadership for deep-dive analyst sessions.

  • Track analyst sentiment, coverage gaps, and broader digital asset research coverage — and report findings to executive leadership.

Investment Content Creation

  • Author institutional-grade research content including white papers, deep-dives, tokenomics explainers, newsletters, and blogs.

  • Translate complex protocol mechanics, on-chain data, and revenue models into clear, compelling narratives for institutions.

  • Develop a regular cadence of public-facing materials — quarterly data packets, use case briefings, and market positioning updates — that analysts and allocators can reference and cite.

  • Partner with internal teams (product, economics, legal) to ensure all content is accurate, approved, and consistent with Chainlink's public positioning.

Institutional Investor Engagement

  • Support the broader institutional strategy by engaging directly with accredited audiences who engage with digital assets.

  • Contribute to building and maintaining a CRM of qualified institutional and accredited contacts.

  • Collaborate with the PR function to secure podcast appearances, financial media placements, and speaking opportunities that reinforce the institutional narrative.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in investor relations, institutional research, investment banking, equity sales, or capital-markets roles, with significant direct experience engaging institutional investors.

  • Demonstrated experience engaging directly with sell-side equity research analysts — either as a peer analyst or as the company-side IR professional managing those relationships.

  • Exceptional written communication skills with a proven ability to produce institutional-grade content: research notes, white papers, or investor presentations that have been read and acted on by accredited audiences.

  • Deep understanding of how institutional investment decisions are made and how sell-side research influences allocator behaviour.

  • Genuine fluency in digital assets, blockchain technology, and token economics. You need to be able to speak credibly about staking mechanics and protocol revenue to generalist managers.

  • Existing relationships with sell-side analysts who cover crypto, fintech, or digital asset companies

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and building a function from scratch within a globally distributed organisation.

Preferred Requirements

  • Prior experience as a sell-side equity research analyst, particularly covering fintech, payments infrastructure, or digital assets.

  • Experience at a crypto-native company or strong knowledge of DeFi.

  • Familiarity with the institutional digital asset landscape — who the major players are, how they think about digital assets, and what drives their decisions.

  • CFA or equivalent financial credentials.

We want to fully consider your experience and skills, and you will hear from us regarding the status of your application shortly after the closing date.

  • 3+ years of Android development experience using Kotlin.

  • Good knowledge of Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android architecture.

  • Strong sense of mobile UX, usability, edge cases and user flows.

  • Experience integrating REST APIs and debugging production issues.

  • Fast execution, high ownership and strong attention to product quality.

  • App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage.

Tech Stack

  • Kotlin

  • Jetpack Compose

  • Android SDK

  • Coroutines & Flow

  • SQL / NoSQL

  • TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)

  • Thinks in user journeys, not just screens.

  • Notices UX, performance and reliability issues before users complain.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Spain. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Spain.

About the Role

We’re looking for an AI Researcher focused on AI architecture research to help design, analyze, and advance next-generation model architectures. You’ll work at the intersection of theory and production—publishing novel research while collaborating closely with engineers to turn ideas into real systems.

This role is ideal for someone who has published research papers and wants to see their work directly shape deployed models, not just benchmarks.

What You’ll Work On

  • Research and design novel AI architectures (e.g. alternatives to standard Transformer designs, long-context models, efficient sequence modeling, hybrid architectures)

  • Explore architectural improvements for scalability, efficiency, and stability

  • Prototype and evaluate new architectures through ablations, benchmarks, and empirical studies

  • Author and co-author research papers for top ML conferences and journals

  • Collaborate with engineering teams to translate research into training and inference systems

  • Stay current with state-of-the-art research and identify promising directions early

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong background in machine learning research, with a focus on model architecture

  • Publication record in ML/AI venues (e.g. NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, COLM, ACL, EMNLP, arXiv)

  • Deep understanding of:

    • Neural network architectures

    • Sequence models and attention mechanisms

    • Training dynamics and optimization

  • Hands-on experience with PyTorch or JAX

  • Ability to reason rigorously, design clean experiments, and communicate results clearly

  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving startup environment

Nice to Have

  • Experience with non-Transformer architectures (e.g. RNN-based, state-space, hybrid models)

  • Work on long-context or memory-efficient models

  • Open-source research contributions

  • Experience bridging research and production systems

  • Background in efficient training or inference-aware architecture design

Why Join Us

  • High ownership over research direction and roadmap

  • Clear path to publishing impactful work

  • Tight feedback loop between research and real-world deployment

  • Small, highly technical team with strong research culture

  • Competitive compensation and meaningful equity

jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a full-time position based at our HQ in central Zurich or in Munich.

About the role

You solve the hard technical problems on live systems.

Once a customer is running on blp, their processes are business critical. Invoices post or they do not. Orders flow or they sit. Our support organisation resolves most of what comes in, and a lot of it is genuinely well handled by people early in their career. What is left is yours: the cases where the cause is not obvious, where it crosses systems, data and process logic at once, where the same symptom has three possible explanations and only one of them is right.

That is the job. Not a queue, and not the easy half of one. Everything difficult that comes out of the run phase lands with you.

Two things sit alongside the case work, and they are what make this a senior job rather than a harder version of a junior one.

Stabilising accounts
When an account's health goes bad, you go in and stabilise it. Not as a permanent assignment, but as a small, highly skilled squad that takes a customer whose numbers or whose confidence have slipped, works out what is actually wrong across the whole picture, fixes it, and hands back a customer who is running properly again. It is the most concentrated version of this work there is.

Taking effort out permanently
Anything that keeps arriving in the queue is a signal, and the answer is usually not more people answering it. It might be better self-service for customers, a customer-facing assistant that resolves the routine questions before they reach us, better diagnostics, or a change in how something is configured at deployment so the problem never occurs. You are expected to find those, make the case, and drive them through. That is how a support organisation scales without scaling headcount one for one, and it is value the customer feels directly.

You work across the boundary between what our platform does, what the customer's ERP does, and what their data actually looks like. You are the one who can read a failing case end to end and say what really happened, and then say credibly whether the fix is configuration, data, process, or a genuine product issue. When it is a product issue, you are the counterpart to our engineering and product teams: you bring the evidence, and because you have seen the same structural problem across several customers, your case is the one that moves the roadmap.

You are also how this function gets better rather than just bigger. The diagnostic tooling, the patterns, the documentation that lets a first-year person resolve what used to take a senior one: that is yours to build. And the interns and specialists coming through the team learn this craft from you.

You do not deliver integrations and you do not run go-lives. Our integrations engineers and technical project managers own that. You own what happens once it is live and it is challenging.

What you'll do

  • Own the technically difficult cases from our live customer base, end to end, to a verified root cause.

  • Diagnose across boundaries: platform behaviour, ERP behaviour, master data and process logic.

  • Decide what the real fix is, and make it: configuration, data, process, or a case for engineering.

  • Go into accounts with a deteriorating health score, diagnose across the whole picture, stabilise them and hand them back running properly.

  • Drive strategic initiatives that permanently reduce effort and improve the customer experience, from better diagnostics to customer-facing self-service and assistants.

  • Act as the counterpart to Product and Engineering, with evidence strong enough to change priorities.

  • Recognise structural problems across customers and push for them to be solved once.

  • Build the diagnostic tooling, patterns and documentation that raise what the rest of the team can resolve alone.

  • Mentor interns and earlier-career colleagues, and raise the technical bar of the function.

  • Support Consultants and Customer Success Managers on the technical substance of customer escalations.

What we're really looking for

The following key attributes ensure success in this role:

  • Root Cause, Not Symptom – You are not finished when it stops happening. You are finished when you know why.

  • Cross-Boundary Reasoning – You hold platform, ERP, data and process in your head at once and find where the truth is.

  • Credible Both Ways – You explain the same problem to an engineer and to a CFO, and both of them believe you.

  • Leverage – Your instinct is to remove the next hundred cases, not only to close this one. You would rather build the thing that makes a problem stop arriving.

  • Calm Under Escalation – When a business-critical process is stopped, you get more precise rather than faster.

  • Stabilizer Under Pressure: An unhappy client is not a fire to put out. It is a relationship to rebuild. You bring the temperature down, put structure back into the account, and align next steps so trust returns, not just silence

What you'll bring

  • Master's degree in a STEM field: computer science, engineering, information systems, mathematics, physics or similar. Strong candidates from a related field are welcome to make their case.

  • 3+ years in a technical customer-facing role: application support at depth, technical consulting, solution engineering, integration engineering or equivalent.

  • Demonstrable debugging ability across systems, not only within one. APIs, data mapping, interfaces, logs.

  • Comfortable with data. SQL or equivalent, and the instinct to check rather than assume.

  • German and English, both fluent. This is a hard requirement. Our customers work in German every day and our internal work runs in English.

  • Nice to have: ERP experience with SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or similar, scripting in any language, or exposure to workflow automation and process mining.

What you'll get

  • The hard problems, not the queue.

  • Influence on the product, with a direct line to Engineering and Product.

  • Room to shape the function, since the practice is still being built.

  • Real growth – the path from here leads into Consulting, technical leadership within Customer Success, or Product.

  • Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option programme.

  • Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

  • Visits & offsites – including collaborative team offsites.

Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact.

jobs.description:
Job Overview

Dynime is seeking a proactive and highly motivated Sales Development Representative (SDR) / Lead Generation Executive to expand our global sales pipeline by identifying, researching, and engaging potential clients. This role serves as the initial point of contact for many prospective customers and is crucial for driving revenue growth by generating qualified meetings for the sales team.

You will utilize modern sales prospecting techniques, AI-powered tools, CRM systems, and outbound outreach strategies to connect with decision-makers across startups, SMEs, and enterprise businesses worldwide. If you excel at research, communication, relationship building, and achieving measurable targets, this role offers an excellent opportunity for career growth in international B2B sales.

Employment Type & Location

  • Employment Type: Full-Time

  • Location: Remote / Hybrid (Global)

Dynime operates with a remote-first culture, supporting remote flexibility while offering the option to collaborate from any nearby Dynime office when needed. Find your nearest Dynime office:

Department

Sales & Business Development

Reports To

Business Development Manager / Growth & Revenue Lead

Vacancy

2 Positions

Experience

1–3+ Years in Lead Generation, Sales Development, Business Development, Outbound Sales, or a related role. Exceptional fresh graduates with excellent communication skills and a strong willingness to learn are also encouraged to apply.

Salary Range

USD $4,200 – $7,800 per year

Compensation is highly dependent on location, experience, skills, and interview performance.

Additional performance incentives and meeting-based bonuses are available.

About the Role

As an SDR / Lead Generation Executive, your primary responsibility is to generate qualified business opportunities for Dynime's sales team. This involves researching target companies, identifying decision-makers, conducting outbound outreach, qualifying prospects, and scheduling discovery meetings with potential clients.

You will collaborate closely with the Business Development and Marketing teams to ensure a consistent flow of high-quality leads across Dynime's service offerings, including software development, AI automation, business consulting, web solutions, digital marketing, and technology services.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Generation

  • Research and identify qualified B2B prospects across international markets.

  • Build targeted prospect lists using LinkedIn, company websites, business directories, and sales intelligence platforms.

  • Identify key decision-makers, including founders, CEOs, CTOs, CMOs, and business owners.

  • Maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified prospects.

Outbound Prospecting

  • Conduct outbound outreach via email, LinkedIn, phone calls, and other professional channels.

  • Personalize outreach messages to enhance engagement.

  • Follow structured outbound sequences to maximize response rates.

  • Schedule qualified discovery meetings for the sales team.

  • Maintain consistent daily outreach activity.

Lead Qualification

  • Understand prospect needs and business challenges.

  • Qualify leads using predefined sales frameworks.

  • Gather relevant business information before handing leads to Account Executives.

  • Ensure only qualified opportunities enter the sales pipeline.

CRM Management

  • Maintain accurate prospect records within the CRM.

  • Update lead statuses and activity history.

  • Track outreach performance and follow-up schedules.

  • Ensure CRM data quality and consistency.

Collaboration

  • Work closely with Business Development Executives and Sales Managers.

  • Collaborate with the Marketing team to improve lead quality.

  • Share market feedback and customer insights.

  • Contribute ideas to enhance outreach strategies.

Performance Optimization

  • Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly outreach targets.

  • Continuously improve email open rates, response rates, and meeting conversion rates.

  • Experiment with new outreach strategies and AI-assisted prospecting methods.

  • Stay updated on industry trends and competitor activities.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Management, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • 1–3+ years of experience in lead generation, SDR, outbound sales, or business development.

  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.

  • Strong research and analytical abilities.

  • Comfortable communicating with international clients.

  • Strong organizational and time management skills.

  • Ability to work independently in a remote-first environment.

  • Goal-oriented with a strong desire to exceed targets.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, software development, AI, consulting, digital marketing, or technology services.

  • Experience using LinkedIn Sales Navigator, , Clay, Instantly, ZoomInfo, Lusha, or similar sales intelligence tools.

  • Knowledge of cold email best practices.

  • Familiarity with CRM platforms such as HubSpot, Zoho CRM, or Salesforce.

  • Experience working with global clients across North America, Europe, or Australia.

Core Competencies

  • Lead Generation

  • Sales Prospecting

  • Outbound Sales

  • B2B Sales

  • Cold Email

  • LinkedIn Outreach

  • CRM Management

  • Market Research

  • Communication

  • Relationship Building

  • Time Management

  • Negotiation

  • Customer Qualification

Tools You'll Use

  • ClickUp

  • Notion

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 6 months, you will be expected to:

  • Build a consistent pipeline of qualified prospects.

  • Schedule high-quality discovery meetings for the sales team.

  • Meet or exceed outreach and meeting targets.

  • Maintain excellent CRM hygiene.

  • Improve response rates through personalized outreach.

Why Join Dynime?

Dynime empowers businesses globally through software, AI, automation, digital transformation, consulting, and innovative technology solutions. As an SDR / Lead Generation Executive, you will play a pivotal role in building meaningful business relationships and creating opportunities that drive the company's continued global expansion.

You will work with modern sales technologies, AI-powered tools, and a collaborative international team, developing valuable skills in business development and enterprise sales.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Dynime is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. jobs.title: CRM & Automation Specialist
jobs.excerpt: OverviewDynime is seeking a detail-oriented and innovative CRM & Automation Specialist to design, implement, and optimize customer relationship management (CRM) systems and business automation workflows across the organization.
jobs.description:
Overview

Dynime is seeking a detail-oriented and innovative CRM & Automation Specialist to design, implement, and optimize customer relationship management (CRM) systems and business automation workflows across the organization. This role is responsible for improving operational efficiency, enhancing customer experiences, streamlining internal processes, and enabling scalable growth through automation.

You will work closely with sales, marketing, customer success, operations, and leadership teams to build intelligent workflows, automate repetitive tasks, improve lead management, and maintain accurate customer data. This is an ideal opportunity for someone passionate about automation, AI, integrations, and building efficient business systems.

Employment Type & Location

This is a full-time, remote-first position with global flexibility. Team members can work remotely from anywhere or collaborate from a Dynime office when needed.

Department

Operations & Revenue Operations (RevOps)

Reports To

Operations & Project Manager / CEO

Vacancy

1 Position

Experience

2–5+ Years in CRM Administration, Revenue Operations, Marketing Automation, Workflow Automation, or Business Systems.

Salary Range

Compensation is based on experience, technical expertise, interview performance, and location.

Annual salary reviews and performance-based incentives are available.

About the Role

As the CRM & Automation Specialist, you'll be responsible for creating scalable systems that improve how Dynime manages leads, customers, projects, and internal operations. You'll configure CRM platforms, automate sales and marketing processes, integrate business applications, and build workflows that reduce manual work while improving accuracy and efficiency.

You'll also collaborate with technical teams to connect APIs, AI tools, and third-party platforms, helping Dynime deliver a seamless customer journey from lead generation to long-term client success.

Key Responsibilities

CRM Management

  • Design and optimize lead pipelines, sales stages, and customer lifecycle workflows.

  • Maintain clean, accurate, and organized customer data.

  • Develop dashboards and reports for leadership and department managers.

Workflow Automation

  • Optimize internal processes to improve productivity and operational efficiency.

  • Continuously evaluate and improve existing automation systems.

System Integrations

  • Build API-based integrations between business tools.

  • Manage webhook implementations and data synchronization.

  • Troubleshoot integration issues and ensure system reliability.

  • Work closely with developers on advanced automation requirements.

Marketing & Sales Automation

  • Automate lead capture, nurturing, scoring, and qualification.

  • Build email automation sequences and customer engagement workflows.

  • Support campaign tracking and attribution.

  • Improve lead routing and sales handoff processes.

  • Optimize customer onboarding and follow-up automation.

AI & Business Automation

  • Implement AI-powered workflows to improve efficiency.

  • Explore and integrate modern AI tools into daily operations.

  • Build AI-assisted internal processes where appropriate.

  • Recommend automation opportunities that improve customer experience and business performance.

Reporting & Optimization

  • Monitor workflow performance and system health.

  • Analyze CRM usage and adoption.

  • Create reports and dashboards for business insights.

  • Recommend continuous improvements based on performance data.

  • Document systems, workflows, and automation processes.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • 2–5+ years of experience with CRM platforms and business automation.

  • Experience designing workflow automation.

  • Knowledge of APIs, webhooks, and system integrations.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

jobs.description:
Operations & Project Manager

Dynime is seeking a highly organized and proactive Operations & Project Manager to oversee the successful planning, execution, and delivery of client projects while optimizing day-to-day business operations. This role is responsible for ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and to the highest quality standards, while continuously improving internal processes and operational efficiency.

You will work closely with leadership, sales, design, development, marketing, and customer success teams to coordinate resources, manage priorities, mitigate risks, and deliver exceptional client experiences. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, remote-first environment and has a passion for operational excellence, project leadership, and continuous improvement.

Role Details

  • Employment Type: Full-Time

  • Location: Remote / Hybrid (Global)

  • Department: Operations & Project Management

  • Reports To: Chief Executive Officer (CEO)

  • Vacancy: 1 Position

  • Experience: 3–6+ years in Project Management, Operations Management, Delivery Management, or a related field.

  • Salary Range: USD $9,000 – $18,000 per year

Compensation is based on experience, project management expertise, leadership ability, interview performance, and location. Performance bonuses and annual salary reviews are available based on individual and company performance.

As the Operations & Project Manager, you will serve as the central coordinator between clients and internal teams, ensuring projects move efficiently from planning to successful delivery. Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the role

We are looking for a deeply technical Senior Retention Specialist to own the CRM build for a high-growth consumer technology client. You will architect and implement the flows and automations that carry the program, own the segmentation logic behind them, and hold the channel KPIs that determine whether any of it lands in the inbox.

You are standing this program up from the ground, not inheriting it. The list starts near 20,000 and scales rapidly behind a significant acquisition investment — which puts real pressure on deliverability, list hygiene, and data hygiene from day one. Volume ramps to 40–60 emails a month, and increasingly granular segmentation is what generates that output. Automation is the core of the program: lead capture, welcome series, and the first-conversion funnel first, then subscription activation, loyalty, repeat purchase, and win-back. You will work in an enterprise-grade platform — Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, , or comparable.

You are the person who knows the platform better than anyone else on the team. When something does not fire, does not render, or does not deliver, you find out why.

You should apply if this sounds like you

You are hands-on in the ESP every day and you like it there. You enjoy building a journey with real conditional logic, and you get genuine satisfaction from tracking down why one segment stopped converting.

  • 3–5+ years of hands-on lifecycle, CRM, or email marketing execution, with deep expertise in at least one enterprise-grade ESP — Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, , or comparable.

  • You have built complex, event-triggered journeys from scratch: multi-branch logic, wait steps, conditional splits, holdouts, and cross-channel orchestration across email, SMS, push, and in-app.

  • You are fluent in advanced segmentation — behavioral and product-event based, computed attributes, dynamic and personalized content — and you have scaled a program where segmentation drove a real increase in send volume.

  • You have built the funnel that matters here: lead capture forms and opt-in logic, welcome series, first-conversion sequences, and subscription activation journeys.

  • You have implemented loyalty, rewards, and win-back programs, and you treat driving repeat purchase and long-term value as a core outcome rather than a nice-to-have.

  • You own deliverability as a discipline: domain warming and authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, BIMI), sending reputation, list hygiene, sunset policies, and what to do when a list grows very fast.

  • You own the channel KPIs — open, click, click-to-open, conversion, deliverability, bounce, spam complaints, unsubscribe — and you can diagnose a drop in any of them.

  • You are comfortable with HTML and CSS for email, and you know how to build templates and modules that render correctly across clients. Liquid, Handlebars, AMPscript, or a similar templating language is a strong plus.

  • You understand data flows into the ESP: API-based events, webhooks, ETL or CDP integrations, and product event streams. You can hold a technical conversation with a client's engineering team.

  • You are a systematic troubleshooter — you isolate variables, you check the data before the theory, and you document what you find.

  • You design and execute proper tests: A/B and multivariate, with honest reads on significance.

  • Excellent written communication and the ability to explain a technical problem to a non-technical audience clearly and without condescension.

A day in the life

  • Build and QA the flows, automations, and campaigns that run your client's program — from lead capture and welcome through activation, loyalty, repeat purchase, and win-back.

  • Implement the segmentation and audience logic behind the calendar, and build the dynamic content that makes personalization work at volume.

  • Own the technical setup and health of the client's ESP instance: integrations, data feeds, event tracking, templates, and modules.

  • Monitor and own channel performance and deliverability, escalating and fixing issues before they affect the program.

  • Troubleshoot anything that misfires — a flow that does not trigger, a segment that under-populates, a template that breaks in Outlook — and document the fix.

  • QA every build end to end before launch: logic, rendering, links, personalization, suppression.

  • Design and run the testing roadmap with your Associate Director, and report results honestly.

  • Partner with the Copy & Content Specialist to get copy and creative into the build accurately and on schedule.

  • Build and maintain the reporting your Associate Director needs for client KPI reviews.

What It's Like to Work at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

  • Unlimited PTO + US holidays: Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.

  • Finances, growth, and retirement: Darkroom offers a robust 401(k) program with company match and profit-sharing opportunities to help you save and grow as the company grows.

  • Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.

  • Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

  • Compensation: The base salary range for this role is $60,000-$80,000 per year. jobs.description:
Overview

The HRU requires a remote Occupational Health Physician support to provide case review services of occupational medical exams performed for medical clearance, medical surveillance, reasonable accommodation, medical review board, and other purposes as needed by the DEA. This review is provided by a Reviewing Medical Officer (RMO) who makes a recommendation for clearance based on the medical information provided to make a medical recommendation to the DEA regarding an applicant or employee’s ability to perform their job duties safely.

Location: Remote for the Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) located at 75 Morrissette Dr, Springfield, VA 22152

Pay: $140/hr

Schedule: Services shall be provided Monday - Friday between the hours of 0830 - 1700 EST. Averaging 40 hours each week

Position Type: Independent Contractor (1099)

Responsibilities

Perform duties of Reviewing Medical Officer (RMO) to make medical recommendations to DEA about a worker’s ability to perform their job duties safely by reviewing exams and associated medical documents within 30 days of receiving paperwork.

Communicate daily with DEA Health Services Unit staff to determine work priorities, issues encountered, and discuss individual exams as needed. RMO will communicate as needed to 3rd parties such as personal or treating physicians in order to successfully and accurately issue a clearance determination.

Provide weekly reports to the DEA on productivity.

Utilize federal, agency specific, and industry medical standards established prior to the examination to make a medical determination of fitness for duty.

Perform clearance case reviews; make a determination about whether the applicantor employee meets job specific medical standards to safely perform work that is arduous, involve a high degree of sensitivity toward the public or sensitive national security concerns, or put employees at risk of hazardous exposures during the course of performing essential job functions. The RMO determination shall address:

  • Whether the applicant or employee is medically cleared to work with or without
  • Whether the applicant or employee is medically able or unable to work.
  • Employee has a suspected work-related injury or illness.
  • Whether or not additional information is needed to make the medical
  • Whether to accelerate exam frequency and/or further evaluation such as additionalmedical testing or a Fitness for Duty evaluation is warranted.

Case reviews shall include examinations performed prior to employment for applicants, for periodic medical evaluation of incumbents, before return to work after an injury, or to determine an incumbent’s ongoing fitness for duty when a change in health status has caused concern about the worker’s or others’ safety.

When conducting medical screening and medical surveillance case reviews, the RMO determines whether there is a change in the health status of an employee due to apotential exposure at work. Requirements for these examinations fall under the general OSHA standard. The RMO determination will address:

  • Whether the health status of an employee has changed due to a potential workplace exposure.
  • Whether work areas require further evaluation due to medical information that raises suspicion for an unsafe work environment.

In determining medical support for medical employability case review, agency specific requests shall include:

  • Reasonable Accommodation under the Americans with Disabilities Act
  • Leave under the Family Medical Leave Act
  • Medical Fitness for Duty evaluations
  • Return to work after illness or injury
  • Handicapped parking requests
  • Federal disability retirement applications
  • Advanced sick leave and leave bank requests
  • Hardship requests

The RMO shall provide consultative occupational medical services related to agency and occupational health needs. The consultative services may include:

  • Subject Matter Expertise in Medical Review Board proceedings
  • Assistance with developing medical guidelines and standards
  • Creating agency policies and standard operating procedures for medical issues
  • Providing medical guidance on and evaluations for specific occupational medicine issues that arise in the workplace

In any instance, absence of specific guidance for medical determinations requires RMO research and expertise in collaboration with agency POC to develop consistent protocols for evaluation.

Transmission: Encrypted documents will be furnished electronically to RMO’s DEA email address, and will be returned via same. All communications should be via DEA email or shared folder.

The Contractor’s management organization shall be responsible for ensuring that all work activities are performed in a timely and cost-effective manner while maintaining the highest quality of performance. The Contractor shall: (1) prepare monthly status reports; and (2) participate in ad hoc status meetings. The Contractor shall ensure that project management activities are reflective of all active task orders.

Litigation Support. The Contractor’s reviewing physicians, specialists, or other staff may berequired to provide legal testimony or testify in court proceedings for the DEA. These services may include:

    • Providing copies of medical files and related documentation
    • Ad hoc consulting
    • Participate in investigatory interviews in person or by electronic means
    • Prepare affidavits
    • Participate in depositions by electronic means
    • Provide testimony by electronic means

Qualifications

  • Experience: Minimum 12 months specialized expertise and experience rendering opinions about whether an applicant or employee is medically qualified to perform the duties of their position, with or without accommodation.
  • Education: Completed Undergraduate Program and Medical School (MD/DO).Specialized training in Occupational Health Medicine.
  • Licensure: Unrestricted state licensure in state of practice
  • Certification: General Practitioner, at minimum; Contractor shall be a board-certified in Occupational Health Medicine or board-certified in Preventive Medicine
  • Malpractice Insurance: Provider is required to provide their own malpractice insurance.
  • Demonstrate the ability to convey expert medical opinions and advice using excellent communication skills. Communications will primarily be in writing. If needed, contractor shall be able to provide expert witness testimony related to case reviews performed.

Kako'o Services LLC

Kako'o Services is a premier provider of healthcare workers to various military treatment facilities across the United States. With a corporate office in Honolulu, Hawaii and recruiting office in San Antonio, Texas we specialize in providing skilled, trained and highly successful healthcare workers, including RNs, CRNAs, Physicians, LPN/LVN, Licensed Social Workers, and many more.

Information Security Compliance Coordinator
Contact Discovery Services - Washington, DC
Location: Remote

A leading eDiscovery technology and consulting firm headquartered in Washington, DC is looking for a part-time Information Security Compliance Coordinator in the eDiscovery space to support the Director of Compliance with day-to-day compliance-related activities associated with ISO 27001, SOC 2, and CMMC. This role is primarily focused on administrative support, documentation, coordination, and execution of assigned tasks within the company’s information security and compliance programs.
The qualified candidate would assist with audit preparation, evidence collection, compliance tracking, and status reporting, ensuring that the required materials are accurate, up to date, and delivered on time. This role works under direction and established procedures and does not have compliance strategy or decision-making but plays a key role in keeping compliance efforts organized, on schedule, and well-documented.

This position includes working with a variety of internal & external team members including fellow Project Managers, business development team, attorneys, company or government representatives, and other legal staff. This is a part-time position (25 hours per week), with the potential to transition to a full-time role.

DUTIES OF THE POSITION:

Compliance & Audit Support

  • Support ISO, SOC 2, and CMMC compliance activities under the direction of the Director of Compliance
  • Assist with internal and external audit preparation, including:
  • Collecting requested evidence
  • Tracking auditor requests
  • Organizing documentation for review
  • Maintain compliance artifacts such as control matrices, evidence folders, spreadsheets, and trackers
  • Track remediation items and follow up with control owners as directed

Documentation & Administration

  • Update and maintain compliance documentation, policies, procedures, and logs as instructed
  • Manage version control and ensure documentation is current and properly stored
  • Prepare draft reports, summaries, and status updates for compliance leadership
  • Maintain audit calendars, timelines, and task lists

Coordination & Communication

  • Coordinate meetings related to compliance and audits, including scheduling, agendas, notes, and action-item tracking
  • Serve as a point of contact for routine compliance-related requests and information gathering
  • Communicate clearly with internal teams to obtain documentation and updates, escalating issues when needed

Program Support

  • Assist with maintaining awareness of compliance requirements across applicable frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, CMMC)
  • Support compliance training and awareness activities as directed
  • Perform other compliance-related administrative or support tasks as assigned

EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 1 – 3 years of experience in a compliance support, audit support, risk, security, IT administration, or similar operational role
  • Experience supporting audits, compliance programs, or regulated environments is preferred
  • Ability to follow established processes and execute tasks accurately and on time
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills
  • High attention to detail, especially when handling documentation and evidence
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously
  • Strong, clear written and verbal communication skills
  • Familiarity with information security or compliance concepts
  • Exposure to one or more frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, or CMMC is a plus
  • Basic understanding of data protection and secure handling of information
  • Ability to take direction and execute tasks independently once assigned
  • Comfortable working with sensitive and confidential information
  • Reliable, methodical, and process-oriented
  • Willingness to learn and grow within a compliance function

THE FOLLOWING SKILLS ARE PREFERRED BUT NOT REQUIRED:
  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Business, or a related field
  • Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience will be considered

JOB SUMMARY

This paragraph summarizes the general nature, level and purpose of the job.

The Translation Program Coordinator is responsible for developing, coordinating and managing translation services, for training and assessment of staff, interns and volunteers for translation services. Conducts medical and general interpreting/translating for staff, patients, and families for Stanford Health Services and other contracting institutions. Ensures translation process is followed according to department guidelines.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

The essential functions listed are typical examples of work performed by positions in this job classification. They are not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, tasks, and responsibilities. Employees may also perform other duties as assigned.

Employees must abide by all Joint Commission Requirements including but not limited to sensitivity to cultural diversity, patient care, patient rights and ethical treatment, safety and security of physical environments, emergency management, teamwork, respect for others, participation in ongoing education and training, communication and adherence to safety and quality programs, sustaining compliance with National Patient Safety Goals, and licensure and health screenings.

Must perform all duties and responsibilities in accordance with the hospital's policies and procedures, including its Service Standards and its Code of Conduct.

  • Conducts translating proficiency testing for all full and part-time interpreter employees and interns.

    * Coordinates workflow of all translation assignments, including delegating translation assignments and ensuring successful completion of all assigned projects.

    * Develops language/translation courses for interns.

    * Develops policies, financial planning and organization of the translation program.

    * Edits all translations providing feedback to the translation team including monitoring the translators' performance and providing feedback.

    * Ensures translation process is followed according to department guidelines.

    * Handles requests for translations from external customers including other hospitals, pharmaceutical companies and outside institutions.

    * Communicates and manages the procedure, payment, and delivery timeframe.

    * Coordinates with outside contractors for certain languages and establishes working relationships with contractors and vendors.

    * Responsible for invoicing, billing and collection upon delivery of final product for external customers.

    * Handles requests for translations from the hospital units and clinics and assigns work orders to in house translators.

    * Must possess high verbal and written skills in both English and the appropriate language.

    * Organizes educational translation meetings and prepares presentations on translation topics such as grammar, punctuation, medical terminology, etc) in staff meetings.

    * Performs all functions listed under the job description for interpreter/translator.

    * Responsible for Translation quality including edits to all Spanish translations including format, grammar, syntax, usage, spelling, etc.

    * Reviews delivery of assignments of electronic files and ensures fonts are legible (Asian, Arabic, Russian languages).

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Any combination of education and experience that would likely provide the required knowledge, skills and abilities as well as possession of any required licenses or certifications is qualifying.

Education: Bachelors degree in translation and interpretation from an accredited college or university.

Experience: Three (3) years of progressively responsible and directly related work experience.

Licensure/Certification: ATA (American Translator's Association) certification. ATA certification may be waived with a Master's degree in translation and interpretation.

KNOWLEDGE

These are the observable and measurable attributes and skills required to perform successfully the essential functions of the job and are generally demonstrated through qualifying experience, education or licensure/certification.

  • Ability to adjust communications to fit the needs and level of understanding of the receiver.

    * Ability to establish and maintain excellent client relationships, exhibit exemplary interpersonal skills and exercise sound judgment and professionalism in business and personnel matters.

    * Ability to maintain confidentiality of sensitive information.

    * Ability to remain calm under pressure and apply sound judgment Ability to solve problems and identify solutions.

    * Ability to work well with individuals at all levels of the organization.

    * Knowledge of cultural and perceptual factors that may affect patient treatment and communication Knowledge of Medical Terminology.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

The Physical Requirements and Working Conditions in which the job is typically performed are available from the Occupational Health Department. Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

Pay Range
Compensation is based on the level and requirements of the role.
Salary within our ranges may also be determined by your education, experience, knowledge, skills, location, and abilities, as required by the role, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.
Typically, new team members join at the minimum to mid salary range.

jobs.description:
Diseñar, desarrollar, optimizar y mantener soluciones de base de datos Oracle que soporten los procesos de negocio, asegurando alto rendimiento, integridad de la información y automatización eficiente mediante SQL y PL/SQL.

  • Desarrollar scripts para la automatización de tareas administrativas y procesos programados utilizando PL/SQL, shell scripting o PowerShell.
  • Mantener y documentar código siguiendo buenas prácticas y estándares de calidad.

Conocimientos Técnicos Requeridos

Base de Datos Oracle

  • SQL avanzado
  • PL/SQL

  • Oracle SQL Developer

Rendimiento y Optimización

  • Optimización de consultas (SQL Tuning)
  • Análisis de Execution Plans
  • Ajuste de parámetros SGA / PGA
  • Uso de AWR y estadísticas del optimizador

Automatización

  • Scripts en PL/SQL
  • Shell scripting o PowerShell para tareas programadas

Metodologías y Herramientas

  • Metodología Scrum / Agile
  • Control de versiones con Git

Experiencia Requerida

  • Experiencia comprobable en desarrollo con Oracle Database.
  • Experiencia en diseño y optimización de bases de datos relacionales.
  • Experiencia en implementación de lógica de negocio mediante PL/SQL.
  • Deseable experiencia en ambientes productivos de alta disponibilidad o alto volumen de datos.

Competencias Clave

  • Análisis y resolución de problemas
  • Orientación a resultados y calidad
  • Pensamiento lógico y estructurado
  • Trabajo en equipo
  • Comunicación efectiva
  • Gestión del tiempo y prioridades

Escolaridad

Deseable

  • Certificaciones Oracle
  • Experiencia en integración con aplicaciones externas
  • Conocimiento básico de sistemas operativos Linux/Unix

Lo que ofrecemos

  • Acceso a plataformas de aprendizaje y desarrollo profesional.
  • Cultura de innovación y colaboración.
  • Programas de bienestar físico y emocional.

The Property Services Coordinator is a vital operational link between tenants, property owners, and third-party contractors.   2. Property Compliance & Safety
    1. Track and schedule cyclical safety inspections, ensuring 100% compliance across key statutory areas (Gas Safety/CP12, EICR, EPC, Fire Safety, and Legionella).

VetsEZ is seeking a Senior AI Solutions Architect to lead the design and implementation of enterprise Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), with responsibility for AI architecture across the JLV contract. The initial assignment will support the Joint Longitudinal Viewer (JLV) AI Search and Summarization initiative, delivering a secure, governed AI-assisted search and summarization MVP for development, clinical evaluation, and designated-user testing in an approved lower environment utilizing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and Large Language Models (LLMs) within a secure AWS cloud environment.

Working closely with Government stakeholders, clinical subject matter experts, software engineers, cybersecurity teams, and DevSecOps personnel, this individual will establish the overall AI solution architecture while ensuring scalability, security, interoperability, Responsible AI, and compliance with Federal cybersecurity and AI governance requirements.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of enterprise AI solutions utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
  • Design scalable, secure, and maintainable AI architectures supporting enterprise healthcare applications.
  • Define solution architecture, data flows, system interfaces, AI orchestration, and integration patterns.
  • Evaluate AI technologies, services, and frameworks to support current and future project needs.
  • Ensure architecture supports approved future phases without expanding the authorized MVP scope.
  • Design AI solutions leveraging Amazon Bedrock and AWS cloud services.
  • Architect secure AI pipelines supporting approved document access and processing, retrieval, vector search, prompt orchestration, and AI-assisted summarization.
  • Define strategies for model selection, prompt management, retrieval optimization, and AI performance tuning.
  • Define monitoring and evaluation strategies to detect model, prompt, retrieval, and data drift and address degradation in accuracy, safety, or clinical relevance.
  • Optimize AI architectures for scalability, operational cost, reliability, and response time.
  • Collaborate with DevSecOps teams to support deployment automation and operational readiness.
  • Design integration between AI services and existing enterprise healthcare applications.
  • Define secure interfaces utilizing REST APIs and modern integration patterns.
  • Ensure solutions align with healthcare interoperability standards including FHIR, HL7, and CCD.
  • Collaborate with application development teams to integrate AI capabilities into clinician workflows.
  • Promote consistent architecture patterns and engineering best practices across JLV development teams.
  • Design AI solutions that comply with Federal cybersecurity, privacy, and Responsible AI requirements.
  • Incorporate Human-in-the-Loop (HITL), source traceability, approved data boundaries, retention and purge controls, explainability, auditability, and governance principles into solution architecture.
  • Support Authority to Operate (ATO), AI governance, Security Impact Analysis (SIA), and technology approval activities.
  • Ensure secure handling of Protected Health Information (PHI) and Personally Identifiable Information (PII).
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to implement secure AI architectures and operational controls.

jobs.excerpt: The Role• Foster a deep understanding of the fundamentals, supply chains, end uses, and key market participants across metals recycling markets, including both ferrous and non-ferrous sectors.
jobs.description:
The Role

  • Foster a deep understanding of the fundamentals, supply chains, end uses, and key market participants across metals recycling markets, including both ferrous and non-ferrous sectors.
  • Collect pricing data and set price assessments in line with the company’s methodology, price specifications and principles, and IOSCO principles
  • Write market commentaries, breaking news and insightful copy with price reporting angles
  • Back colleagues up on their pricing patches to provide cover and consistency for the market and build up a wider knowledge base
  • Peer review prices to verify that processes have been followed and editorial judgement applied correctly to ensure our prices are representative
  • Manage and expand the number of industry contacts that submit pricing data and give news exclusives
  • Handle questions from contacts and the market about the dynamics of particular pricing sessions, seeking guidance when inquiries are sensitive
  • Help foster Fastmarkets’ prices and expertise through the team’s market engagement plans
  • Present at events and webinars, and chair panel discussions when deemed appropriate by editors on behalf of the company

We are looking for:

  • A high level of written and spoken Spanish and English is necessary.
  • An interest in and understanding of financial markets and commodities
  • Pricing experience is helpful, but is not required
  • Journalistic reporting experience is helpful, but is not required
  • Strong networking and communication skills, confident telephone manner
  • Team player who fosters excellent working culture and acts - both internally and externally - in a courteous and professional manner, with impeccable integrity
  • Ability to work with numbers and spreadsheets and produce analytical editorial copy
  • Ability to undertake business travel by plane, train or car

We recruit talented, dynamic people with diverse backgrounds and experiences, all united by a belief in our mission to provide the world’s leading and most trusted price reporting, events, and intelligence service for the markets we serve. We’re proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to creating a fully inclusive workplace, where everyone feels able to participate and contribute meaningfully.

If you are open-minded, curious, resilient, solutions-oriented and committed to promoting equality, then read on.

KNOWLEDGE, EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS

We are looking for an individual who is highly motivated, driven, and have a passion to be part of a fast-paced, successful team. Being a strong team player is also important as well as someone who is happy to work flexibly.

If you're excited about the role but your experience, skills or qualifications don't perfectly align, we encourage you to apply anyway.

Our Values

Fastmarkets people come from all different walks of life. It’s this mix of brilliant personalities, experiences and insights that gives us that warm, open, and friendly culture you can feel as soon as you meet us. But however wonderfully different we all are, there are six things we all have in common – and they form our Fastmarkets values.

Created by our own employees to reflect some of the personal traits that Fastmarkets people have, our values are key to what makes our culture unique. They reflect who each of us are and they're embedded in everything we do. Our values are:

  • METRICS DRIVEN. We use insights to improve our customers’ experience and our business performance
  • ACCOUNTABLE. We are accountable to ourselves and those we work with: we keep our promises and get things done
  • GROWTH MINDSET. This value enables us to be nimble to the changing realities and operate with a sense of urgency
  • INCLUSIVE. We are inclusive and respectful, celebrating each of us and giving everyone a deep sense of belonging with the desire to bring their best self to work every day.
  • CUSTOMER CENTRIC. We are customer-centric in all that we do
  • COLLABORATIVE. We are collaborative, able to work across teams and capitalise on the diversity of intellect, perspectives, and experiences.

We are committed to ensuring all candidates feel welcomed and supported. Should your application advance and you require accommodations for the interview process, please inform us so we can make the necessary arrangements.

Reward and benefits at Fastmarkets

We believe in fair pay and benefits that support you both inside and outside of work. Through Fastmarkets Rewards, you'll have access to a range of core benefits and a flexible allowance, giving you the freedom to tailor your package to suit your lifestyle, wellbeing and financial priorities. We know that everyone's needs are different, so we've designed our benefits to support our diverse global team wherever they're based.

Specific benefits may vary by country and role.

If the position is listed as remote this opportunity is available to applicants based in the following states:

• Illinois

• Oregon

• New York
• Pennsylvania

• Texas*

* Denotes states with office locations to support hybrid working.

Otherwise the position will be located as shown in the advert.

You’ve read a little about us – now it’s over to you!

If you like what you’ve read so far and think you can see yourself as a Fastmarkets person, it’s time to fill in your application form. This form is an important part of the selection process: it’s used to determine whether or not you’ll be chosen to have an interview and acts as a basis for the questions we’ll ask you on the day.

It’s vital that you try to capture all the relevant information we have asked for on the form so we can get a good feel for who you are and why you’re great.

Fastmarkets is an industry-leading price-reporting agency (PRA) and information provider for global commodities, providing price data, news, analytics and events for the agriculture, forest products, metals and mining and new-generation energy markets.

Fastmarkets' data is critical for customers seeking to understand and predict dynamic, sometimes opaque markets, enabling trading and risk management. Fastmarkets is a global business with a history dating back to 1865 and is built on trust and deep market knowledge. It has more than 700 employees spread across global locations in the UK, US, China, India, Singapore, Brazil, Belgium, Bulgaria, Finland and beyond.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst
jobs.excerpt: The Senior Business Analyst is an expert in business analysis, functional design, and web solutions.
jobs.description:
The Senior Business Analyst is an expert in business analysis, functional design, and web solutions. They contribute to the evolution and modernization of LGI's Human Resources (HR) and Payroll management solutions by transforming business needs into digital solutions that create value for customers and end users.

Working closely with Product Managers, UI/UX Designers, Developers, Subject Matter Experts, and customers, the Senior Business Analyst participates in every stage of the Agile development lifecycle, from product discovery through feature delivery. They play a key role in modernizing the web components of LGI's HR and Payroll solutions by designing functional solutions that are consistent, high-performing, and user-centered.

As a subject matter expert, the Senior Business Analyst acts as a strategic partner to the Product teams. They facilitate discovery workshops, translate business needs into functional solutions, define expected application behaviors, and ensure that delivered functionality meets both business objectives and user needs.

They leverage artificial intelligence tools to improve the efficiency of business analysis, prototyping, functional design, user story creation, and documentation.

They also contribute to the evolution of business analysis practices by integrating AI tools as productivity enablers, proposing improvements to working methods, and promoting the adoption of best practices and emerging technologies.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Business Analysis & Functional Design (Approximately 65%)

  • Collaborate with Product Managers, UI/UX Designers, Subject Matter Experts, and stakeholders to understand, analyze, and refine business requirements.
  • Participate in Product Discovery activities, hypothesis validation, and user needs exploration.
  • Contribute to the modernization of the HR and Payroll web solutions by participating in their functional design and ongoing evolution.
  • Define user journeys, functional behaviors, business rules, validations, exception handling, and interactions between solution components.
  • Partner with UI/UX Designers to design, refine, and validate wireframes and prototypes, ensuring alignment with business requirements and the desired user experience.
  • Translate business requirements and design mockups into clear, complete user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional documentation that are ready for development.
  • Break down features into deliverable increments and contribute to prioritization based on business value, user experience, risk, and implementation complexity.
  • Participate in the functional modernization of solutions by assessing the business, operational, and technical impacts of proposed changes.
  • Responsibly leverage artificial intelligence tools to accelerate analysis, research, prototyping, documentation, and user story development while exercising critical judgment and ensuring the quality of deliverables.

Communication & Collaboration (Approximately 25%)

  • Work closely with Product Managers to ensure the consistent evolution of the product backlog.
  • Participate in Agile planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Facilitate discovery, validation, and solution design workshops with customers and stakeholders.
  • Present proposed functional solutions to stakeholders and obtain alignment and buy-in.
  • Communicate business requirements and proposed solutions effectively to multidisciplinary teams.
  • Support development teams by answering functional questions and validating deliverables prior to acceptance.
  • Collaborate with Quality Assurance teams to define test scenarios.
  • Maintain clear, accurate, and up-to-date functional documentation throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Support implementation and Customer Success teams during the rollout of new functionality.

Leadership & Continuous Improvement (Approximately 10%)

  • Serve as a business analysis subject matter expert within the Product organization.
  • Mentor Business Analysts and contribute to the development of their skills.
  • Contribute to the evolution of business analysis methodologies, tools, templates, and best practices.
  • Promote the responsible adoption of artificial intelligence and help evolve best practices to improve the quality, speed, and consistency of business analysis activities.
  • Stay current on industry trends in business analysis, digital product design, user experience, and artificial intelligence, and recommend improvements to team practices.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of product delivery processes.

REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or another relevant discipline.
  • Minimum of eight (8) years of relevant experience in business analysis or functional analysis within a software development environment.
  • Significant experience designing and delivering web-based solutions.
  • Proven experience working in an Agile software development environment.
  • Experience in user needs discovery, writing user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional documentation.
  • Experience collaborating with Product Managers, UI/UX Designers, Developers, and Quality Assurance teams.
  • IIBA certification (CBAP, CCBA, or equivalent) is considered an asset.

Knowledge & Technical Skills

  • Excellent ability to translate business requirements into functional solutions.
  • Strong understanding of modern web application design principles.
  • Good understanding of modern web architectures, REST APIs, and application integration mechanisms.
  • Experience with design and prototyping tools such as Figma, Axure, or Balsamiq.
  • Experience using Jira and Confluence.
  • Experience using, in a work related context, generative AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Claude, or equivalent) and strong prompt engineering skills.
  • Ability to effectively integrate AI into business analysis, prototyping, functional design, and documentation activities.
  • Understanding of the opportunities, limitations, and responsible use of artificial intelligence.
  • Knowledge of Human Resources, Payroll, Talent Management, or unionized work environments is considered an asset.
  • Ability to identify opportunities to integrate artificial intelligence into software products is considered an asset.
  • Knowledge of web accessibility standards (WCAG) is considered an asset.

Personal Competencies

  • Inspiring and collaborative leadership.
  • Strong initiative and the ability to positively influence multidisciplinary teams.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and workshop leadership skills.
  • Outstanding interpersonal and teamwork abilities.
  • Customer-focused with a user-centered mindset.
  • Systems thinking and the ability to solve complex problems.
  • Strong analytical and synthesis skills.
  • Self-motivated with a high sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Intellectual curiosity, commitment to continuous learning, and adaptability in a rapidly evolving technology environment.
  • Ability to challenge existing practices and drive continuous improvement.
  • Critical thinking skills to validate and enhance outputs generated by artificial intelligence tools.
  • Ability to leverage AI-driven productivity gains in order to focus expertise on high-value strategic activities.
  • Excellent time management, prioritization, and organizational skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Excellent written and spoken French is required for this position as it requires almost exclusively spoken and written communication in French. (Bilingual French and English will be considered as an asset but is not required.)

Why join LGI?

  • A workplace built on trust, autonomy and collaboration
  • The opportunity to grow, perform and work alongside curious and talented colleagues
  • A continuous learning culture with dedicated training time, a renowed skills development platform and access to cutting-edge tools
  • Stimulating projects that advance healthcare technology and support the work of over 320,000 professionals, benefiting more than 6 million patients
  • A comprehensive benefits package including group insurance from day one, a group RRSP with employer contributions, 24/7 telemedicine, an employee and family assistance program, and a minimum of 3 weeks vacation per year

At LGI Healthcare Solutions, we value diversity, equity, and inclusion. We believe that a diversity of experiences, perspectives, and backgrounds contributes to our success. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and respectful work environment where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply.

Interested?

Come and join us!

For over 40 years, LGI Healthcare Solutions has built software that healthcare organizations depend on. AI is now at the heart of that work — not as a destination, but as the engine behind our next generation of mission-critical solutions and our enduring mission: helping healthcare organizations perform at their best.

We're looking for exceptional people who are passionate about technology, relentless in their standards, and driven to push what's possible further.  At LGI, curiosity isn't a nice-to-have, it's how we work.

We're looking for talent who explore and innovate by instinct and want their work to matter beyond the codebase: shaping decisions, enhancing processes, and enabling healthcare practitioners.
