En Product Hackers estamos construyendo la mejor tripulación de Growth del mundo. Buscamos a un/aGrowth ManagerSeniorcon una mentalidad científica, obsesión por el impacto en negocio y la capacidad de liderar estrategias complejas de forma autónoma. Si eres de los que no solo ejecutan, sino que desafían el status quo, traducen datos complejos en narrativas estratégicas y lideran con éxito a equipos y clientes, este es tu sitio.

¿CUÁL SERÁ TU MISIÓN?

Como Growth Manager Senior,serás el puente operativo y estratégico definitivo entre Product Hackers, nuestro equipo interno y el cliente. Tu responsabilidad principal será ejecutar y coordinar la estrategia de crecimiento garantizando la máxima calidad, ritmo y alineación con los objetivos de negocio, optimizando de forma constante el plan de experimentación.

¿CUÁLES SERÁN TUS CONTRIBUCIONES?

  • Co-creación y desafío estratégico: Colaborarás con el Growth Strategist para comprender a fondo los objetivos del cliente. Integrarás la visión de crecimiento en un roadmap holístico y multicanal, desafiando la estrategia planteada, haciendo preguntas críticas y proponiendo mejoras estructurales.

  • Investigación, ideación y GOI Tree: Identificarás oportunidades de negocio de forma proactiva y autónoma. Utilizarás el framework GOI Tree para detectar oportunidades basadas en KPIs, calcularás el tamaño de estas oportunidades a partir de Business Cases y priorizarás las ideas bajo un criterio ICE estricto.

  • Liderazgo del método científico end-to-end: Gestionarás el ciclo de vida completo de la experimentación. Desde la formulación de hipótesis sólidas, selección de métricas y cálculo riguroso de viabilidad (MDE, potencia estadística, tamaño de muestra e identificación de variables de control), hasta la documentación de hallazgos.

  • Coordinación y ejecución operativa: Convertirás la estrategia en planes de acción concretos. Coordinarás las tareas de forma efectiva con equipos internos y externos (diseñadores, desarrolladores y especialistas funcionales), asegurando que los entregables cumplan con los plazos de entrega y estándares de calidad de Product Hackers.

  • Optimización y discovery continuo: Re-evaluarás continuamente el roadmap de experimentación. Detectarás cuellos de botella en la ejecución, recalcularás el ICE de forma recurrente y propondrás mejoras en procesos y herramientas para aumentar la velocidad y el impacto del equipo.

  • Explotación de data cuanti y cuali: No te quedarás en la superficie. Definirás métricas clave y crearás dashboards de negocio interconectados. Extraerás insights combinando datos cuantitativos complejos (LTV, cohortes, análisis predictivos) con análisis cualitativos (mapas de calor, grabaciones de usuarios, encuestas y estudios de comportamiento).

  • Visión de cliente y producto: Trabajarás con los stakeholders para alinear el producto con las oportunidades de crecimiento. Identificarás gaps en el producto o palancas estructurales que frenen la escalabilidad a largo plazo y propondrás soluciones estratégicas.

  • Consultoría y gestión de relación directa: Actuarás como un consultor senior para C-Levels y stakeholders clave. Mantendrás una comunicación fluida, resolverás bloqueos críticos de forma creativa, liderarás las Strategy Reviews y te involucrarás en asegurar la renovación de las cuentas aportando valor tangible.

  • Escalabilidad interna y mentoría: Participarás en la creación de repositorios internos y frameworks de conocimiento. Entrenarás y mentorizarás a otros Growth Managers en la metodología PH y en la gestión integral de la experimentación científica.

¿QUÉ TE HARÁ TRIUNFAR CON NOSOTROS?

🧠 Hard Skills

  • Metodologías de Growth avanzadas: Dominio experto de frameworks (AARRR, ICE, experimentación ágil). Capacidad para adaptar, iterar y crear metodologías personalizadas según las necesidades del cliente.

  • Rigor estadístico aplicado: Experiencia real aislando variables de control, definiendo MDEs, determinando la significancia estadística y mitigando errores de Tipo I y Tipo II en tests A/B y modelos multivariantes (MVT).

  • Ecosistema de herramientas de experimentación: Manejo experto de plataformas de testing de nivel Enterprise (Optimizely, VWO, AB Tasty) y herramientas de descubrimiento/UX (Google Tag Manager, Maze, UserZoom, Klaviyo, etc.), conviviendo si es necesario con entornos bajo CMS ad-hoc.

  • Analítica, data e IA: Nivel experto en Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Looker Studio o Data Studio. Capacidad para modelar escenarios de negocio, liderar proyectos de análisis predictivo e integrar herramientas de Business Intelligence (BI) e Inteligencia Artificial como apoyo estratégico.

  • Gestión de proyectos y documentación: Autonomía absoluta para estructurar y dar seguimiento a flujos de trabajo paralelos y complejos utilizando Notion o Jira (Kanban, Sprints), estandarizando los flujos de documentación del equipo.

  • Frameworks PH: Comprensión y ejecución impecable del GOI Tree y el Moonshot Framework para empujar la innovación x10.

🗣️ Soft Skills

  • Comunicación con impacto: Eres un embajador de la marca. Sabes contar historias con datos, presentar ideas complejas con solidez ante perfiles no técnicos y liderar foros internos o externos (Demobeers, All Hands).

  • Pensamiento crítico y curiosidad: Capacidad para conectar datos invisibles, cuestionar supuestos asentados y desafiar modelos de negocio basándote en la evidencia.

  • Proactividad extrema (Mentalidad Owner): Defines las hojas de ruta con antelación, te anticipas a las tendencias del mercado y tomas la iniciativa sin esperar instrucciones.

  • Resolución de problemas complejos: Rapidez para solucionar incidencias operativas de alto impacto y diseñar estrategias que prevengan su reaparición en el futuro.

  • Adaptabilidad, resiliencia y gestión del cambio: Flexibilidad para ajustar la ejecución ante giros estratégicos del mercado, guiando a tus compañeros a través de la incertidumbre y fomentando una cultura de aprendizaje basada en el error constructivo.

  • Trabajo en equipo y cultura de feedback: Colaboración estrecha con perfiles multidisciplinares. Promueves de forma proactiva una cultura de feedback constante sin esperar a que sea requerido.

  • Colaboración remota efectiva: Dominio de la gestión asincrónica para mantener la eficiencia operativa en equipos distribuidos.

ADEMÁS, SERÁ IDEAL SI TÚ...

  • Has trabajado previamente en una agencia/consultora.

TE OFRECEMOS

Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.

Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.


Professional Services | AI & Digital Solutions | EMEA

As an Principal AI Solutions Architect, Customer Success at Genesys, you will serve as the strategic and technical bridge between customer ambition and successful AI transformation.

You will partner directly with strategic customers across the EMEA region — leading with a consultative approach, moving with the agility that enterprise AI demands, and measuring success against customer business outcomes. At Genesys, we’re transforming how organisations connect with their customers through empathy, collaboration, and innovation.

This role offers the opportunity to make a lasting impact by helping enterprises move from AI exploration to continuous transformation — and to shape how that transformation capability is built and scaled within the organisation.

What You’ll Do

Advise, Influence & Drive Adoption

  • Lead discovery and strategy alignment — partner with Genesys CX Advisors, Solution Consultants, and customer stakeholders to identify AI use cases, assess feasibility and value, and translate business KPIs into actionable technical priorities
  • Surface the real problem beneath the presenting symptom — use data, evaluation outputs, and systematic analysis to form precise hypotheses and direct where intervention has the most leverage
  • Influence adoption through credibility: when customers are blocked, uncertain, or sceptical, resolve it through evidence and clearly articulated reasoning
  • Translate data-driven findings into executive-ready narratives — present complex AI performance insights, business impact, and recommendations with the clarity and confidence that influences C-level decisions

Design and Architecture

  • Define reference architectures, integration patterns, and data flows for AI-powered experience orchestration — adapting the approach iteratively as customer context and data reveals new priorities
  • Lead process-redesign workshops to create seamless, channel-agnostic CX — facilitated with a consultative approach that builds customer ownership of the solution
  • Ensure all designs comply with Genesys and customer security, privacy, and regulatory requirements (GDPR, PDPA, PCI, HIPAA where applicable)

Prototype and Implementation

  • Deliver rapid POC and MVP implementations using Genesys Cloud AI Studio, CoPilot, Agentic Virtual Agent, and related product suites — moving from hypothesis to working prototype at pace, and adjusting direction when the evidence requires it
  • Integrate Genesys AI components with customer CRM, ERP, and third-party systems
  • Establish implementation KPIs and analytics to measure model and journey performance from day one — not as an afterthought

AI Engineering & Outcome-Oriented Delivery

  • Design and implement evaluation frameworks to measure AI solution quality in production: intent accuracy, retrieval groundedness, response relevance, agent goal completion, and policy adherence
  • Build automated eval pipelines that enable rapid, systematic iteration across prompt variants, guardrail configurations, and model versions
  • Architect agentic systems with precision: define agent topology, design tool schemas, and engineer orchestration logic.
  • Measure success through production adoption and demonstrable outcome improvement — use outcome data as the primary signal for where to focus next

Optimisation and Continuous Improvement

  • Define baseline metrics at engagement start and iterate relentlessly
  • Evaluate solution performance against KPIs and refine designs based on data-driven insights, changing direction quickly when the data signals it
  • Collaborate with Customer Success and Professional Services teams to hand over production-ready assets and roadmaps
  • Codify field learnings into reusable frameworks, evaluation standards, and accelerators that scale capability beyond individual engagements

Governance, Ethics, and Enablement

  • Champion responsible AI design principles and apply guardrails to prevent bias or unsafe responses
  • Adhere to Genesys ethical standards and compliance frameworks
  • Mentor customer, partner, and internal teams to build long-term AI maturity and self-sufficiency — transferring expertise, not just delivering outcomes
  • Feed well-formed, evidence-backed field signal to product and solution teams — precise enough to influence roadmap priorities directly

What We’re Looking For

Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree (Master’s preferred) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related discipline
  • 8–12 years of combined experience across AI implementation, CX/CCaaS platform consulting, or technical solution architecture — demonstrated through overlap and measurable customer impact, not additive year counts across separate tracks
  • Extensive on-field experience implementing or supporting CX, CRM, or AI orchestration platforms (e.g., Genesys Cloud, Google CCAI, Salesforce, Microsoft, NICE CXone, AWS Connect, ServiceNow, or similar)
  • Hands-on experience with agentic AI systems: building, evaluating, or operating LLM-powered agents in production contexts
  • Demonstrated experience working with APIs, data pipelines, and modern cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Track record of mentoring or developing technical peers and codifying expertise into approaches others can build on

Consultative & Customer-Facing Skills

  • Proven autonomy inside complex enterprise accounts — leading discovery, shaping scope, managing stakeholder expectations, and building trust without hand-holding
  • Comfortable operating without a defined playbook — able to form and test hypotheses under ambiguity, pivot quickly when the data signals a change, and bring stakeholders along through the process
  • Translates data-driven findings into executive-ready narratives: quantified outcomes, causal relationships, and clear next steps — not qualitative summaries
  • Proven leadership in cross-functional environments and complex enterprise contexts
  • Product instinct: able to define success metrics, surface well-formed requirements, and articulate the business case for technical decisions
  • Experience with industry verticals such as Financial Services, Healthcare, Insurance, Retail, or Public Sector
  • Multilingual communication ability is an advantage across the EMEA region

Technical Skills

  • CX orchestration and workflow design across multiple platforms — with a focus on outcome over architecture elegance
  • Conversational AI and Agentic Virtual Agent implementation across voice, chat, and messaging channels
  • Knowledge engineering: retrieval system diagnosis, RAG pipeline design, semantic coverage analysis, and knowledge optimisation for AI consumption
  • Agentic system design: tool schema authoring, multi-agent topology, prompt engineering as a systematic discipline, and guardrail implementation for enterprise-safe agent behaviour
  • Applied data analysis: Python for evaluation scripting, log analysis, and integration development; SQL for operational data querying — AI-assisted development tooling expected and encouraged
  • Deep working knowledge of one or more enterprise CCaaS or Agentic AI platforms — Genesys Cloud preferred, or equivalent such as Google CCAI, Salesforce, AWS Connect, NICE CXone, Sierra, Decagon, or Cognigy; demonstrated expertise in deploying and optimising conversational or agentic AI solutions on any of these platforms is equally valued
  • Data and integration expertise: REST APIs, event-driven architecture, JSON
  • Cloud infrastructure familiarity: provisioning, access control, and cost management (AWS preferred)
  • Data governance, security compliance, and responsible AI design principles

As a senior member of the team you are expected to mentor and grow other software engineers and act as a go-to person within the team and the wider organisation across multiple codebases and languages.

Key Responsibilities

  • Advocates for and models great quality with proactive actions, and tackles difficult and subtle system issues
  • Uses systematic debugging to diagnose all issues within a set of related domains and leads in fostering a culture of observability and monitoring across several teams
  • Regularly works across teams to build a culture for iterative, autonomous development and future scaling.
  • Is a technical and prioritisation leader across a set of related team's domains, consistently pushing boundaries and exploring gaps in understanding.
  • Is a go-to within the team and the wider organisation across multiple codebases and languages.
  • Be proactive and require minimal supervision or mentoring to complete tasks
  • Review specifications produced by architects and formal methods specialists

Education / Experience

jobs.title: Chief Information Officer (CIO)
jobs.excerpt: About the roleWe are looking for an accomplished Chief Information Officer to lead the global information systems and technology organisation of an international, service-oriented university.
jobs.description:
About the role

We are looking for an accomplished Chief Information Officer to lead the global information systems and technology organisation of an international, service-oriented university.

Reporting directly to the President and serving as a member of the executive leadership team, the CIO will define and execute the technology strategy supporting the University’s mission, operational excellence and long-term international growth.

The role includes end-to-end responsibility for:

  • Product Management

  • Software Engineering and Enterprise Applications

  • Data and Analytics

  • AI Transformation

  • Enterprise Architecture

  • Infrastructure and Cloud

  • Cybersecurity

  • IT Operations

The successful candidate will be an experienced enterprise technology leader who has previously served as a CIO, or in an equivalent executive role, within a mature and operationally complex global organisation.

Key responsibilities

Technology strategy and executive leadership

  • Define and execute a multi-year global information systems and technology strategy aligned with institutional priorities.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to the President and executive leadership team on technology, transformation, investment, risk and innovation.

  • Translate the University’s strategic vision into clear technology priorities, roadmaps and measurable outcomes.

  • Partner with senior leaders across functions and geographies to ensure organisational alignment and successful execution.

Organisational leadership

  • Lead and develop a distributed global technology organisation of approximately 50 professionals.

  • Build strong leadership capability, succession depth and a high-performance culture.

  • Recruit, retain and develop senior technology talent.

  • Foster accountability, collaboration and inclusion across international teams.

Product management and digital platforms

  • Lead the strategy and lifecycle management of internally developed platforms and systems.

  • Define product roadmaps aligned with the needs of students, faculty and staff.

  • Partner with academic and business leaders to improve digital experiences and operational outcomes.

  • Ensure continuous improvement, scalability and long-term product value.

Engineering and enterprise applications

  • Oversee software engineering, quality assurance, DevOps and enterprise applications.

  • Promote modern engineering practices, scalable architecture and reliable delivery.

  • Drive platform modernisation, cloud adoption and optimisation of the technology ecosystem.

  • Guide build, buy or partner decisions based on strategic value, cost, risk and return on investment.

AI transformation

  • Define and lead the University’s responsible AI strategy.

  • Identify and implement practical AI use cases across academic and administrative functions.

  • Ensure appropriate governance, security, integration and ethical use of AI.

  • Use AI to improve decision-making, efficiency and the experience of students, faculty and staff.

Data and analytics

  • Define and execute the enterprise data strategy.

  • Establish effective governance, quality, ownership and security standards.

  • Build scalable analytics capabilities supporting consistent, data-driven decision-making.

  • Improve access to trusted information across the organisation.

Infrastructure, cybersecurity and IT operations

  • Lead the global technology environment, including cloud infrastructure, networks, end-user services and operational support.

  • Ensure secure, resilient and reliable systems across all locations.

  • Strengthen cybersecurity, privacy, disaster recovery and business continuity capabilities.

  • Ensure compliance with relevant regulatory, security and technology standards.

Vendor and investment management

  • Lead technology vendor strategy, procurement, contracting and performance management.

  • Manage the technology investment portfolio and prioritise initiatives based on strategic impact.

  • Optimise cost, quality, operational resilience and long-term value.

  • Clearly communicate the business case and return on technology investments.

Candidate profile

The ideal candidate will combine strategic vision with the ability to lead complex execution across technology, operations and organisational change.

They should demonstrate:

  • Enterprise-level strategic leadership

  • Strong executive influence and stakeholder management

  • Successful delivery of large-scale transformation

  • Deep understanding of modern technology ecosystems

  • Strong business, financial and value-management orientation

  • Experience building and developing global technology teams

  • A forward-looking approach to AI, data and digital innovation

  • Strong governance, cybersecurity and risk-management awareness

  • The ability to operate effectively in a complex, customer-facing organisation

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a related field.

  • Master’s degree or equivalent advanced qualification preferred.

  • At least15yearsof progressive leadership experience in information systems and technology.

  • Previous experience as a CIO or in an equivalent executive technology leadership role.

  • Experience within a mid-sized or large international organisation.

  • End-to-end responsibility for enterprise systems, digital platforms and technology operations.

  • Proven success defining and executing enterprise technology strategies.

  • Demonstrated experience leading complex organisational and digital transformation.

  • Experience operating in a customer-facing or B2C environment.

  • Strong track record of aligning senior stakeholders and leading change across distributed organisations.

  • Fluent English.

Strong advantage

Experience within:

  • EdTech

  • Higher education

  • Online learning

  • Digital learning platforms

  • Student-centric technology environments

  • International service-oriented organisations

The opportunity

This is an opportunity to shape the global technology direction of an international university and lead a broad transformation agenda covering product, engineering, data, AI, infrastructure and cybersecurity.

The CIO will have direct access to the President, significant executive influence and real ownership of the systems and capabilities supporting the organisation’s future growth.

jobs.description:
O firmie

Międzynarodowa firma z sektora B2B cloud computing, tworząca rozwiązania umożliwiające organizacjom software’owym dostarczanie interaktywnych, praktycznych środowisk do prezentacji sprzedażowych, POC‑ów oraz szkoleń klientów. Z platformy korzystają globalne marki technologiczne, a zespół działa w środowisku rozproszonym (Izrael, USA, Europa). Firma jest wspierana przez fundusz private equity i znajduje się w fazie intensywnego wzrostu.

Opis stanowiska

Poszukiwany jest doświadczony Full‑Stack Developer, który odegra kluczową rolę w zespole R&D. Osoba na tym stanowisku będzie odpowiedzialna za prowadzenie rozwoju funkcjonalności end‑to‑end, modernizację architektury systemu oraz aktywny udział w migracji do chmury publicznej. To rola dla inżyniera, który potrafi łączyć głęboką wiedzę techniczną z umiejętnością samodzielnego podejmowania decyzji i prowadzenia inicjatyw technologicznych. Praca w pełni zdalna (home office).

Zakres obowiązków

  • Prowadzenie pełnego cyklu tworzenia funkcjonalności — od koncepcji, przez projekt techniczny, po wdrożenie produkcyjne.

  • Rozwój frontendu w Angularze oraz backendu w C#/.NET.

  • Udział w modernizacji architektury systemu, w tym: unowocześnianie monolitu, konteneryzacja usług, migracja do AWS.

  • Budowanie i utrzymywanie pipeline’ów CI/CD oraz automatyzacji procesów wdrożeniowych.

  • Projektowanie skalowalnych usług backendowych i responsywnych interfejsów użytkownika.

  • Dbanie o jakość kodu, testy i bezpieczeństwo.

  • Przekładanie wymagań produktowych na gotowe rozwiązania techniczne.

  • Praca z relacyjnymi bazami danych i optymalizacja zapytań.

  • Mentoring mniej doświadczonych inżynierów i promowanie dobrych praktyk w zespole.

Wymagania

  • Wykształcenie wyższe kierunkowe (informatyka, inżynieria) lub równoważne doświadczenie zdobyte w jednostkach technologicznych.

  • Minimum 5 lat komercyjnego doświadczenia w programowaniu.

  • Udokumentowane prowadzenie złożonych funkcjonalności od strony technicznej — od projektu po wdrożenie.

  • Bardzo dobra znajomość C# i .NET / .NET Core.

  • Zaawansowana znajomość Angulara i TypeScript.

  • Doświadczenie w pracy z chmurą publiczną (preferowany AWS).

  • Praktyczna znajomość CI/CD (np. GitHub Actions, Jenkins) oraz konteneryzacji (Docker).

  • Doświadczenie z narzędziami IaC (Terraform lub CloudFormation).

  • Proaktywność, samodzielność i umiejętność brania odpowiedzialności za złożone problemy.

Mile widziane

  • Znajomość bibliotek do zarządzania stanem (np. NgRx).

  • Doświadczenie z Angular Material.

  • Zaawansowana znajomość narzędzi testowych (Jasmine, Karma, Playwright, NUnit, xUnit).

Co oferujemy

  • Pracę w przyjaznym, współpracującym środowisku, w którym innowacje są realnie wdrażane.

  • Konkurencyjne wynagrodzenie i atrakcyjny pakiet benefitów.

  • Możliwość rozwoju zawodowego i wpływu na kierunek rozwoju produktu.

  • Pracę w pełni zdalną (home office) z elastycznym podejściem do organizacji pracy.

jobs.title: Agile Master / Agile Coach (m/w/d) - Remote (Deutschlandweit)
jobs.excerpt: Ein kleines Stück Papier mit Zahlen, die das Potenzial haben, ein Leben für immer zu verändern!
jobs.description:
Ein kleines Stück Papier mit Zahlen, die das Potenzial haben, ein Leben für immer zu verändern! Ok…ersetzten wir das Papier durch eine App und eine Person gegen 610.000+ Nutzer monatlich. This is our Business!

📌 Deine Mission

  • Als Agile Master / Agile Coach (m/w/d) hilfst du unseren Teams, wirkungsvoll zusammenzuarbeiten, ihre Arbeitsweisen kontinuierlich zu verbessern und auch in starken Wachstumsphasen fokussiert zu bleiben. Du entwickelst die agile Zusammenarbeit in unserem Development-Bereich weiter. Gleichzeitig unterstützt du Teams im gesamten Unternehmen dabei, Arbeitsweisen zu etablieren, die zu ihrem jeweiligen Kontext passen. Du schaffst Raum für Reflexion, löst Konflikte an Schnittstellen, verbesserst Prozesse und übersetzt Erkenntnisse in konkrete Veränderungen. So trägst du dazu bei, Next Lotto schnell und nachhaltig zu skalieren – mit klaren Verantwortlichkeiten, hoher Umsetzungskraft und starker teamübergreifender Zusammenarbeit.

  • ℹ️ Für diese Rolle benötigst du sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie fundierte, mehrjährige Erfahrung als Agile Master, Agile Coach, Scrum Master oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle.

🎯 Deine Aufgaben

  • Du unterstützt unsere Development-Teams dabei, ihre sprintbasierten Arbeitsweisen kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln und agile Routinen wirksam zu gestalten.

  • Du erkennst Konflikte, Impediments und Abhängigkeiten in der Zusammenarbeit frühzeitig. Bei übergreifenden Themen bindest du die richtigen Stakeholder ein.

  • Du konzipierst und moderierst Retrospektiven, Team-Workshops und cross-funktionale Alignment-Formate im Development sowie in ausgewählten weiteren Bereichen.

  • Du coachst Product-Rollen und Teammitglieder in pragmatischen agilen Methoden, Selbstorganisation, wirksamer Zusammenarbeit und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung.

  • Du unterstützt ausgewählte Organisationsentwicklungs- und Skalierungsinitiativen mit Facilitation und methodischer Expertise.

  • Du stellst sicher, dass aus Retrospektiven und Workshops konkrete Maßnahmen, klare Verantwortlichkeiten und ein konsequentes Follow-up entstehen.

  • Du entwickelst schlanke, wiederverwendbare Formate, Templates und Working Agreements, die eine wirksame Zusammenarbeit auch während unseres schnellen Wachstums unterstützen.

🚀 Deine Kompetenzen (Hard Skills)

Must-have

  • Du verfügst über fundierte Praxiserfahrung mit agilen Prinzipien und Frameworks, insbesondere Scrum.

  • Du hast nachweislich Sprint-Events, Retrospektiven, Team-Workshops und cross-funktionale Arbeitsformate in internationalen Remote-Teams moderiert.

  • Du bringst ein breites methodisches Repertoire für Retrospektiven, Prozessverbesserung, Konfliktklärung, Teamentwicklung, Root-Cause-Analysen und gemeinsame Entscheidungsfindung mit.

  • Du hast nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Begleitung von Softwareentwicklungs- oder digitalen Produktentwicklungsteams.

  • Du verfügst über ein fundiertes Verständnis von Softwareentwicklungsprozessen, Product Discovery, Release-Prozessen, Qualitätssicherung und technischen Abhängigkeiten.

  • Du kannst die Wirksamkeit von Teams und Prozessen sowohl anhand qualitativer Beobachtungen als auch relevanter Delivery- und Workflow-Daten bewerten.

  • Du arbeitest sicher mit digitalen Kollaborations- und Facilitation-Tools wie GitLab, Notion, Miro, Slack und Google Workspace.

  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch – schriftlich wie mündlich.

Nice-to-have

  • Du verfügst über eine Zertifizierung als Professional Scrum Master, Certified ScrumMaster, Agile Coach, im Bereich Kanban oder über eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

  • Du hast bereits in einem schnell wachsenden Start-up oder Scale-up gearbeitet.

  • Du bringst Erfahrung in der Organisationsentwicklung oder in der Begleitung von Veränderungsprozessen mit.

  • Du hast bereits OKR-Prozesse, Quartalsplanungen oder Portfolio-Priorisierungen moderiert.

💡Deine Soft Skills

  • Pragmatische Flexibilität: Du wendest agile Frameworks nicht dogmatisch an. Du verstehst die dahinterliegenden Prinzipien und passt Methoden gezielt an das jeweilige Problem, Team und Umfeld an.

  • Konfliktfähigkeit: Du erkennst schwierige Dynamiken, Konflikte, unklare Verantwortlichkeiten und ineffektive Routinen – und sprichst sie direkt und respektvoll an.

  • Wenig Ego, hohe Glaubwürdigkeit: Du baust Vertrauen durch Eigenverantwortung, Verlässlichkeit, Kompetenz und wirksame Impulse auf – nicht durch formale Autorität.

  • Klarheit und Umsetzungsstärke: Du übersetzt komplexe Diskussionen in klare Entscheidungen, Verantwortlichkeiten und konkrete nächste Schritte – und stellst sicher, dass diese umgesetzt werden.

  • Anpassungsfähigkeit und Resilienz: Du behältst auch in einem schnell wachsenden Umfeld mit wechselnden Strukturen, Prioritäten und Teamkonstellationen den Überblick und bleibst handlungsfähig.

  • Gespür für den Kontext: Du verstehst, dass Development-, Operations- und Marketing-Teams unterschiedliche Arbeitsweisen und Lösungsansätze benötigen.

🏆 Deine Ziele in dieser Rolle (Impact)

  • Delivery im Development stärken: Du etablierst klare, wirksame und verlässlich gelebte Sprint-Routinen in den relevanten Development-Teams – von Planning und Reviews bis zu Retrospektiven und konsequentem Follow-up.

  • Wirksamkeit unserer Teams erhöhen: Du hilfst Development-Teams, zentrale Impediments frühzeitig zu erkennen und gezielt zu lösen. So schaffst du klarere Verantwortlichkeiten, eine verlässlichere Zusammenarbeit und weniger wiederkehrende Prozessblockaden.

  • Zusammenarbeit über Development hinaus skalieren: Du konzipierst und moderierst ausgewählte Retrospektiven und Workshops für Operations, Marketing sowie cross-funktionale Teams und Projekte – pragmatisch und passend zum jeweiligen Kontext.

  • Cross-funktionale Zusammenarbeit verbessern: Du machst wiederkehrende Impediments und Konflikte an den Schnittstellen zwischen Development, Product, Marketing, Operations und weiteren Bereichen sichtbar. Gemeinsam mit den Beteiligten entwickelst und implementierst du konkrete Verbesserungen.

  • Teams zur Selbstorganisation befähigen: Du befähigst Leads und Teams, ausgewählte Routinen selbstständig durchzuführen – mit praxistauglichen Formaten, Coaching, Facilitation-Guidance und wiederverwendbaren Workshop-Templates.

🎓 Dein Background – Ausbildung & Erfahrung

  • Du bringst mindestens 2-3 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung als Scrum Master, Agile Master, Agile Coach, Team Coach oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit.

  • Du hast agile Softwareentwicklungs- oder digitale Produktteams über einen längeren Zeitraum hands-on begleitet.

  • Du hast Retrospektiven, Workshops und Verbesserungsprozesse in einem Remote-Setting eigenständig konzipiert und moderiert.

  • Du hast praktische Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Stakeholdergruppen – idealerweise aus Development beziehungsweise Engineering, Product und Operations.

  • Erfahrung in einem Start-up, Scale-up, einer Produktorganisation oder einem ähnlich dynamischen Umfeld ist von Vorteil.

Das Team

🪴Unsere Werte:

We are seeking a highly experienced Lead ASIC DFT Engineer to architect, implement, verify, and debug advanced DFT solutions for complex ASIC and SoC designs. This role requires deep technical ownership across DFT architecture, scan insertion, ATPG, MBIST/LBIST, JTAG, boundary scan, and post-silicon validation, along with the ability to lead cross-functional debug efforts and drive resolution of critical silicon issues.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on expertise in DFT fundamentals, fault models, test coverage, diagnosis, and debug, as well as the ability to evaluate and adopt emerging DFT methodologies and architecture schemes to improve robustness, quality, and yield

Requirements

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience in ASIC DFT with end-to-end ownership.
  • Solid understanding of DFT fundamentals, fault models, test techniques, and test coverage concepts.
  • Deep expertise in scan architecture, ATPG, MBIST, LBIST, JTAG, boundary scan, and silicon debug.
  • Hands-on experience with Synopsys, Cadence, and Siemens/Mentor EDA tools.
  • Proven experience in scan insertion, ATPG setup, simulation, debug, and DRC analysis.
  • Experience with MBIST implementation and verification; SMS experience preferred.
  • Experience with scan architecture and scan chain stitching; Tessent/SSN experience preferred.
  • Strong understanding of PLLs, RTL design, synthesis flows, logical equivalence checking (LEC), and physical design implementation.
  • Proven post-silicon debug and silicon bring-up experience.
  • Exposure to large SoC designs, hierarchical DFT flows, and multi-domain integration challenges.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work independently with minimal ramp-up.

jobs.description:
Role Purpose

The Strategic Account Executive exists to drive Omilia's enterprise revenue growth in the North American market by winning and expanding high-value, strategically important accounts. The role is the primary commercial owner of a portfolio of Fortune 500 and Global 2000 target accounts, responsible for creating, advancing, and closing complex multi-stakeholder opportunities for Omilia's AI-powered contact center automation platform. Operating at the intersection of enterprise sales, executive relationship management, and solution selling, this individual brings deep credibility in the CX and conversational AI space to articulate and defend Omilia's differentiated value proposition. The Strategic Account Executive is expected to be a high-performing, self-directed revenue contributor who consistently exceeds targets and raises the commercial bar for the North American sales organization.

Accountabilities

  • Own the full enterprise sales cycle for strategic accounts in the North American market, from initial engagement through close and expansion.
  • Drive net-new revenue by acquiring and growing high-value enterprise accounts aligned with Omilia's Ideal Customer Profile across banking, healthcare, insurance, and utilities sectors.
  • Build and maintain executive-level relationships (C-suite, VP of CX, VP of IT, COO) within target accounts, positioning Omilia as the preferred AI-powered contact center automation partner.
  • Develop and execute account strategies, territory plans, and pipeline forecasts that meet or exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets.
  • Act as the primary commercial authority for your accounts, coordinating cross-functional resources — Solution Consulting, Professional Services, Customer Success, Legal — to ensure successful outcomes.
  • Represent the voice of the customer internally, contributing market and competitive intelligence to product, marketing, and leadership to influence go-to-market strategy.

Key Responsibilities

Pipeline Development & Prospecting

  • Prospect and qualify enterprise opportunities through a combination of outbound activity, partner referrals, marketing-sourced leads, and executive networking.
  • Build and maintain a self-generated pipeline of 3–4x quarterly quota coverage, with a disciplined focus on ICP accounts in banking, insurance, healthcare, and utilities.
  • Map target accounts across multiple buying centers (CX, IT, Operations, Procurement, Finance) and identify the right entry points for executive engagement.
  • Leverage intent data, industry event calendars, and partner ecosystems (system integrators, CCaaS vendors) to identify in-market opportunities at the earliest possible stage.
  • Develop and execute territory plans on a quarterly basis, aligning prospecting activity to revenue goals and reporting progress to VP of North American Enterprise Sales.

Discovery & Solution Positioning

  • Lead structured discovery engagements to diagnose prospect pain points, map decision-making structures, and define compelling business cases tied to measurable ROI.
  • Translate prospect challenges (containment rates, AHT, agent attrition, digital deflection) into quantified value narratives anchored to Omilia's platform outcomes.
  • Position Omilia's full portfolio — OCP, miniApps, Diamant, Pathfinder, CoPilot, Agentic Self-Learning — in the context of each prospect's specific automation maturity and technology stack.
  • Facilitate executive alignment sessions, including live demos, proof-of-concept scoping, and outcome-based business reviews, in partnership with Solution Consulting.
  • Identify competitive displacement opportunities where prospects are running on legacy IVR, competing conversational AI platforms, or in-house NLU builds.

Deal Execution & Stakeholder Management

  • Develop and present executive-level proposals, RFP responses, and solution overviews in collaboration with Solution Consulting and Pre-Sales Engineering.
  • Manage complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles (typically 6–18 months) involving procurement, IT, legal, compliance, and CX/operations teams.
  • Orchestrate internal deal teams — Pre-Sales, Legal, Deal Desk, Finance — to structure proposals that meet prospect requirements while protecting Omilia's margin and risk posture.
  • Navigate procurement and vendor assessment processes, including security reviews, RFP/RFI responses, and SOC 2 / HIPAA / PCI-DSS compliance questionnaires.
  • Build and maintain multi-threaded relationships at each strategic account, ensuring no deal is dependent on a single sponsor or champion.
  • Anticipate and resolve deal-level obstacles — budget cycles, internal champion transitions, competitive re-evaluations — with proactive stakeholder engagement and creative commercial structuring.

Commercial Negotiation & Contracting

  • Negotiate commercial terms, contract structures, and SLA agreements in alignment with Omilia's pricing and deal desk guidelines.
  • Structure multi-year, value-based subscription and platform agreements that align to prospect ROI expectations and Omilia's ARR growth objectives.
  • Partner with Deal Desk and Legal on Master Services Agreements, DPAs, and order forms, ensuring commercial velocity without exposing Omilia to unacceptable contractual risk.
  • Apply judgment on discounting, payment terms, and contract flexibility within approved parameters, escalating to VP-level for exceptions.

CRM Hygiene & Revenue Forecasting

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date opportunity and account data in CRM (Salesforce), including pipeline stage, close dates, deal size, and activity logs.
  • Provide a rigorous, data-supported weekly forecast to the VP of North American Enterprise Sales, with explicit risk and upside commentary per opportunity.
  • Contribute to monthly and quarterly business reviews with pipeline trend analysis, competitive intelligence, and win/loss learnings.
  • Ensure all discovery, demo, and negotiation activity is logged in Salesforce in real time to enable accurate territory and business planning.

Customer Expansion & Retention

  • Collaborate with Customer Success and Professional Services at handoff to ensure a smooth transition and set the foundation for long-term account expansion.
  • Identify and develop upsell and cross-sell opportunities within the existing customer base, growing account ARR through adoption of additional Omilia miniApps, modules, and services.
  • Conduct periodic strategic account reviews with key customers, positioning new capabilities (Agentic Self-Learning, Pathfinder, CoPilot) as the customer's automation roadmap matures.
  • Act as executive sponsor and internal advocate for strategic accounts, ensuring post-sale commitments are met and renewal risk is identified and mitigated early.

Market Presence & Brand Representation

  • Participate in field marketing events, industry conferences (e.g., CCW, CX Summit, Money 20/20), and executive briefings to strengthen brand presence and generate pipeline.
  • Represent Omilia's thought leadership on conversational AI, CX automation, and voice biometrics in prospect and partner engagements.
  • Contribute competitive and market intelligence back to Product, Marketing, and Sales leadership to inform roadmap and go-to-market strategy.

Requirements

Knowledge, Skills & Experience

Required:

  • 7+ years of enterprise B2B SaaS sales experience, with at least 3 years in a quota-carrying role targeting Fortune 500 / Global 2000 accounts.
  • Demonstrated track record of consistently achieving or exceeding annual revenue quotas of $1M+ ARR.
  • Experience selling complex technology solutions into the contact center, CX automation, or conversational AI space is strongly preferred.
  • Expertise in enterprise sales methodologies (MEDDIC, MEDDPICC, Challenger Sale, or equivalent) and disciplined pipeline management.
  • Ability to engage and influence senior executive stakeholders (CxO, VP-level) in business-outcome-driven conversations.
  • Strong commercial acumen — ability to build and present ROI models, TCO analyses, and business cases tailored to enterprise buying committees.
  • Experience navigating complex procurement, compliance, and legal processes in regulated industries (banking, healthcare, insurance preferred).
  • Proficiency with Salesforce CRM and modern sales enablement tools (Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Gong, or equivalents).
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; able to author compelling executive narratives and present with confidence to large audiences.
  • Self-directed and highly organized; able to manage 15–25 concurrent enterprise opportunities across multiple deal stages without sacrificing quality.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).

Nice to have:

  • Experience with AI, NLU, or speech technology platforms (e.g., Nuance, Google CCAI, AWS Connect, or similar).
  • Existing executive-level network in banking, insurance, healthcare, or utilities sectors in North America.
  • Familiarity with CCaaS platforms (Genesys, NICE, Avaya, Cisco) and how they integrate with conversational AI solutions.
  • MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification.

Omilia Note

- Contribute actively and effectively as an integrated team member.
- Act as an Omilia ambassador in all interactions.

We are looking for a highly skilled Materials Science Expert to contribute to an AI training project involving computational materials science, materials modeling, scientific simulation, and Python.

The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating engineering tasks related to material structures, properties, processing, performance, and failure. A representative task may require constructing a material or atomic model, configuring and running a simulation, calculating relevant properties, analyzing the resulting outputs, and determining whether the solution is computationally valid and physically meaningful.

This role requires both strong materials expertise and experience using engineering or scientific tools programmatically. Experience limited exclusively to graphical user interfaces will not be sufficient, as task solutions must be reproducible through code, scripts, configuration files, or command-line tools.

What You’ll Work On

  1. Solve and validate computational materials-science and materials-engineering problems.
  2. Create material structures, atomic configurations, compositions, and solver-ready inputs.
  3. Model relationships between composition, structure, processing, properties, and performance.
  4. Run atomistic, electronic-structure, molecular-dynamics, continuum, electrochemical, or related simulations.
  5. Use Python to generate inputs, automate calculations, conduct parameter sweeps, process results, and validate outputs.
  6. Analyze mechanical, thermal, electrical, chemical, structural, or electrochemical properties.
  7. Diagnose failed calculations, invalid structures, convergence problems, numerical instability, and incorrect physical assumptions.
  8. Compare computational results with experimental data, literature values, known properties, or expected physical trends.
  9. Review AI-generated solutions for scientific correctness and identify invalid assumptions, configurations, or conclusions.
  10. Develop reproducible reference solutions and objective verification methods.

Required Qualifications

  1. An MS or PhD in Materials Science and Engineering, Metallurgy, or a closely related discipline; or

  3. Strong understanding of materials behavior and relevant structure-property relationships.
  4. Experience with computational materials modeling, simulation, characterization, or materials-focused engineering analysis.
  5. Practical proficiency with Python.
  6. Experience with at least one engineering or scientific tool that can be operated through a CLI, scripting interface, configuration files, or programmatic API.
  7. Ability to understand and justify modeling assumptions, parameters, approximations, and convergence criteria.
  8. Ability to distinguish computational failures from genuine physical behavior.
  9. Ability to explain complex scientific reasoning and technical limitations clearly.

Relevant tools may include LAMMPS, ASE, pymatgen, Quantum ESPRESSO, FEniCSx, CalculiX, Elmer, PyBaMM, or similar programmatic materials and simulation software. Experience with an equivalent CLI-accessible tool is acceptable.

Relevant Python tools may include NumPy, SciPy, pandas, Matplotlib, Jupyter, atomistic modeling packages, materials informatics libraries, or domain-specific scientific tools. No single library is mandatory.

Experience may come from academic research, national laboratories, industry R&D, computational engineering, or other demonstrated materials work.

Process

  2. Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.
  3. Complete a technical assessment, if required.
  4. Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.

Minimum submission requirements apply.

Start Timeline & Availability

jobs.description:
Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.

We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space.

We operate across 3 business segments:

Corporate Secretary: Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations

Accounting & Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service

FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses

Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 17,500 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 600 staff with an intact startup mindset. We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia. Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia Pacific.

Requirements

Mission of the role
To deliver accurate, timely, and compliant bookkeeping for a diverse portfolio of UK clients (VAT and non-VAT). Reporting to the Senior Accountant feeding into the Accounts Manager, this role ensures all financial records are consistently up-to-date, hitting critical deadlines while providing high-quality support to the wider accounting team.

Key outcomes in the first 6–12 months

  • Outcome 1: Maintain Flawless Xero Records — Ensure all client transactions are fully recorded, allocated, and perfectly reconciled in Xero within target deadlines.
  • Outcome 2: Build Client Relationships — Establish strong, trusting relationships with your client portfolio, ensuring smooth communication and the timely collection of required financial documents.
  • Outcome 3: Support the Accounts Team — Seamlessly integrate with the UK team, reliably assisting the Senior Accountant and Accounting Manager to ensure all departmental targets and statutory deadlines are met.
  • Outcome 4: Drive Bookkeeping Efficiency — Identify process bottlenecks and proactively implement smarter ways of working to increase efficiency and speed across your portfolio's bookkeeping workflows.

Must-have experience

  • UK Tax & Compliance: Proven track record handling both VAT returns and non-VAT registered clients.
  • Multi-Industry Exposure: Broad bookkeeping experience across a wide variety of business sectors.
  • E-commerce Expertise: Specific, demonstrable experience managing the complexities of e-commerce bookkeeping (e.g., handling payment gateways, multi-channel sales, inventory).
  • Language Proficiency: Exceptional, grammatically correct written and spoken English (essential for an overseas hire managing direct UK client communications).
  • Software: Strong proficiency in Xero.

Must-have attributes

  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: Spots errors instantly and takes pride in 100% accurate data entry and reconciliations.
  • Highly Organized & Deadline-Driven: Capable of juggling multiple clients at once without letting turnaround times slip.
  • Proactive & Self-Motivated: Because this is an overseas role, they must be a self-starter who doesn't need to be micro-managed to get the work done.
  • Adaptable: Quick to learn and comfortable switching gears between completely different industries (e.g., jumping from an e-commerce client to a construction client).
  • Clear Communicator: Confident enough to ask the right questions when information is missing, and polite but firm when chasing clients for paperwork.

Behavioural fit is also important at Sleek, and we will be looking for candidates that have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

  • Ownership: This shows reliability and helps build trust within the team. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us.
  • Humility: There is so much we don't know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self awareness and emotional intelligence.
  • Structured Thinking: Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you're more analytical or creative in nature, being able to show sound judgement is important to us. It ensures solutions are pragmatic and balance the needs of the organisation, team and customers.
  • Attention to detail: You'll be managing multiple, complex workstreams from numerous stakeholders. It will be important for you to keep track of everything and notice when information is missing or inconsistent.
  • Excellent listener and clear communicator: We have a variety of nationalities and for many people, English isn't their first language. For you to excel, you'll need to be present in your calls and make sure you properly receive and thoughtfully send messages to others in the business.

The interview process

  • TA Screening Call: A 30 minute call with our Talent Acquisition team
  • Live Technical Assessment: A ~60–90 minute live skills test to assess your hands-on bookkeeping capability.
  • Soft Skills Interview: A ~15-30 minute interview with the hiring team to evaluate real-world work scenarios against our core behavioural values.
  • Reference Verification: Prior to final offer confirmation, we will conduct one professional reference check with your recent direct manager or supervisor. To keep the process moving smoothly, this step may be initiated during the final interview stages.

Requirement for background screening Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role. This may include using external vendors to verify:

  • Your education
  • Any criminal history
  • Any political exposure
  • Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation. By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at Sleek.com.

Benefits

Some other great things about working at Sleek…

Humility and kindness: Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.

Flexibility: You'll be able to work remotely. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we don't mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate. You can also work fully remote from anywhere in the world for 1 month each year.

Financial benefits: We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region.

Personal growth: You'll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so you'll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. There's also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. We're also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional.

Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Since we started our journey in 2017, we've been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, we've joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben & Jerry's, and P&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy.

jobs.description:
a bit about the role

British Rowing (BR) is the national governing body of the sport of rowing. An important part of its role is dealing with safeguarding concerns and disciplinary matters as they arise. To that end, from time to time BR refers matters to independent Panels convened under the terms of its Safeguarding Regulations and Disciplinary Rules. BR wishes to recruit a collection of experienced, independent individuals available to be appointed to its Safeguarding Panels by the Case Management Group (CMG).

BR via the Safeguarding Committee are now seeking applications to join the Safeguarding Panel. Applications are sought from safeguarding professionals, legally qualified or suitably experienced individuals Safeguarding Panel. Whilst this recruitment focuses on the Safeguarding Panel, suitably qualified individuals may sit on both Panels.

a bit about you

Responsibilities

Three person, independent Panels will be asked to sit on cases which arise inside of rowing. Cases based on behaviours outside of rowing are related to safeguarding and transferable risk. The key skills required of Panel members are set out below, however full training will be provided prior to sitting on any panels and ongoing training is also offered.


BR’s Regulations and Rules determine that all Panels must be chaired by a suitably legally qualified individual and that a Written Judgment be produced by the Panel on conclusion of the case. Current case load indicates that Panel members would need to provide availability for four to six Panels a year and members are asked to sit on cases on an ad hoc basis. A degree of flexibility is therefore required. Please note this is a voluntary role and as such there is no remuneration.


Person Specifications

  • A nationally recognised professional qualification requiring expertise and skills in the safeguarding of children or adults at risk, and/or management of offenders; and/or

  • A minimum of five years’ experience of working in a safeguarding role

  • Recent experience of sitting on safeguarding tribunals, panels or case management groups which have powers to decide on the suitability of individuals to work with children, young people, and adults at risk;

  • Recent experience of undertaking safeguarding risk assessments of individuals’ suitability to work with children, young people and adults at risk;

  • A basic knowledge of employment law and other relevant legislation which concerns equality, disability discrimination, human rights law, and the safeguarding of children young people and adults at risk;

  • An understanding and appreciation of the impact which abusive or discriminatory behaviour can have on children and young people including the additional vulnerability to abuse and exploitation of some young people;

  • An understanding and appreciation of behaviour which is indicative of ‘grooming’ with the intention to abuse or exploit a child or young person;

  • An understanding and appreciation of the support required for vulnerable witnesses and those accused of unsafe practice in work with children, young people and adults at risk;

  • Ability to work alongside other professionals;

  • Ability to assess and analyse a variety of evidence both written and in other forms;

  • Knowledge of best practice in conducting disciplinary proceedings and in particular those of sports governing bodies.

  • It is desirable that candidates have recent experience of chairing tribunals, panels or case management groups which have powers to decide on the suitability of individuals to work with children, young people or vulnerable adults.

mandatory requirements

  • Expressed commitment to complete a minimum of four hours of relevant continued professional development training each year; and

  • Applications will also be measured against current and potential needs of the Panel so as to fill gaps in experience and/or to meet diversity requirements.

what we offer

This is a volunteer role

additional information

Panel hearings are conducted online. Panel members will be asked to undergo training from time to time and membership of the Panels is pro bono in a voluntary capacity.

Applications should address the candidate’s interest in the role, sporting governance or the sport of rowing and the criteria outlined above. Rowing seeks to be an ever more diverse sport and BR aims to appoint Panel members that reflect the diversity of its members.

jobs.title: Senior SEO Specialist – Local & Content
jobs.excerpt: Heads up before you go further: a video application is required to be considered.
jobs.description:
Heads up before you go further: a video application is required to be considered.

We'll explain it in detail at the bottom, but here's the short version: this is a high-investment role and we filter hard. Resume + a short video interview through HireFlix. Both required. No video, no consideration.

👉 Start your video application here👈

Who this is for

This role is for the SEO who's tired of building strategies that get watered down by committee, tired of waiting three months for someone to approve a content brief, tired of doing great work that gets buried inside a giant agency client roster.

You'll work directly with the founder. When you spot an opportunity, you can act on it. When you have a strong opinion about how something should be done, you'll be heard. The work you ship in your first 90 days will visibly move the business, and you'll be able to point to specific pages, specific links, and specific rankings and say "I did that."

If you want a role where you can put your head down, build a real content engine from scratch, and watch it compound month over month, this is it. If you want to manage other SEOs or sit in strategy meetings all day, this isn't.

About us

We're a residential plumbing company based in Orange County, California. We've built a strong brand serving homeowners across Southern California, and we're investing heavily in organic growth. This role is a key part of that investment.

What this role is

We're hiring a Senior SEO Specialist to own our content and link building strategy in-house. You'll be the SEO expert in the room, and you'll be expected to know more than the people you report to. We don't want someone we have to train. We want someone who's going to teach us things and push us to be better.

We are bringing this work in-house, which means no agency layer between you and the founder. You'll work directly with our CMO, our founder, and our Senior Web Developer to drive organic traffic, improve local rankings, and build a content engine that compounds over time.

How you work with the team

This role does not operate in isolation. You're one half of a tight in-house pair built specifically to scale our organic growth.

Senior Web Developer: Your closest day-to-day collaborator. They own the technical surface (page builds, performance, schema implementation, site architecture, GTM, GA4, Search Console error resolution). You own the strategy and the content that goes on the pages they build. Daily Slack collaboration, a weekly working session, and a clean handoff process for everything that touches both surfaces.

CMO: Strategic alignment, content priorities, performance review. You'll have a weekly working session with the CMO.

Founder: Direct communication when needed. The founder is engaged with this work, not buried two layers up.

What you'll own

Content production at scale. Researching, writing, and optimizing 4 to 6 publish-ready pieces per week, scaling to 6 to 8 once you're dialed in. This includes blog posts, service pages, location pages, and campaign landing pages. AI-assisted production is expected. We use Claude for drafting from briefs you build. You own the brief, the structure, the editorial review, and final QA. Pure AI-drafted content does not ship without your review.

Link building, full ownership. This is your domain end to end. Outreach, guest posting, digital PR, broken link building, HARO, manufacturer dealer pages, local sponsorships, competitor link gap analysis. You own the strategy, the targets, the outreach, the follow-up, and the reporting on what landed.

Content and on-page SEO strategy. Keyword research, topical authority building, content refreshes, content gap identification, competitor positioning. You set the editorial calendar.

Internal linking strategy. You own what links to what, anchor text, topical clusters, and content interconnection. The web developer owns the technical implementation and architecture that makes it scale.

Schema strategy. You decide what schema types we need, what fields, and what content goes in. The web developer handles JSON-LD implementation, structured data testing, and deployment. You review and confirm before it ships.

Local SEO. Location page strategy, citation management, NAP consistency, Local Pack ranking factors, and competitive positioning in our core OC markets. Google Business Profile execution currently sits with our marketing coordinator. As you ramp, GBP strategy and oversight will migrate to this role. Expect to absorb GBP within the first 90 days.

Strategic and content SEO audits. Link profile, content gaps, competitor positioning, on-page performance, topical authority. Technical issues you identify get flagged to the web developer for implementation. You're not expected to fix them yourself, but you should be able to identify them clearly enough that the developer can act.

Search Console analysis and reporting. Strategic interpretation of GSC data: query trends, ranking diagnostics, content gap identification, page-level performance. The developer owns error resolution and indexation issues. You own what the data is telling us about the business and what to do about it.

Performance reporting. Reporting is core to this role, not an afterthought. We need a clear weekly pulse and a substantive monthly read on the program.

Weekly tactical update (every Monday):

  • What shipped (pages, content, links earned)
  • Outreach status (emails sent, responses, links pending)
  • Ranking movement worth flagging (wins, drops, opportunities)
  • Anything blocking or pending decision
  • Plan for the coming week
  • Format: short. 5 to 10 minutes to read. Async in Slack or shared doc.

Monthly strategic review (first week of each month):

  • Organic traffic and engagement trends, month-over-month and year-over-year
  • Search visibility (click, impression, CTR, average position trends, plus query-level shifts)
  • Local Pack performance by city (rank tracking across our core OC markets)
  • Domain authority and backlink growth (DR, referring domains, new and lost links, competitive positioning)
  • Content output and performance (pages published, top performers, content that needs refresh)
  • Link building results (links earned, sub-track breakdown, outreach metrics)
  • Competitor movement (what our key OC competitors are doing that we should respond to)
  • Strategic recommendations (what to double down on, what to kill, what to test)

We are not handing you a template. A senior SEO knows how they want to present data better than any template can specify. What we will require is that every monthly report contains the sections above. Beyond that, the structure, visualizations, and commentary are yours. We will review your first monthly report together and lock the format from there.

What you need to have

  • 4+ years of hands-on SEO experience for B2C businesses. Home services experience is a big plus. We're not interested in B2B SaaS or enterprise SEO backgrounds.
  • Hands-on experience across the SEO reporting stack. You've used the major tools daily (GA4, Google Search Console, Ahrefs, SEMrush, BrightLocal, or equivalents). We're still finalizing our stack, so you should be tool-fluent rather than tool-dependent.
  • Proven link building experience. Real campaigns, real outreach, real results you can show us.
  • Content production at volume. You've personally researched, briefed, and edited 4+ pieces of publish-ready content per week. AI-assisted is fine. We expect it. What we don't accept is unreviewed AI output shipping as final.
  • Local SEO fundamentals. Google Business Profile, citation management, NAP consistency, location page strategy, Local Pack ranking factors. You know the local SEO playbook cold.
  • Strong written English. This is non-negotiable. You'll be writing content that homeowners read and editing AI-drafted content to a publish-ready standard.
  • Experience working Pacific Time Zone hours from wherever you're based. We're not interested in candidates who plan to flip their schedule for this role.
  • Reliable internet, a quiet workspace, and the ability to be on camera for team meetings.

A note on how we work

This is a 100% remote role. We don't use monitoring software and we don't micromanage. We trust our team to do excellent work and communicate proactively when something is off track.

That trust runs both ways. We expect you to show up, take ownership, and operate with high integrity. If you need help, ask. If you're stuck, say so. If you're ahead of schedule, find the next thing. We're hiring an adult, and we'll treat you like one.

This role is full-time. Not a side gig, not a weekend project, not something you stack with three other clients. Your full attention during business hours is part of what we're paying for.

Communication rhythm:

  • Daily async updates in Slack: what you shipped, what you're working on, anything blocking
  • Weekly working session with the CMO
  • Weekly working session with the Senior Web Developer to coordinate on schema, internal linking, page builds, and technical issues
  • We over-communicate by default. Silence is a flag, not a feature.

Decision authority:

We want you to ship without asking permission for things you should be empowered to ship.

  • What you can ship without approval: content briefs, on-page optimization, internal linking decisions, link building outreach, schema strategy recommendations, content calendar decisions, AI-assisted drafts that you've reviewed.
  • What needs CMO or founder approval: major topical pivots, link building budget commitments above $250 per item, sponsorships, paid placements, brand voice changes, anything that contradicts existing strategy documents.
  • Always loop in the developer on: schema specs before implementation, internal linking changes, page-level technical needs, anything affecting URL structure.

Hours and compensation

  • Full-time, 100% remote
  • Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific Time
  • One-hour lunch and two 10-minute breaks
  • $2,000 to $3,500 USD per month, depending on experience
  • Independent contractor role, paid through our global payroll partner

Reports to: CMO and Founder

Start date: Immediate

How to apply

We're filtering hard on this role. Generic applications will be ignored.

To be considered, you must submit both:

  1. Your resume through this BambooHR posting
  2. A short video interview through our HireFlix link

The video is short, four questions, about 15 minutes from your phone or laptop. A real person watches every video. No bots, no AI screening.

👉 Start your video application here👈

Applications without a completed video will not be reviewed. Resume alone is not enough.

If you're a finalist, we'll ask you for a custom screen-share video walking through your actual SEO workflow. That's the deep dive. The HireFlix video is the gate.

Salary: $2,000 to $3,500 USD per month, DOE, Remote. Pacific Time Zone.

jobs.description:
🚀 Únete al claustro de preparadores de Polaris x Ucademy

¿Eres ingeniero/a, economista o jurista en ADIF o preparas sus oposiciones de Cuadro Técnico y Técnico? Colabora en remoto con Polaris x Ucademy y ayuda a otros a entrar.

🚆 Buscamos preparadores/as para las oposiciones de ADIF

ADIF está en pleno relevo generacional y cada año convoca cientos de plazas de personal laboral fijo. Buscamos preparadores que conozcan el proceso por dentro para los perfiles de Personal Operativo.

🚆 Buscamos preparadores/as para las oposiciones de titulados de ADIF

ADIF convoca cada año plazas para titulados universitarios en dos grupos profesionales: Mando Intermedio y Cuadro (perfiles de Cuadro Técnico) y Técnico de la Estructura de Apoyo. Buscamos preparadores que conozcan estos procesos y puedan acompañar a opositores de una o varias especialidades relacionadas.

📚 Perfiles para los que buscamos preparadores

Con más plazas

Ingeniería Civil

  • Cuadro Técnico - Ingeniería Civil

  • Técnico de Ingeniería Civil

Ingeniería Industrial

  • Cuadro Técnico - Ingeniería Industrial

  • Técnico de Ingeniería Industrial

Economía y Gestión

  • Cuadro Técnico - Área de Gestión

  • Cuadro Técnico - Área Económica

  • Técnico de Gestión

  • Técnico de Economía

Otras especialidades

Ingeniería de Telecomunicación

  • Cuadro Técnico - Ingeniería de Telecomunicación

  • Técnico de Ingeniería de Telecomunicación

Jurídico

  • Cuadro Técnico - Área Jurídica

  • Técnico Jurídico

Informática

  • Cuadro Técnico - Ingeniería en Informática

  • Técnico Informático

Arquitectura y Edificación

  • Cuadro Técnico - Arquitectura Técnica y Edificación

  • Técnico de Arquitectura

Prevención de Riesgos Laborales

  • Cuadro Técnico - Prevención de Riesgos Laborales

No buscamos necesariamente un preparador distinto para cada perfil: si por tu especialidad y experiencia puedes preparar varios relacionados, cuéntanoslo.

🌟 Quiénes somos

En Polaris x Ucademy preparamos oposiciones de una forma más digital, práctica y personalizada. Ya hemos acompañado a miles de opositores y tenemos un objetivo claro: que 10.000 personas consigan su plaza preparándose con nosotros.

Para lograrlo, estamos ampliando nuestro claustro de preparadores de alto rendimiento.

Somos muy digitales, pero lo humano no se negocia. La tecnología nos ayuda a enseñar mejor, y son nuestros preparadores quienes aportan conocimiento, criterio, cercanía y acompañamiento.

🔎 A quién buscamos

  • Profesionales de ADIF que hayan superado el proceso de ingreso como Cuadro Técnico o Técnico, en cualquiera de las especialidades anteriores.

  • Preparadores/as con experiencia en estas oposiciones.

  • Especialistas en normativa del sector público y ferroviario: el temario común es el mismo para todos los perfiles y tiene un peso decisivo en el examen.

  • Personas capaces de preparar la entrevista profesional por competencias de los perfiles de Técnico.

  • Quienes sepan enseñar y acompañar a opositores con perfil universitario, muchas veces compatibilizando estudio y trabajo.

  • Soltura con herramientas digitales. Si ya utilizas IA en tu día a día, mucho mejor.

También buscamos especialistas en psicotécnicos e inglés (B1 y B2): son dos de las tres pruebas del examen y cada una exige una nota mínima.

🎯 En qué podrás colaborar

Según tu perfil y disponibilidad, podrás participar en uno o varios proyectos:

  • Clases online del temario común y de la parte específica.

  • Normativa del sector público y ferroviario explicada con casos reales de ADIF.

  • Psicotécnicos e inglés B1/B2 orientados al examen.

  • Preguntas tipo test y simulacros con el formato real.

  • Preparación de la entrevista profesional por competencias (perfiles de Técnico).

  • Orientación sobre baremo de méritos y elección de perfil entre Cuadro Técnico y Técnico.

  • Mentoring a opositores de tu especialidad y materiales: esquemas, resúmenes y vídeos cortos.

🤝 Cómo funciona la colaboración

No es un puesto de trabajo a jornada completa ni parcial. Colaborarás con Polaris x Ucademy mediante prestación de servicios en proyectos educativos concretos, compatible con tu actividad profesional.

Si trabajas en ADIF, no te pedimos que dejes tu puesto. Queremos que pongas tu experiencia al servicio de otros opositores de una forma flexible.

🌍 100 % remoto
🕐 Horarios y disponibilidad a convenir
📚 Proyectos y entregables definidos desde el inicio
💰 Compensación competitiva según el proyecto y los entregables

🎬 Cómo es el proceso de selección

Queremos conocerte enseñando, no solo leyendo tu CV. El proceso tiene tres pasos:

1. Revisión de perfil. En la candidatura responderás a unas preguntas breves y nos enviarás un vídeo de presentación de 1 minuto. Grábalo con el móvil, sin complicaciones: cuéntanos quién eres, tu especialidad y tu experiencia con ADIF.

2. Contacto de validación. Si tu perfil encaja, nos pondremos en contacto contigo por llamada o por escrito para resolver dudas, conocer tu disponibilidad y explicarte cómo colaboramos.

3. Clase de prueba y entrevista. Agendarás tu entrevista y, antes de la fecha, nos enviarás una clase grabada de máximo 5 minutos: la explicación de un contenido del temario, la resolución comentada de varias preguntas tipo test o cómo prepararías una pregunta de la entrevista por competencias, con un material de apoyo creado por ti. No buscamos una producción perfecta: queremos ver cómo explicas y cómo haces sencillo lo difícil.

Si conoces ADIF por dentro y quieres ayudar a otros titulados a conseguir su plaza, queremos conocerte.
