jobs.excerpt: Online werken als klinisch psycholoog in een team dat digitale zorg niet ziet als noodoplossing, maar als dé manier om het beter, slimmer en mensgerichter te doen.
jobs.description:
Online werken als klinisch psycholoog in een team dat digitale zorg niet ziet als noodoplossing, maar als dé manier om het beter, slimmer en mensgerichter te doen.
Geen wachtkamers of vaste kantoortijden, maar ruimte voor flexibel werken vanuit huis en volledig digitaal, zonder in te leveren op persoonlijk contact of kwaliteit. Bij de Digitale Poli maak je deel uit van een enthousiast team dat werkt aan snelle, doelgerichte zorg met oog voor herstel, veerkracht en zingeving. Je krijgt alle ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen én om mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van de GGZ.

Wat ga je doen?

Als klinisch psycholoog ben je regiebehandelaar binnen een multidisciplinair online team. Je voert zelfstandig psychotherapie en diagnostiek uit, met aandacht voor complexe problematiek. Je begeleidt basispsychologen en GZ-psychologen in opleiding, en draagt actief bij aan hun professionele groei.

Je werkt vanuit huis, maar staat er niet alleen voor: via dagelijks contact in overleggen en samenwerking binnen behandelingen blijf je verbonden met het team. Daarnaast lever je een inhoudelijke bijdrage aan de ontwikkeling van ons behandelaanbod en een inspirerende leeromgeving. Je taken bestaan onder andere uit: het voeren van intakes, opstellen en evalueren van behandelplannen, systeemgesprekken, deelnemen aan overleggen, uitvoeren van ROM-onderzoek en het ontwikkelen van (groeps)therapieën.

Wat hebben we jou te bieden?

Bij Altrecht heeft je werk betekenis: samen met bevlogen collega’s en een sterk netwerk van zorg- en kennispartners maak je écht verschil in de ggz. Je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te zijn, mee te denken en te groeien, als professional én als mens.

Je komt te werken in een organisatie vol mogelijkheden, met diverse (TopGGz) specialismen en meerdere werklocaties in en rondom Utrecht. We kijken naar jou als persoon, je ambities en je voorkeuren zoals behandelprogramma’s en woon-werkafstand. Samen vinden we de rol die het beste bij je past.

Daarnaast krijg je van ons:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 6.798,- tot € 9.442,- (FWG 75 in de cao GGZ) op basis van 36 uur per week.

  • Een volledige dertiende maand (8,33% eindejaarsuitkering) en 8,33% vakantiegeld.

  • 166 vakantie-uren en 35 levensfase-uren per jaar (o.b.v. 36 uur per week). Extra tijd voor jezelf? Je kunt tot 36 uur extra verlof bijkopen.

  • Een jaarlijks balansbudget. Je kunt het bedrag uit laten betalen, extra verlof kopen of het bedrag verhogen tot € 1.400,- als je het inzet voor een vrijetijdscursus.

  • Pensioenopbouw bij Pensioenfonds Zorg en Welzijn, collectieve inkomensverzekering en korting op aanvullende zorgverzekering (IZZ of Zilveren Kruis).

  • Alflex, ons meerkeuzesysteem voor extra arbeidsvoorwaarden. Kies bijv. voor een fiets, sportschoolabonnement of reiskostenvergoeding.

  • Ruimte en mogelijkheden voor (door)groei! Je kunt scholingen volgen bij de Altrecht Academie, deelnemen aan organisatiebrede kennis & expertisenetwerken, meewerken aan onderzoek of jezelf verder ontwikkelen in de praktijk, via opleidingen en intervisie.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent een klinisch psycholoog met een nieuwsgierige en innovatieve houding. Je ziet kansen in digitale zorg en durft te pionieren in een dynamisch en veranderend veld. Tegelijkertijd werk je zorgvuldig en zelfstandig, met een scherp oog voor complexe problematiek en het vermogen om regie te houden over behandelingen. Je gelooft in herstelgerichte zorg, werkt vanuit het gedachtegoed van positieve gezondheid en zet digitale middelen doelgericht in om écht van betekenis te zijn voor de cliënt.

Daarnaast ben je een echte teamspeler die collega’s weet te begeleiden en graag bijdraagt aan de ontwikkeling van ons behandelaanbod. Je hebt ervaring met individuele en groepsbehandelingen, blijft rustig in hectiek en schakelt snel wanneer dat nodig is. Je staat stevig in je schoenen, bent BIG-geregistreerd als klinisch psycholoog – of je bent bijna klaar met je opleiding – en je herkent jezelf in onze kernwaarden: passend, vertrouwen, verbindend en (veer)krachtig.

Daarnaast herken jij jezelf in onze kernwaarden: passend, vertrouwen, verbindend en (veer-)krachtig.

Wie zijn wij?

De Digitale Poli is een innovatieve behandelomgeving waar we volledig online zorg bieden aan mensen met angst-, trauma-, stemmings- en persoonlijkheidsproblematiek. Met beeldbellen, chat en interactieve modules bieden we intensieve behandelingen die flexibel én persoonlijk zijn, en altijd afgestemd op de behoefte van de cliënt.

Onze aanpak is gebaseerd op het gedachtegoed van positieve gezondheid: we kijken breder dan klachten en diagnoses en richten ons op veerkracht, zingeving en dagelijks functioneren. Vanuit een transdiagnostische visie werken we evidence-based én mensgericht, in nauwe samenwerking met verschillende afdelingen binnen Altrecht. Zo bieden we snelle, toegankelijke en effectieve zorg, waarbij de eigen regie van de cliënt centraal staat. Als professional krijg je hier de kans om mee te bouwen aan nieuwe digitale behandeltechnieken, onderzoek te doen en zo bij te dragen aan toegankelijke, toekomstbestendige en effectieve ggz – mét behoud van menselijk contact, ook online.

Enthousiast en nu?

Solliciteer eenvoudig via de onderstaande button! Wil je eerst meer weten? Stuur gerust een berichtje of bel met Senada Nikocevic, teammanager, via 06-83110133.

Je bent ook van harte welkom voor een oriënterend gesprek, zodat je de sfeer bij ons kunt ervaren. We kijken ernaar uit om van je te horen!

Goed om te weten

  • Een dagdeel meelopen kan onderdeel uitmaken van de sollicitatieprocedure. Zo leren wij elkaar beter kennen.

  • Acquisitie op basis van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

About the role

As Director, Image Analysis & Radiopharmaceutical Therapy, you will provide integrated scientific and management leadership across imaging-driven clinical trials, providing scientific guidance on development of modelling, analysis design, results interpretation and dosimetry techniques to clinical trials. You are accountable for both the scientific integrity and end-to-end delivery of image analysis data supporting multi-center trials, including Radiopharmaceutical Therapy (RPT) and advanced imaging modalities such as PET/SPECT and MRI. People & Functional Leadership

  • ​Ensure succession planning and skills readiness for critical roles.
  • Provide insight and develop business cases to support financial planning and decision‑making for investment priorities, capacity planning, and resourcing discussions.

Stakeholder Relationship Management

  • Serve as the primary scientific and delivery point of contact for external stakeholders for Image Analysis and RPT capabilities.
  • Translate scientific and operational requirements into executable strategies.
  • Lead scientific consultation, delivery assurance discussions, issue resolution, and interpretation of results.
  • Translate scientific and operational requirements into executable approaches.
  • Facilitates business decision-making processes.  
  • Represent Image Analysis and RPT capabilities in internal governance, prioritization, planning and strategic forums.

Other

Functional Competencies (Technical knowledge/Skills)

  • ​Demonstrable knowledge of nuclear medicine imaging.
  • Demonstrable knowledge of relevant scientific terminology and practices.

  • Technical proficiency in image analysis and associated software platforms.
  • Proven ability in other software packages (Microsoft Office, Matlab, etc).

  • Wholistic understanding of data delivery processes.
  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • Must have the ability to work methodically in a fast-paced, time-sensitive environment.
  • Demonstratable ability to apply critical thinking to problems and tasks.
  • Ability to identify and implement process improvements, including management of stakeholders.

  • Excellent mentor who can foster professional development and growth of their team.

  • Organized leader and mentor with the ability to identify the appropriate leadership style to manage the individuals in their team.
  • Financial management and acumen, with an ability to strictly manage a complex and large budget to a demanding target.
  • ​Maintains an up-to-date awareness of trends, tools, technology, techniques and processes that affect image analysis technology within the Life sciences domain and how it affects customers adopting our products.

Experience, Education, and Certifications

  • Significant demonstrable experience in both academic and/or industrial instrumentation/ image processing environments.
  • ​Demonstrable experience in image analysis; key focus on modelling and dosimetry techniques.
  • Proven line management and leadership ability in the same or similar role.
  • ​Solid proven experience of working in and knowledge of medical imaging or clinical development in the life sciences industry.
  • ​Experience using both knowledge and tools to communicate progress to Stakeholders and credibly represent the business.
  • ​Bachelor's Degree (Medical degree/ PhD) in a quantitative field, ideally

jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for mobile developers to build BJAK's AI Neobank App across Android and iOS.

This role is for strong mobile builders who can ship clean, reliable and intuitive mobile experiences, whether their main strength is Android, iOS or both.

What You'll Own

  • Build and ship mobile features for Android and/or iOS.

  • Create simple mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services.

  • Work with product, design and backend teams to turn complex journeys into usable mobile products.

  • Integrate APIs and handle edge cases, loading states, errors and production issues.

  • Improve app performance, reliability, crash rate and user experience.

  • Support fast product launches, experiments and iterations across mobile journeys.

  • Help set high standards for mobile product quality across the app.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of mobile development experience in Android, iOS or both.

  • Strong experience with Kotlin and/or Swift.

  • Experience shipping production apps used by real users.

  • Strong product sense and attention to mobile UX.

  • Able to work with APIs, analytics, crash logs and production feedback.

  • Fast, practical and comfortable owning work with limited handholding.

  • App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks like a product builder, not just a mobile coder.

  • Cares about smooth flows, small details and real user behaviour.

  • Can work across ambiguity and ship without waiting for perfect specs.

  • Takes production quality personally.

  • Honest about what they built directly versus what the wider team delivered.

This Role Is Not For

  • Developers who only want to build isolated screens.

  • People who do not care about UX, performance or reliability.

  • People who need heavy guidance for every task.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Poland. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Poland.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  2. Role-specific interview

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Lost Time Workers' Compensation claims handling experience in Kentucky is strongly preferred and Nebraska and Minnesota would be a plus.

The position reports to the Director, Workers' Compensation Claims. We may hire a senior level depending on the candidate's background and experience and the salary range is inclusive of all levels.

Are you a Referral?

If you know a current Encova Insurance associate and would like to apply as a referral, please encourage them to submit your referral information before you submit your application. You will receive an email with a direct URL link to the Job Posting of interest. Applying through this URL link will create your referral relationship for our Talent Acquisition Team.

Unique residence requirements are listed in each job posting, please review closely for details.

Encova is only able to employ associates who reside and work within specific U.S. states. Our current policies are based on the laws in states in which we are registered for payroll. Our current footprint includes:

Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kentucky, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Jersey, North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, West Virginia, Wisconsin.


JOB OBJECTIVE:

The Lost Time Claims Specialist, Workers’ Compensation primarily manages indemnity claims. The Lost Time Claims Specialist is responsible for the investigation, evaluation, and determination of compensability for work-related injury and disease claims following established guidelines to determine benefit eligibility. The Lost Time Claims Specialist also serves as a resource to Medical Only Claims Specialists and Claims Specialist Trainees. The position’s objective is to provide superior service in a cost-effective manner to achieve best possible outcomes as well as proactively collaborate across the enterprise to ensure alignment of objectives and foster continuous improvement.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
1. Evaluates and establishes an action plan to manage medical and indemnity benefits associated with injury and occupational disease claims to their most cost- effective conclusion.
2. Decides the outcome of the claim using sound judgment by applying established policy, procedures, regulations and guidelines.
3. Gathers facts by conducting interviews with all involved parties and considers all the elements of the claim prior to issuing a decision.
4. Take recorded statements when necessary.
5. Determines eligibility of indemnity and medical benefits once salary information and medical treatment plans have been secured and processed within the designated authority levels.
6. Utilize proactive reserving behaviors to ensure adequate case reserves which reflect the probable ultimate outcome based on the current known circumstances throughout the life of the claim.
7. Actively identifies and develops the investigation of and pursuit of subrogation recoveries when possible.
8. Consults with assigned claim director, return to work specialists, nurse case managers, internal/external medical, and legal on current and/or recommended treatment, litigation or rehabilitation plans to ensure claims outcomes are achievable and appropriate.
9. Works collaboratively with the injured worker, employer, outside counsel, and health and rehabilitation professionals to manage the claims costs and promote quality medical care.
10. Works collaboratively with the injured worker, employer, assigned return to work specialist, and medical providers to facilitate the injured worker’s safe and timely return to work.
11. Manages claims litigation, including expenses, by collaborating and providing direction to panel counsel throughout the life of the claim.
12. Analyzes reports from external resources such as physicians, attorneys, and/or vocational rehabilitation experts to evaluate and adjust claim strategies as needed.
13. Evaluates and negotiates claim settlements utilizing human relation skills and technical knowledge to achieve the best possible outcome.
14. Presents and summarizes claim details at internal team staffing, participates in discussions, and provides guidance as needed.
15. Consults with assigned claim director if the loss becomes significantly complex or presents significantly increasing financial exposure.
16. Follows established claims best practices related to medical management, litigation, fraud/abuse and recovery.
17. Effectively and independently uses available resources to prioritize, organize, and complete work in a timely manner to meet jurisdictional requirements, timeframes, and internal metrics.
18. Develops presentations for special projects such as internal/external meetings and conferences as needed.
19. Along with the claim director, regional vice president and other claims staff, participates in claim reviews, onboardings, etc. for our policyholders and agents.
20. Proactively collaborate with our policyholders to ensure alignment of objectives and foster continuous improvement.

OTHER FUNCTIONS:
1. Nonessential function: other duties as assigned.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:
• Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university is preferred.
• Three years of experience in the field of workers’ compensation insurance required.
• Ability to manage claims through the litigation process.
• Internal candidates must demonstrate knowledge of Encova Best Practices guidelines and meet quality standards.
• One valid workers’ compensation adjuster license is strongly preferred. Must be eligible to obtain additional licenses as required.
• Must pass the claims adjuster license exam(s) as assigned within 90 days of being hired.
• Preference may be shown to candidates with multiple state claims management experience.
• Experience in workers’ compensation claims practices and laws, court procedures, precedents and state statutes.
• Ability to use logic and sound reasoning to identify alternative solutions for problem-solving.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Strong analytical skills.

• Ability to multitasks and manage time effectively and productively.
• Work effectively independently as well as in a team environment.
• Develop and maintain strong, effective internal and external relationships.
• Work effectively in a paperless environment.
• Skilled in the use of laptops, claims management systems, and other typical business-related programs such as Microsoft Office suite.

This position has been evaluated in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. This description reflects the nature and level of work performed by associates in this position. It is not an all-inclusive inventory of duties, responsibilities and qualifications required. It provides an accurate overview of the work and skills needed to perform this position. jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Job Title:Senior DevOps Engineer / Ruby
Reporting into:VP of Engineering
Location:Remote (North America, South America, and Europe)
As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you will help run the cloud infrastructure that powers our Ruby API for our family of LGBTQ+ mobile dating apps. We are looking for engineers who are passionate about architecture and monads! Ok just kidding about the last part -- but you can see more about our approach to API development in our Medium blog series here. The position is 40 hours per week and ongoing/full-time.

What you'll do:

  • Maintain a complex backend which processes more than 350 million web server requests per day
  • Manage, modernize and innovate across our fleet of API, process and database servers running in the AWS cloud
  • Terraform our architecture to ensure cloud architectural consistency
  • Build a modern API application atop a functional architecture in Ruby, Ruby on Rails, and/or Sinatra
  • Build well factored, maintainable, and tested code using RSpec with Test & Behavior Driven Development (TDD & BDD)
  • Understand and build using strong architectural patterns beyond the standard MVC of Rails
  • Have a strong sense of OO programming and Architectural patterns
  • Be able to work with, mentor, and guide a distributed team of developers
  • Team members will be expected to align to the working and pairing hours of their team in their respective regions. Our team writes code in pairs, and engineering teams screen-share with each other a minimum of 4 hours per day.
  • We are pioneers of architectural linters, and are working on a new open-source architectural linter for Ruby inspired by our experience in Kotlin. This enables us to apply architectural principles across a global, distributed team
You can see more about our architectural approach on our Engineering blog here. As a DevOps engineer you should definitely read our guest post in the AWS Engineering blog here.

Requirements

Timezone requirements:
  • Because we are a global, remote, distributed company, timezone alignment is critical
  • If you are EU-based, you must be available to work between 11am CET and 8pm CET (Winter) or 12pm CET and 9pm CET (Summer)
  • If you are Brasil-based, you must be available to work between 8am EST and 5pm EST
  • If you are North America-based, you must be available to work between 8am EST and 5pm EST
Candidates must:
  • Be available to collaborate between 9a EST and 1p EST, regardless of your present timezone.
  • Have experience working for remote, global teams

jobs.description:
Senior Software Engineer (Cloud Native) – Maatwerk Software met Impact

Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. En wij begrijpen dat technologie geen barrière mag zijn, maar juist de verbinding naar een bestendige maatschappij.

Bij Dawn Technology bouwen we niet zomaar digitale oplossingen. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. Binnen onze Smart Devices afdeling bouwen we apps die impact maken. Van media apps voor bedrijven als Pathé en RTL met miljoenen gebruikers, tot de app van het KNNI waarmee we belangrijke weerswaarschuwingen zoals code rood meldingen afgeven. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details.

Om onze groeiambities binnen onze smart devices practice te realiseren zoeken we een Senior Software Engineer (Cloud Native). Iemand die energie krijgt van het ontwerpen van zwaarbelaste backend-omgevingen, het bewaken van technische standaarden en het meedenken over digitale oplossingen die écht verschil maken binnen mobiele applicaties voor miljoenen gebruikers.

Jouw rol

Als Senior Software Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor de cloud-architectuur en de backend-trajecten van onze smart device applicaties. Je bouwt de schaalbare, onzichtbare motor achter hoogwaardige innovaties en zorgt dat backends standaard zijn geoptimaliseerd voor mobiele apps.

Je bent analytisch sterk, communicatief vaardig en je krijgt er energie van om complexe business-requirements te vertalen naar logische cloud-infrastructuren. Je werkt nauw samen met onze multidisciplinaire ontwikkelteams en denkt proactief mee over databeveiliging, cloud-kosten en schaalbaarheid. Geen haastwerk, maar engineering met diepgang en visie.

Wat je zal gaan doen:

  • Ontwerpen en programmeren van complexe cloud-native architecturen en API's (AWS Serverless, microservices) met een focus op clean code.

  • Vertalen van complexe klantvragen naar stabiele cloud-infrastructuren en dit helder uitleggen aan zowel developers als aan de klant.

  • Proactief bewaken en optimaliseren van applicatie-uptime, API-performance, databeveiliging en cloud-kosten (FinOps).

  • Reviewen van code, bewaken van de technische standaard en het coachen van andere developers binnen het team.

  • Effectief asynchroon samenwerken, documenteren en code opleveren binnen een distributed, remote-first team.

Requirements

Wie ben jij?

We zoeken een ervaren engineer met een HBO werk- en denkniveau en meerdere jaren ervaring in het succesvol bouwen van grootschalige, complexe cloud-native applicaties. Je hebt al meters gemaakt met AWS en weet hoe je een stabiele infrastructuur ontwerpt voor mobiele toepassingen (zoals iOS en Android). Modern software-development zoals Agile/Scrum, CI/CD en Infrastructure as Code kent voor jou geen geheimen.

Je bent een echte spin in de code die geniet van architectonische puzzels en kalm blijft tijdens kritieke live-gang momenten. Je streeft onvoorwaardelijk naar technisch vakmanschap en deelt jouw kennis graag om het hele team naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Je begrijpt dat het in deze rol draait om de perfecte brug te slaan tussen de wensen van de klant en de ultieme technische oplossing. Verder ben je woonachtig in Nederland.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • De Organisatie: Snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software.

  • Autonomie: Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie.

  • Maatschappelijke Impact: De kans om bij te dragen aan bekende, maatschappelijk relevante applicaties voor platformen zoals NPO Start, RTL Boulevard en het KNMI binnen een uitstekend beoordeeld top-tier maatwerk softwarebedrijf (Emerce100 koploper).

  • Salaris: Bruto maandsalaris tussen de €4000,- en €6000,- passend bij jouw ervaring.

  • Vakantiedagen: 25 vakantiedagen om lekker uit te rusten.

  • Werkplek & Sfeer: Een fijne remote-first cultuur met volledige flexibiliteit, een gezellige werksfeer en inspirerende maandelijkse co-working dagen.

  • Mobiliteit & Thuiswerken: Kilometervergoeding van €0,25/km of volledige OV-vergoeding, gecombineerd met een maandelijkse thuiswerkvergoeding.

  • Pensioen: Een uitstekend en goed geregeld pensioen.

  • Ontwikkeling & Extra's: Ruime mogelijkheden voor opleidingen en trainingen, plus actieve deelname en toegang tot het eigen event Appdevcon en diverse kennissessies.

  • De 'Gadget Kit': Een high-end MacBook Pro, een 27 inch 5K display, testdevices en een volledig ingerichte thuiswerkplek.

  • Events & Fun: Toffe teamactiviteiten en gezellige, bedrijfsbrede Summer en Winter Events.

Over Dawn Technology

We bouwen niet voor de massa, maar voor betekenis. Onze klanten komen uit sectoren die er écht toe doen – van zorg en educatie tot duurzaamheid en publieke dienstverlening. We verstoppen complexiteit achter eenvoud en bouwen software die logisch voelt. En precies dát maakt ons werk elke dag boeiend.

Samen met een groep van bijna 250 digitale specialisten delen we kennis, zoeken we de nieuwste technologieën op en versterken we elkaar. Benieuwd om te horen hoe het is om bij Dawn Technology te werken? Luister dan eens naar deze podcast.

Solliciteren

Spreekt deze rol je aan? Laat je gegevens dan achter via de sollicitatieknop. Ook als je twijfelt of je volledig aansluit nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren. Nog vragen naar aanleiding van deze vacature? Neem dan gerust contact op met Dennis Timmerman (Corporate Recruiter) via 0638675360.

Have a great day. Dawn Technology.

We gebruiken voor nieuwe kandidaten een assessment (actueel binnen software ontwikkeling) om het niveau objectief vast te stellen. Hiermee onderbouwen we de totstandkoming van het salaris in het recruitmentproces op basis van feitelijke vaardigheden. Dit geeft ons een eerlijk en meetbaar kader voor iedereen.

jobs.description:
Summary

The VP, Global Practices leads the technical and methodological backbone of Guidewire Professional Services. This leader owns the global capability, technical standards, and innovation agenda across five practices — InsuranceSuite & INOW, Data, Digital, Tech & Integration, and Business Consulting — and is accountable for ensuring Guidewire-led implementations and SI partner-led programs are delivered to the highest technical bar in the industry.

This role is a true VP on all three Guidewire PS VP framework dimensions: global in scope (every practice, every region, every product), strategy-setting in authority (defines the multi-year capability roadmap and the technical bar for Guidewire implementations worldwide), and externally facing (the senior technical voice of PS with customers, SI partners, analysts, and industry forums).

Job Description

What you’ll do

Strategic Accountabilities

Technical Methodology and Standards

  • Own deployment of global technical methodology — architecture standards, integration patterns, product-specific implementation methods, design patterns, and code standards — for every Guidewire product implemented through PS.

  • Maintain practice IP (toolkits, accelerators, reference architectures) in partnership with Services Product and Portfolio team, and ensure it is versioned, governed, and accessible to regions, GDC, and SI partners globally.

  • Set the engineering rigor expected of every implementation, every region, and every partner; establish the quality bar and the enforcement mechanisms that hold to it.

  • Partner with Delivery Assurance & Global PMO on integration into the end-to-end PS delivery standard, and with Global Delivery on operationalizing technical methodology into GDC and productized services.

Innovation and Practice Evolution

  • Set the multi-year vision for how each of the five practices evolves to support new products (Pricing & Rating, Underwriting, Industry Intelligence), new delivery models, and AI-accelerated implementation.

  • Lead the integration of AI methods and tools into technical practice methodology — AI-accelerated prototyping, document ingestion, intelligent automation, code-gen, and agentic workflows — in partnership with the PS AI CoE.

  • Partner with Product, Platform, and AI engineering to ensure practice capability stays ahead of product roadmap commitments — and that Guidewire-led implementations are a proof point for new product capability.

  • Champion the productization of repeatable services solutions (e.g., BOLT, US Admitted Lines) and own the technical quality of those offerings in partnership with Global Delivery and Product & Portfolio.

Talent and Capability Bench

  • Build and maintain a world-class bench of architects, technical experts, and methodologists across all five practices.

  • Define the technical career path and leveling expectations for practice talent — from senior consultant to principal architect — in partnership with People Solutions on the broader PS career framework.

  • Drive workforce planning across practices in coordination with Global Operations and Global Delivery — anticipating skill needs 12–24 months ahead of demand.

  • Drive high levels of utilization and overall productivity across practices, managing the impacts of AI on the various tasks and roles in the organization.

  • Develop succession depth for each Senior Director practice lead and identify high-potential talent for cross-practice rotation.

Sales and Strategic Deal Support

  • Serve as the senior technical voice on strategic deals — partner with GTM and regions on deal shaping, technical pre-sales, and complex proposal development.

  • Provide escalation support for at-risk programs, bringing the right practice expertise to recover delivery and protect customer outcomes.

  • Own the technical credibility of Professional Services with major customers, partners, and Guidewire executive leadership.

Partner Technical Enablement

  • Partner with Delivery Assurance & Global PMO (which owns partner program quality standards) to set the technical bar that SI partners must meet to deliver Guidewire programs successfully, and align technical certification with overall partner accreditation.

  • Build the practice tools, training, and reference assets that enable SI partners to scale quality delivery without Guidewire bottlenecks.

  • Influence the partner ecosystem strategy — which partners to invest in, where capability gaps exist, and how to close them.

Practice Areas Under Leadership

Five Senior Director-led practices, each with its own strategic mandate:

  • InsuranceSuite & INOW — global product methodology, architecture standards, and integration patterns for Guidewire's flagship core product suite.

  • Data — data architecture, platform integration, ETL, analytics enablement, and Industry Intelligence implementation methodology.

  • Digital — Jutro, digital experience layer, customer and agent portals, and modern front-end engineering practices.

  • Tech & Integration — integration architecture, API design, cloud platform engineering, DevOps, and the cross-cutting technical foundation that all practices depend on.

  • Business Consulting — insurance domain expertise, business process design, change management, and value realization advisory.

External Representation

Represents Guidewire externally as the senior technical voice of Professional Services — at customer executive briefings, customer advisory councils, SI partner technical summits, analyst engagements, and industry forums. The role is the public face of “how Guidewire implements”, with credibility to engage architects and engineers as a peer, not just a manager.

Decision Rights

  • Owns: Global technical methodology, reference architectures, architecture and integration standards, practice IP (toolkits, accelerators, design patterns, code standards), engineering quality bar for implementations, technical certification standard for SI partners, technical career path and leveling for practice talent, practice headcount plan.

  • Influences: Regional delivery execution (regions own customer P&L), program management and assurance methodology (owned by Delivery Assurance & Global PMO), engineering and delivery-execution methodology for GDC and productized services (owned by Global Delivery), product roadmap (owned by Product & Engineering), AI tooling roadmap (owned by AI CoE), partner commercial strategy (owned by GTM and Alliances).

What Success Looks Like in the First 12-18 Months

  • Each practice has a refreshed, multi-year capability roadmap aligned to Guidewire's product strategy and AI direction.

  • Measurable improvement in implementation quality and consistency — fewer escalations, more predictable technical outcomes, fewer rework cycles.

jobs.excerpt: About BJAKThe original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for mobile developers to build BJAK's AI Neobank App across Android and iOS.

This role is for strong mobile builders who can ship clean, reliable and intuitive mobile experiences, whether their main strength is Android, iOS or both.

What You'll Own

  • Build and ship mobile features for Android and/or iOS.

  • Create simple mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services.

  • Work with product, design and backend teams to turn complex journeys into usable mobile products.

  • Integrate APIs and handle edge cases, loading states, errors and production issues.

  • Improve app performance, reliability, crash rate and user experience.

  • Support fast product launches, experiments and iterations across mobile journeys.

  • Help set high standards for mobile product quality across the app.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of mobile development experience in Android, iOS or both.

  • Strong experience with Kotlin and/or Swift.

  • Experience shipping production apps used by real users.

  • Strong product sense and attention to mobile UX.

  • Able to work with APIs, analytics, crash logs and production feedback.

  • Fast, practical and comfortable owning work with limited handholding.

  • App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks like a product builder, not just a mobile coder.

  • Cares about smooth flows, small details and real user behaviour.

  • Can work across ambiguity and ship without waiting for perfect specs.

  • Takes production quality personally.

  • Honest about what they built directly versus what the wider team delivered.

This Role Is Not For

  • Developers who only want to build isolated screens.

  • People who do not care about UX, performance or reliability.

  • Candidates who cannot explain their own contribution clearly.

  • People who need heavy guidance for every task.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a high-growth environment.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Sweden. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Sweden.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Intellect is APAC's leading mental health and wellbeing platform, serving around 4 million members across more than 100 countries through digital self-care tools, telehealth consultations, crisis helplines and physical clinics. We sell primarily to enterprise buyers — CHROs, total rewards and benefits leaders — while the end user is the employee, which means one brand with two expressions.

The Role

We're in the middle of a brand revamp — a four-phase programme to rebuild the brand key, validate it with both buyers and members, and activate it across product, web and content. Our recent design audit was blunt about where we stand: recognisable core logo, strong content, but text-heavy layouts, no unified design system across sub-brands, and creative that leans on vibrant illustration in a way that undercuts our clinical B2B positioning. You'll be the designer who closes that gap — turning credible clinical substance into work that reads as enterprise-grade and still stops the scroll.

What You'll Do

  • Campaign and social creative. Design assets across the monthly brand campaign calendar — LinkedIn single images, carousels, personal-profile posts and launch moments — with stronger visual hooks and less text density.

  • Design system and sub-brands. Help build and maintain a unified system covering typography, colour, iconography, illustration and the asset bank — and bring fragmented sub-brands (Intellect Clinic, Atlas) into one coherent architecture.
  • Events and offline collateral. Design booth backdrops, roadshow banners, print and merchandise to real production specs — panel sizes, zone hierarchy, bleed and legibility at distance.
  • Motion and video. Produce and maintain video templates for YouTube and social, plus screen-recording and product-demo assets through in-house or external agencies.
  • Web. Partner with the web developer on landing pages and the site revamp, with attention to navigation hierarchy and conversion pathways for executive decision-makers.

Requirements

Must Have

  • Strong typographic and layout craft — the ability to make dense, evidence-heavy content readable.

jobs.description:
Overview

BrightView was founded to give the people in our communities two things: help and hope. We’re changing addiction treatment by combating the disease of addiction with a comprehensive treatment approach.

We are committed to personalizing our addiction treatment programs to each individual patient. We believe anyone can achieve the goal of life-long recovery with the help of our outpatient services which includes Medically Assisted Treatment and Clinical Services.

We continue to grow our presence nationwide as we stay committed to serving patients and saving lives!

Position Summary:

The Advanced Practitioner-Psychiatric Mental Health NP will be responsible for providing medical services in collaboration with a licensed physician. Psychiatric Mental Health NP is a member of a treatment team, which may consist of staff with a variety of mental health, education, or medical backgrounds. The Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner plans and delivers clinical services that include:

  • Document patients' medical and psychological histories, physical assessment results, diagnoses, treatment plans, prescriptions, or outcomes.
  • Evaluate patients' behavior to formulate diagnoses or assess treatments.
  • Analyze patient data to determine patient needs or treatment goals.
  • Write prescriptions for psychotropic medications as allowed by state regulations and collaborative practice agreements with experience and understanding of chemical dependency treatment.
  • Monitor patients' medication usage and results.
  • Monitor patient progress or responses to treatment.

The NP must practice in accordance with the rules adopted by the Ohio Board of Nursing, the Revised Code, and SBHI policies and procedures.

The Advanced Practitioner will document patient histories, perform physical examinations, order diagnostic tests, and perform existing patient assessments as needed. The Advance Practitioner will also implement treatment plans in coordination with the supervising physician and inform patients about the medical components of their treatment. The goal of this position is to be a key component of the integrated care team that provides high quality comprehensive care to each of our patients.

Responsibilities

    • Mentor and conduct professional development activities (e.g., in-service, training) in medical subjects relevant to the patient’s treatment
    • Participate in all trainings as required by federal, state, local and accrediting agencies
    • Develop and present training content for education on various medical topics relevant to substance use disorders and general good health practices when requested
    • Perform medical services within the scope of his/her education, training and expertise:
      • Obtain and prepare patient histories and perform physical examinations
      • Assess patient’s appropriateness for dosing, dose level adjustments, phase level adjustments, and changes to the patient’s treatment plan
      • Order or perform diagnostic procedures as delegated by the supervising physician
      • Assist in the development and implementation of a treatment plan in accordance with written clinical practice guidelines
      • Monitor the effectiveness of therapeutic interventions
      • Offer counseling and education to meet patient needs, especially in the medical areas of patient’s treatment
      • Coordinate care with ancillary healthcare providers and make referrals when appropriate
      • Review all laboratory results, as well as all medical documentation from other care providers
    • Ensure implementation of medical quality health standards for both patients and employees
    • Provide medical input into overall program philosophy, treatment services, and patient care when requested
    • Provide a response to emergency care providers when they require consultation for one of the program’s patients
    • Collaborate whenever necessary with other physicians, clinics or hospitals participating in the treatment of program patients
    • Attend weekly treatment team meetings, as well as outside seminars and training when approved by the Senior Medical Director
    • Hold a basic understanding of drug/alcohol abuse and addiction
      • Keep updated on current drug abuse and treatment information, especially current trends in Substance Use Disorders including Opioid Maintenance Treatment
    • Develop professional, helpful, and effective relationships with patients, team members, and constituents; re-engage patients as necessary
    • Ensure treatment center meets all accreditation standards related to Medical, Health, and Safety issues
    • Comply with all accrediting, federal, state, and local regulatory agency requirements
    • Assist in activities that are otherwise identified by members of the Senior Management team

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for Mobile developer to build the native Android experience for BJAK's AI Finance Agent.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

What You'll Own

  • Build and ship Android features using Kotlin.

  • Create clean mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services.

  • Work with product and design to simplify complex user journeys.

  • Integrate backend APIs and ensure mobile flows are stable, secure and reliable.

  • Improve app performance, crash rate, loading states, responsiveness and memory usage.

  • Use analytics, user behaviour and production issues to improve the product.

  • Build AI-assisted mobile experiences only where they genuinely improve the user journey.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of Android development experience using Kotlin.

  • Strong Android fundamentals and experience shipping production apps.

  • Good knowledge of Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android architecture.

  • Strong sense of mobile UX, usability, edge cases and user flows.

  • Experience integrating REST APIs and debugging production issues.

  • Fast execution, high ownership and strong attention to product quality.

  • App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage.

Tech Stack

  • Kotlin

  • Jetpack Compose

  • Android SDK

  • Coroutines & Flow

  • SQL / NoSQL

  • TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks in user journeys, not just screens.

  • Cares about making complex financial products feel simple.

  • Moves fast without creating messy code.

  • Notices UX, performance and reliability issues before users complain.

  • Honest about what they personally built, what was team-owned and what impact they can or cannot claim.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Thailand. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Thailand.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Partner Acquisition Germany team builds the partner channel through which iwoca reaches small businesses in Germany: comparison platforms and brokers, banks, payment providers, business software providers and financial advisors who offer iwoca's finance to their customers at the moment it is needed. The team works with three partnership models, from a co-branded referral link and a partner portal to a full API integration, and measures its success by partners that are live and funding customers.

The team is small and works closely together: the Head of Partner Acquisition Germany, a Strategy & Data Manager who owns market analysis, business cases and the CRM, and the partner managers who own the relationships. The team prioritises partners by strategic fit, works through warm introductions and existing networks wherever possible, and stays close to every new partner until the first customers are funded. It works hand in hand with Relationship Management and the product and engineering teams in London / Berlin / Frankfurt that build the integrations.

The role

This is a senior role with full ownership of the partners you pursue. Three things matter more than anything else: You will qualify before you sell, because the best partnerships begin with a genuine customer need. You know how to activate networks and create warm introductions rather than relying solely on cold outreach. And you consider a deal complete only when the partnership is live, working well and funding its first customers. You'll travel across Germany one to two days a week for face-to-face partner meetings, industry events and trade fairs.

Ownership and impact

  • Own a portfolio of the highest-value partnership prospects in Germany, from first conversation to signed contract and live integration.

  • Lead negotiations with founders, managing directors and heads of product or partnerships at banks, payment providers, business software platforms and financial intermediaries.

  • Design the cooperation model and commercial terms for each partner so that the partnership works for both sides over years, not quarters.

  • Bring every partner to go-live with a committed internal promoter and a first concrete use case, so that your work turns into funded customers and long-term value.

Autonomy, backed by a dedicated strategy and data function

  • Spend your time on relationships and deals, with a Strategy & Data Manager who builds target models, business cases and CRM automation alongside you for your prospects and partners.

  • Own your pipeline end to end and keep it transparent, so that forecasts and decisions rest on input and numbers everyone trusts.

  • Decide together with the Head of Partner Acquisition which segments and partners you pursue and where you say no.

Influence on product and strategy

  • Feed what you learn from partners directly into our partnership models, the integration roadmap and the go-to-market plan for Germany.

  • Shape the activation playbook for new partners and the handover to Key Account Management together with the Head of Business Development.

  • Represent iwoca at the industry events, trade fairs and partner roundtables that matter for SME finance in Germany.

The requirements

Essential:

  • At least five years of experience in B2B partnerships, business development or key account management in fintech, banking, payments or business software. You can show a proven track record of closing complex deals with six to twelve month sales cycles at C-Level, founder, board or head-of-department level.

  • A working understanding of how a financing product is integrated into a partner's platform: APIs, embedded finance and how a partner's customer data can be used in the application journey. You won't build integrations yourself (our engineering teams do that), but you need to lead that conversation credibly.

  • Native-level German and professional English.

  • Demonstrates curiosity to use and learn more about AI tools. You’ll already be comfortable using AI tools in practical ways to help solve problems, increase productivity and improve quality of work, showing good judgement about when to use them and the ability to explain the reasoning behind that use.

Bonus:

  • An existing network among German banks, payment providers, brokers or business software platforms.

  • Experience with lending, working capital or other financial products for small businesses.

  • Experience managing a partner pipeline in HubSpot and using data to prioritise targets.

Don’t take this list as prescriptive: it’s just to give you a sense of who might do well at the job. We’d still love to hear from you if you don’t hit every point on the list, or if you have other experience.

The salary

We expect to pay from €70,000 - €85,000 base salary plus a performance-related bonus for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • A smart, motivated and international team (we represent over 35 different nationalities) with a ridiculous growth-mindset.

  • 26 days of vacation a year plus a free day for your birthday.

  • One-month fully paid sabbatical after 4 years.

  • Mental health support with direct access to certified psychologists via our partner OpenUp.

  • iwoca takes over a ski chalet in winter so that you and your team can ski or snowboard (and work) for a week. During summer we are drawn to the sun. We’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

  • Access to the gym membership program, €25 for either Fit711 or Urban Sports Club.

  • €30 contribution towards the Deutschlandticket.

  • Company Pension with Canada Life.

  • Great office locations. In Frankfurt in the middle of the city, our Berlin office is located in Prenzlauer Berg.

  • A paid volunteer day that gives you the opportunity to invest time to support a charity of your choice.

  • Corporate Benefits discounts.

  • ’iwocans’ also benefit from fully stocked fridges in our offices with whatever is needed to strengthen them. There are snacks (both healthy and less healthy) for the whole day.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone, including a book budget.

  • Learning German budget.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Useful links:

  • See iwoca benefits & policies iwocade/iwoca-benefits-policies-de for detail and some additional benefits.

  • See iwoca interview welcome pack iwocade/iwoca-interview-welcome-pack-de.

Compensation Range: €70K - €85K

jobs.title: Masterpsycholoog GGz Online
jobs.excerpt: Jouw vak, volledig onlineAls masterpsycholoog behandel je volwassenen vanaf 18 jaar met onder andere angststoornissen, depressieve klachten en trauma- en stressgerelateerde stoornissen.
jobs.description:
Jouw vak, volledig online

Als masterpsycholoog behandel je volwassenen vanaf 18 jaar met onder andere angststoornissen, depressieve klachten en trauma- en stressgerelateerde stoornissen. De behandelingen zijn kortdurend en intensief, met een gemiddelde behandelduur van drie maanden.

Je voert online intakegesprekken en stelt samen met een regiebehandelaar het behandelplan op. Vervolgens voer je zelfstandig behandelinterventies uit. Daarbij gebruik je beeldbellen en online behandelmodules, maar ook digitale toepassingen zoals biofeedback, virtual reality, serious gaming en EMDR-tools als MOOVD en Psylaris.

Concreet betekent dit dat je:

  • online intakegesprekken voert en behandelplannen opstelt in overleg met een regiebehandelaar;

  • evidence-based behandelinterventies uitvoert;

  • digitale behandeltechnieken inzet wanneer deze passen bij de behandeling;

  • deelneemt aan multidisciplinaire overleggen;

  • jouw kennis en ervaringen deelt met collega’s;

  • bijdraagt aan de verdere ontwikkeling van digitaal behandelen binnen GGz Online.

Volledig online behandelen vraagt meer dan dezelfde behandeling via een beeldscherm uitvoeren. Je bouwt digitaal een behandelrelatie op, kiest bewust welke interventie past en leert digitale mogelijkheden gericht binnen je vak toe te passen.

Zelfstandig betekent niet alleen

Je krijgt ruimte om zelfstandig te behandelen, maar staat er inhoudelijk niet alleen voor. Je werkt samen met onder anderen psychologen, ervaringsdeskundigen, verpleegkundigen en psychiaters.

Je stemt af met de regiebehandelaar over behandelplannen en bespreekt casuïstiek met collega’s wanneer dat inhoudelijk nodig is. Ook neem je deel aan multidisciplinaire overleggen.

Zo combineer je zelfstandig werken met de kennis van verschillende disciplines.

Zo ziet werken bij GGz Online eruit

GGz Online is de digitale poli van GGz Centraal en biedt specialistische geestelijke gezondheidszorg volledig online. Niet alleen het contact met cliënten is digitaal; de manier van werken is daarop ingericht.

Je organiseert een groot deel van je werkdag zelfstandig. GGz Online biedt op werkdagen behandelingen tussen 08.00 en 20.00 uur. Op die dagen stem je je werktijden daarop af en begin je later.

Binnen de behandeling werken we met evidence-based interventies en verschillende digitale behandeltechnieken. Als masterpsycholoog krijg je daarmee de ruimte om je vak uit te oefenen én ervaring op te bouwen met volledig digitaal behandelen.

Requirements

Past deze manier van werken bij jou?

Volledig digitaal behandelen moet bij je passen. Je hebt niet voortdurend collega's fysiek om je heen en organiseert je werk voor een belangrijk deel zelf. Dat vraagt dat je verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor je eigen werk en gericht afstemming zoekt wanneer dat nodig is.

Je past bij deze manier van werken als je:

  • zelfstandig kunt werken en professionele verantwoordelijkheid neemt;

  • digitaal vaardig bent;

  • via beeldbellen een professionele behandelrelatie kunt opbouwen;

  • zorgvuldig en gestructureerd kunt werken;

  • nieuwsgierig bent naar de mogelijkheden van digitale behandeltechnieken;

  • collega's actief opzoekt voor afstemming en inhoudelijke verdieping.

Dit heb je nodig

Voor deze functie heb je:

  • een afgeronde universitaire masteropleiding psychologie;

  • een LOGO-verklaring of de mogelijkheid deze op korte termijn aan te vragen;

  • ervaring binnen de specialistische ggz;

  • een afgeronde basiscursus CGT.

Ervaring met EMDR, imaginaire exposure en/of ACT is een pré.

Daarnaast ben je bij voorkeur twee avonden per week beschikbaar om tot 19.30 uur te behandelen.

Wat je van ons krijgt

Werk dat er toe doet en waar je van betekenis bent, dat is alvast onze eerste belofte. Omdat we een grote organisatie zijn met veel verschillende mogelijkheden kunnen we inspelen op ontwikkelwensen en voorkeuren qua functie-inhoud, type behandelprogramma en woon-werkafstand. We zien wie je bent en wat je kan. Als -masterpsycholoog bij GGz Centraal kun je in ieder geval rekenen op:

  • een bruto maandsalaris volgens CAO GGZ, FWG 60 (tussen €4.544,- en €5.901,- o.b.v. 36 uur​). Bereken hier jouw netto salaris.

  • een contract voor 24-36 uur per week voor onbepaalde tijd. We werken vanuit vertrouwen, dus je krijgt meteen een vast contract.

  • een vakantietoeslag en een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33%.

  • 166 verlofuren en 35 levensfase-uren o.b.v. 36 uur. Zo willen we bijdragen aan een goede werk-privébalans.

  • een jaarlijks balansbudget van €1.000,- naar rato. Dit budget kun je besteden aan iets waar jij blij van wordt. Denk aan een cursus, extra salaris of verlofuren, aan jou de keuze.

Boven alles bieden we je een uitdagende en afwisselende baan met de ruimte om jezelf professioneel en persoonlijk te ontwikkelen via opleidingen, trainingen en interne scholing.

PrOMO
Masterpsychologen en orthopedagogen kunnen bij ons een intern ontwikkelprogramma volgen, waarmee startende gedragswetenschappers hun kennis ten aanzien van diagnostiek en behandeling kunnen uitbreiden. Meer weten? Alles over PrOMO lees je hier.

Onze arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn conform de CAO GGZ. Heb je vragen? Laat het ons weten.

Klaar om te solliciteren?

Past deze manier van behandelen bij jou en voldoe je aan de functie-eisen? Solliciteer dan via de sollicitatieknop.

Zodra we een passende kandidaat hebben gevonden, kunnen we de vacature eerder sluiten.

Eerst weten hoe dit in de praktijk werkt?

Benieuwd hoe volledig online behandelen er voor een masterpsycholoog in de praktijk uitziet? Of wil je meer weten over de caseload, behandelmethoden of samenwerking met de regiebehandelaar? neem dan contact op met Carlos Croes, klinisch psycholoog/manager zorg, via +31 6 53479468.

Een referentiecheck maakt onderdeel uit van het aannamebeleid. Bij indiensttreding vragen we om een actuele Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG). GGz Online vraagt deze voor je aan en vergoedt de kosten.

Highlights

Je behandelt volwassenen met onder andere angst, depressie en trauma volledig online. Met bewezen behandelmethoden én digitale technieken werk je gericht aan kortdurende, intensieve behandelingen.

Workforce Lead – North of England

Full time, permanent.

jobs.excerpt: Nelnet is a diversified and innovative company committed to enriching lives through the power of service as a student loan servicer, professional services company, consumer loan originator and servicer, payments processor, renewable energy solutions, and K-12 and higher education expert.
jobs.description:
Nelnet is a diversified and innovative company committed to enriching lives through the power of service as a student loan servicer, professional services company, consumer loan originator and servicer, payments processor, renewable energy solutions, and K-12 and higher education expert. For over 40 years, Nelnet has been serving its customers, associates, and communities.

The perks of working at Nelnet go beyond our benefits package. When you join the Nelnet team, you're part of a community invested in the success of each individual. That support comes through in our work, as we are united by our mission of creating opportunities for people where they live, learn, and work.

This role owns the data foundation underpinning Nelnet’s GenAI solutions for higher education and SLED clients. The Data Engineer builds and maintains the data pipelines, classification, and governance framework required to make client data safely and reliably usable by agentic AI solutions built on the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform.


Operating within Nelnet’s GenAI delivery team, this role translates the Forward Deployed Engineer’s scoped requirements into production data pipelines on Google Cloud, working closely with the GCP/Gemini Enterprise Engineer to ensure data is structured, classified, and access-controlled appropriately for AI use. Given the sensitivity of student and institutional data, this role plays a central part in surfacing data-level compliance risk — such as FERPA — before it reaches production.

Compensation range for this role: $115,000-$135,000 based on experience.

Data Pipeline Engineering

  • Design, build, and maintain data pipelines using BigQuery and Dataflow (or Cloud Composer/Apache Airflow) to ingest, transform, and serve client data for GenAI use cases.
  • Build and maintain ELT/ETL processes for batch ingestion of client source system data (SIS, ERP, casework systems) into Google Cloud analytics and RAG data stores — distinct from the live, real-time system access the GCP/Gemini Enterprise Engineer builds for agent tool use.
  • Monitor pipeline reliability, performance, and cost, optimizing BigQuery usage and Dataflow jobs as engagements scale.

Data Classification & AI Readiness

  • Classify and tag client data using Dataplex and Cloud Data Loss Prevention (DLP) to identify sensitive and regulated data, such as FERPA-protected student records, prior to AI use.
  • Define and enforce data access controls and governance policies appropriate for higher education and SLED data sensitivity.
  • Assess and document data readiness for AI use cases, flagging gaps in quality, completeness, or governance to the Forward Deployed Engineer.

Data Architecture & Integration

  • Design data models and schemas that support both current client use cases and reusable, repeatable data patterns across engagements.
  • Partner with client technical teams to understand source system constraints and negotiate data access and extraction approaches.
  • Maintain technical documentation of data flows, schemas, and classification decisions for internal reuse and audit purposes.

Delivery Execution & Quality

  • Execute against the delivery backlog owned by the Forward Deployed Engineer, providing technical estimates and flagging data-related delivery risks.
  • Partner with the GCP/Gemini Enterprise Engineer to ensure data pipelines feed agentic solutions with the structure and freshness required.
  • Conduct data quality reviews and testing to maintain reliability standards across the practice.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with the GCP/Gemini Enterprise Engineer on data structure and access needed for agentic solutions and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines.
  • Partner with the AgentOps Engineer on infrastructure, security, and environment management for data systems.
  • Provide technical input to the Forward Deployed Engineer and Engagement Manager on data-related scope, risk, and timeline.

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s degree in related field or equivalent work experience

  • Develop software engineering best practices, guidelines, procedures, and repeatable and scalable frameworks

  • Document, automate, and enforce data quality, data integrity, and QA best practices

  • 5+ years of experience with cloud solutions (AWS, Azure)

  • 5+ years of experience with big data technologies (Spark, Hadoop, MapReduce, Hive, Kafka)

  • 5+ years of experience with data pipelines orchestration tools like Airflow.

jobs.title: Customer Manager - Quality & Insights
jobs.excerpt: What are we building? Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world.
jobs.description:
What are we building?

Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. We're building a team that resonates passion for learning, operating, and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We care about each customer interaction, experience, behavior, and insight and strive to ensure we're always acting authentically.

Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We're taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space — ready to join us?

What's the position?

As Customer Quality & Insights Manager, you will build and lead how Hard Rock Digital understands and acts on customer sentiment. This is a zero-to-one role: the function doesn't exist yet, and you will be the one to organize various efforts into one cohesive strategy — the reporting, the process, and eventually the team.

At the center of the role is a closed loop, and running that loop well is the actual job: identify where sentiment is slipping, diagnose what's driving it, get the finding to the team who can fix it, and then track what happens after the fix ships to confirm it actually moved the needle. Anything short of closing the loop is just reporting; closing it is what makes the role valuable.

You will organize diagnosis around three pillars that drive customer sentiment: Person (how interactions are handled), Product (how our app and platform perform for customers), and Policy (how our processes and rules affect the experience). Your job is to find the story in the data and hand stakeholders something specific they can act on — not to audit or score individual performance. When a finding touches an individual interaction, your role is to surface the pattern and hand it to the team that owns coaching or process change, not to run that conversation yourself.

This role reports directly to the Senior Manager, Operations Strategy & Insights. There are no direct reports today, but as the function grows, so will this team. You will work alongside the existing BI Operations function — the two teams are parallel, and you'll partner closely with them on shared data and stakeholder context.

Responsibilities

Building the function

  • Stand up the customer sentiment/insights function: the reporting, the classification taxonomy, and the closed-loop process end to end.

  • Define and own how the loop works across the org — from issue identification through post-implementation impact tracking — so stakeholders know how to engage with findings and recommendations.

  • Build the case for future headcount and, if approved, onboard and manage a Quality & Insights Analyst.

  • Represent the Insights function in cross-functional forums as the org's point of contact for customer sentiment.

Sentiment measurement & reporting

  • Build and maintain CSAT and sentiment reporting that gives stakeholders a clear, ongoing view of customer sentiment trends.

  • Design and evolve a sentiment taxonomy that reliably classifies feedback into the Person, Product, and Policy pillars.

  • Mine reviews, support tickets, surveys, and other qualitative feedback sources for sentiment signal, using AI tools to accelerate classification and pattern detection.

  • Track sentiment trends over time and proactively surface emerging issues before they show up as escalations.

Diagnosing what's driving sentiment

  • When sentiment dips or a pattern emerges, dig into the underlying story: is it how an interaction was handled, a product friction point, or a policy/process design issue?

  • Distinguish one-off incidents from systemic patterns, and prioritize investigations toward the issues with the greatest sentiment impact.

  • Turn what you find into a clear, specific narrative stakeholders can act on — the goal is to explain what's driving the pattern, not to audit or score any individual's performance.

Closing the loop

  • Route findings to the team best positioned to act on them (people leadership, product, policy/process owners) with a specific, actionable recommendation.

  • Maintain a running view of every open issue's status in the loop: identified, diagnosed, routed, and resolved.

  • Track outcomes after a fix ships to confirm whether it actually moved sentiment, and close the loop back to the original finding.

  • Present findings and loop status clearly to stakeholders, including team leads and cross-functional partners who own the Product and Policy pillars.

  • Build data-backed business cases when a recommendation requires investment, prioritization, or a change to an existing process.

Data foundation

  • Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, transform, and validate sentiment and CSAT data across large, complex datasets.

  • Validate data integrity and ensure sentiment classifications and diagnostic findings are grounded in accurate, well-understood sources.

  • Create and maintain clear documentation for sentiment definitions, classification methodology, and recurring reports.

  • Collaborate with the BI Operations team on shared data, metrics, and stakeholder context to ensure consistency across functions.

Requirements

What are we looking for?

  • 6–9 years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, customer experience, or a related field, including experience owning a function, workstream, or reporting capability with significant ambiguity.

  • Proficient SQL skills, including the ability to write and join queries across multiple data sources (CSAT, NPS, support systems) to build reporting independently.

  • Experience building and maintaining dashboards or reporting (Tableau or similar) that stakeholders rely on directly.

  • Demonstrated ability to diagnose the underlying driver behind a pattern in customer feedback and turn it into a specific, actionable recommendation.

jobs.description:
Job Summary

Bright Vision Technologies is seeking a highly experienced Semiconductor Software Engineer with 10+ years of industry experience to design, develop, and optimize software, firmware, and automation solutions supporting semiconductor design, verification, manufacturing, and post-silicon validation. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in C/C++, Python, EDA tools, hardware-software integration, and software architecture, with a proven track record of delivering scalable solutions for complex semiconductor platforms.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop high-performance software solutions for semiconductor design, verification, and validation workflows.
  • Architect and implement firmware, device drivers, and low-level software for advanced silicon platforms.
  • Develop scalable automation frameworks and infrastructure for EDA tools, build systems, and compute environments.
  • Design and enhance post-silicon validation, debugging, characterization, and data analysis tools.
  • Optimize software performance, reliability, and scalability across multicore, embedded, and distributed computing environments.
  • Collaborate closely with hardware, ASIC, FPGA, verification, and manufacturing engineering teams to enable successful silicon bring-up and production.
  • Lead technical design discussions, conduct code reviews, and establish software development best practices.
  • Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership across cross-functional teams.
  • Evaluate and integrate emerging technologies, methodologies, and tools to improve engineering productivity and product quality.
  • Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, design specifications, and development guidelines.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience in semiconductor or embedded systems environments.
  • Expert-level programming skills in C, C++, and Python.
  • Extensive experience with EDA tools, ASIC/SoC verification, silicon bring-up, or post-silicon validation.
  • Strong understanding of hardware-software integration, embedded systems, debugging techniques, and performance optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with scripting, automation frameworks, Linux development environments, and HPC or cloud-based compute infrastructure.
  • Experience with version control systems, CI/CD pipelines, and modern software development methodologies.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and technical leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with SystemVerilog, UVM, Verilog, or VHDL.
  • Knowledge of cloud-native EDA workflows, distributed computing, and AI/ML applications in semiconductor design.
  • Experience with FPGA development, embedded Linux, or real-time operating systems (RTOS).
  • Prior experience leading engineering teams or driving large-scale technical initiatives.
  • Master's or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
